description:
About This Position

We are looking for a Data Analyst to support the Demand Planning team in improving demand forecast accuracy and reliability. You will analyze sales and demand patterns, develop forecasting logic, and build automated tools and monitoring to support inventory and fulfillment decisions, ensuring customer demand is met just-in-time.

If you enjoy turning data into practical forecasting solutions and working cross-functionally to improve product availability, we would love to meet you.


Key Responsibilities

  • Demand Forecasting & Business Analysis
    • Analyze demand patterns across SKU, hub, category, time period, campaign, price changes, and seasonal/festive events.
    • Develop, evaluate, and improve demand forecasting logic, including baseline normalization, seasonality, festive events
    • Monitor and analyze forecast-performance metrics
    • Identify and investigate sales and demand anomalies, including unusual spikes or drops caused by festive events, trends, pricing changes, or operational disruption.
    • Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations for Demand Planners and Supply Chain stakeholders.
  • Forecasting Logic, Automation & Data Products
    • Translate Demand Planning business requirements into scalable data solutions, including datasets, forecasting logic, dashboards, alerts, and automated workflows.
    • Build and maintain data models and pipelines supporting demand forecasting processes, including data preparation, normalization, imputation, reporting, and configuration management.
    • Automate manual forecasting and monitoring processes using SQL, Python, BigQuery, workflow orchestration/DAGs, and integrations with Google Sheets or reporting tools.
    • Develop alerts and trackers to enable timely responses to changes in demand, pricing, anomalies, campaign performance, and availability risk.
    • Maintain clear documentation for technical logic, data lineage, source tables, configurations, business rules, and operational runbooks.
  • Production Pipeline Ownership & Reliability
    • Ensure the reliability and timeliness of daily forecasting pipelines and report-refresh processes.
    • Conduct troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and remediation for data-quality issues, pipeline failures, reporting discrepancies, and forecast anomalies.
    • Perform manual runs or backfills when required, ensuring workflow sequence and dependencies are executed correctly.
    • Work with Data Engineering, Data Science, and Product teams to improve the robustness, scalability, and maintainability of forecasting systems.

name: Big Data Analyst
qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of industry experience in data handling, reporting, and analysis.
  • BS or higher in data analytics, statistics, mathematics, or a related technical field or equivalent practical experience.

Core Technical Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with sound judgment about statistical significance, sample size, and confounding.
  • Strong SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL or similar): joins, window functions, CTEs, and query performance on large tables.
  • Python or R with the relevant analytical libraries (e.g. pandas, numpy, statsmodels, scikit-learn, or the tidyverse equivalents).
  • Experience with BI or analytical software such as QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or Metabase.
  • Practical fluency with AI tooling in the analytics workflow, using LLMs and embeddings for text analysis, code assistance, and exploratory work, alongside a clear-eyed view of where these tools fail and how to catch it.

Nice to Have

  • AWS data workflow : Lake Formation, Glue, Crawler, Data Catalog, and Athena.
  • Experience with lakehouse table formats (Iceberg, Delta, or Hudi) and layered data architectures (raw, transformed, curated).
  • Working knowledge of GA4, server-side tracking, and multi-touch or cross-platform attribution, including its limits.
  • Understanding of how AI-driven discovery is reshaping publisher traffic AI summaries, zero-click search, referrals from conversational assistants, and how to measure it.

description:
Analisis Akar Masalah (Root Cause Analysis): Melakukan investigasi RCA berdasarkan alert monitoring data pipeline sesuai prosedur dan SLA pada lingkungan Production (DC) dan Disaster Recovery (DR).

Pengelolaan Deployment: Melaksanakan proses deployment platform data pipeline, meliputi tahap pre-check, deployment execution, hingga post-deployment monitoring untuk memastikan kualitas dan keberhasilan deployment.

Pemeliharaan & Optimasi Sistem:

Melakukan deep dive analysis terkait performa sistem data pipeline dan database, mencakup configuration tuning, table, index, jobs, dan query.

Melakukan pengecekan detail pada object platform dan database untuk mengidentifikasi potensi masalah serta menentukan solusi permanen maupun langkah perbaikan berkelanjutan.

Penyelesaian Masalah (Troubleshooting): Penanganan troubleshooting tingkat lanjut dan perbaikan insiden pada pipeline logic, OS & server, storage, serta jaringan dan konektivitas.

Analisis Tren & Otomasi:

Menganalisis tren performa dan penggunaan sistem (data growth, job relation & dependency, data flow, resource utilization) serta menyusun rencana peningkatan performa (improvement).

Menguasai proses otomasi (monitoring, alert, notification, analisis) dan penyesuaian performa (performance tuning) pada sistem, database, maupun server.

Dokumentasi & Transfer Knowledge: Menyusun serta memperbarui prosedur operasional, mendokumentasikan change management pada tracker, dan memberikan bimbingan (transfer knowledge) kepada tim Junior.

Pelaporan & Komunikasi: Menyusun dan mempresentasikan analisis, rekomendasi, serta wawasan (insight) terkait sistem pangkalan data kepada tim teknis maupun non-teknis.

description:
About this Position
As a Data Platform Engineer — External Data Acquisition, you will build and operate ASTRO's platform for acquiring data from external sources, including websites, web/mobile applications, APIs, public datasets, and third-party data providers.

A significant part of this role focuses on production-grade web and application data acquisition for pricing and market intelligence use cases. You will own the acquisition layer—from understanding external systems and extracting data to delivering reliable landing data for downstream processing.

Focus: External Data Acquisition · Web & App Scraping · Python · HTTP/API · Data Pipelines · Reliability

As our Astronaut, your missions are:

  • Build and maintain reliable web/app crawlers, scrapers, and external API integrations across e-commerce, marketplace, retail, and other external sources.
  • Analyze browser, mobile application, API, and network traffic to understand how data is delivered and design the appropriate acquisition approach and runtime, from direct HTTP/API extraction to browser automation.
  • Build acquisition systems that remain reliable as external websites, applications, APIs, and data contracts evolve.
  • Handle real-world source complexity such as sessions, tokens, pagination, dynamic content, rate limits, retries, concurrency, and partial failures.
  • Build resilient and maintainable acquisition systems with appropriate testing, idempotency, deduplication, retries, safe reruns, data-quality validation, monitoring, and alerting.
  • Operate acquisition workloads using appropriate workflow orchestration, compute, data storage/warehousing, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Continuously improve reliability, scalability, maintainability, and total cost of ownership, including evaluating build-vs-buy approaches for external data.
  • Explore new technologies and AI-assisted development or automation to improve how external-data pipelines are built, operated, and maintained.
  • Collaborate with Pricing, Data Warehouse Engineering, Data Analysts, and other stakeholders to turn external-data needs into sustainable platform capabilities.

address_components.address_line_1: 27, Jalan Tomang Raya, Tomang Kel., Grogol Petamburan

name: Data Platform Engineer
qualifications:
In order to launch successfully, you need to have:

  • Strong Python/software engineering fundamentals and experience building maintainable production systems.
  • Hands-on experience building or operating web scraping, crawling, external API, or similar data acquisition systems.
  • Strong understanding of HTTP, APIs, JSON, headers, cookies, sessions, authentication, pagination, and request/response behavior.
  • Hands-on experience with browser/network debugging and the ability to investigate how websites or applications communicate with their backend services.
  • Experience with both HTTP-based extraction and browser automation, using tools such as Requests/HTTPX, Selenium, Playwright, Scrapy, or equivalent.
  • Understanding of production reliability patterns such as retry, timeout, rate limiting, concurrency, idempotency, and failure recovery.
  • Solid understanding of SQL, data storage/warehousing, schema evolution, workflow orchestration, containerized workloads, and cloud infrastructure fundamentals.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills, especially when working with frequently changing external systems outside your direct control.

Good to Have

  • Experience acquiring data from mobile applications, marketplaces, e-commerce, grocery, food-delivery, or other large consumer platforms.
  • Experience with asynchronous or distributed acquisition systems and high-volume crawling.
  • Familiarity with proxy infrastructure, data observability, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development or automation to improve data acquisition workflows.
  • Experience designing reusable scraping frameworks or shared acquisition platforms.
  • Experience with geospatial or other non-traditional external datasets.

Berkat dukungan dan kerjasama tim yang telah memiliki pengalaman kerja dan komitmen lebih dari 10 tahun di Industri Teknologi Informasi dan Kesehatan, Infokes mampu meraih berbagai prestasi di tingkat Nasional dan Internasional, serta berhasil mengimplementasikan produk dan sistemnya lebih dari 1.000 puskesmas aktif sampai saat ini yang bisa diakses secara realtime / online.
Kedepannya, Infokes akan terus melakukan inovasi-inovasi dan riset teknologi seperti M2M (Machine to Machine) dan IoT (Internet of Things) yang bisa saling terintegrasi dengan Infokes Platform untuk mewujudkan Integrated eHealth Solutions di Indonesia.

company.description:
PT BCA Finance berdiri pada tahun 1981 dengan nama PT Central Sari Metropolitan Leasing Corporation (CSML). Pada awal berdirinya, pemegang saham Perusahaan adalah PT Bank Central Asia dan Japan Leasing Corporation. Saat itu Perusahaan masih memfokuskan usaha pada pembiayaan komersial, seperti pembiayaan mesin-mesin produksi, alat berat dan transportasi.

Selanjutnya pada tahun 2001 PT Central Sari Metropolitan Leasing berubah nama menjadi PT Central Sari Finance (CSF), diikuti dengan perubahan kepemilikan saham, dimana PT Bank Central Asia, Tbk (BCA) menjadi pemegang saham mayoritas, serta perubahan fokus usaha menjadi pembiayaan kendaraan bermotor, khususnya roda empat atau lebih. Terakhir, Sesuai dengan Surat Keputusan Menteri Hukum dan Hak Asasi Manusia Republik Indonesia No.C-08091 HT.01.04.TH.2005, maka per tanggal 28 Maret 2005 PT Central Sari Finance telah berubah nama menjadi PT BCA Finance.

Kini BCA Finance sendiri telah berhasil mencatatkan asset kelolaan sebesar 52 T dengan profit 1,6 T. Dengan misinya untuk menjadi perusahaan terkemuka di industri pembiayaan PT BCA Finance senantiasa melakukan perubahan dan pengembangan model bisnis untuk menjawab tantangan dan kebutuhan zaman dimana hal ini sejalan dengan tag line perusahaan yaitu solusi tepat pembiayaan anda. 

Untuk mencapai hal tersebut PT BCA Finance memiliki nila-nilai perusahaan yang senantiasa diterapkan yaitu FOCUS yang terdiri dari:

First Class Teamwork
Orientation to Quality
Customer Focus
Uncompromise Integrity
Striving for Excellence

Melalui FOCUS ini seluruh karyawan diarahkan untuk memiliki budaya kerja yang sama sehingga tercipta sebuah Tim yang solid dalam menjalankan bisnis.

Untuk SDM sendiri selain penanaman budaya perusahaan BCA Finance juga focus pada pengembangan skill dan karir karyawannya oleh karena itu kebutuhan pejabat di BCA Finance 90% diperoleh dari internal.

company.description:
Asuransi Astra has been serving customers for more than half a century, precisely since September 12, 1956. The company, known for its Garda Oto motor vehicle insurance products, serves customers through a network of services spread across 28 branch offices, as well as service units and Garda Centers that continue developing. In addition to motor vehicle insurance, other products from Asuransi Astra are Garda Medika health insurance, mining industry insurance, agribusiness industry insurance, shop insurance, gas station insurance, sharia insurance, and others.

Since 2015, Asuransi Astra has developed its products and services digitally and introduced Garda Mobile as a collection of mobile applications intended for retail, commercial and general customers. The four Garda Mobile applications namely Otocare, Medcare, HR-access, and CR-access are consistently updated through various innovations aimed at customer convenience and comfort. The latest innovation developed in the Garda Mobile Otocare with the presence of GarXia, the first insurance purchase chatbot in Indonesia that can also help customers in reporting claims and the Garda Mall feature that allows users to shop for a variety of automotive needs, Astra Financial financial products, also to buying and selling cars. Asuransi Astra also has four digital products namely Garda Me, Garda Edu, Garda Home, and Garda Trip which can be purchased easily and quickly through the gardaoto.com site.

Asuransi Astra performance has also been recognized with various awards that have been received, including: Platinum Indonesia Best Brand Award (2002-2019), Top Brand Award (2007-2019), Service Quality Award (2007-2018), Corporate Image Award ( 2007-2019), Indonesian Customer Satisfaction Award (2001-2017), Indonesia Original Brand Award (2017-2019), General Insurance with very good financial performance in the Infobank Insurance Award (2008-2016, 2019), Excellent Service Experience Award (2013 -2020), Contact Center Service Excellence Award (2013-2020), Social Media Award (2012, 2016), Indonesia Sharia Finance Award (2017), Insurance Award (2017-2018), Insurance Consumer Choice Award (2017-2018), Asian Brands (2018), Marketing Award (2018), Indonesia Digital Innovation Award (2018), Markeeter of the Year (2018-2019), Infobrand Mobile Application Choice (2018), Marketeers Editor Choice Award (2018-2019), Indonesia Insurance Innovation Award (2019), Indonesia Digital Popular Brand Award (20 19), and others.

With the support of branches and workshops that are spread all over Indonesia, along with the best services and a series of achievements, certainly not stopping the steps of Asuransi Astra innovation through products that are built from the new spirit of Asuransi Astra to always provide comfort and peace for every customer. Therefore, Asuransi Astra will invest time and effort so that you always smile. "Peace of Mind to Millions" is the result that Asuransi Astra will provide to each customer.

company.description:
Asuransi Astra has been serving customers for more than half a century, precisely since September 12, 1956. The company, known for its Garda Oto motor vehicle insurance products, serves customers through a network of services spread across 28 branch offices, as well as service units and Garda Centers that continue developing. In addition to motor vehicle insurance, other products from Asuransi Astra are Garda Medika health insurance, mining industry insurance, agribusiness industry insurance, shop insurance, gas station insurance, sharia insurance, and others.

Since 2015, Asuransi Astra has developed its products and services digitally and introduced Garda Mobile as a collection of mobile applications intended for retail, commercial and general customers. description:
About The Role

As our Astronaut, your missions are:
As a customer insight Associate, your task is to extracts and analyzes qualitative and quantitative customer data to uncover operational friction, complaints behaviour, and actionable trends across customer touchpoints to increases ASTRO customer experience.

- VoC Program Management: Synthesize Voice of Customer (VoC) data from multi-channel surveys, social sentiment, and chat logs across core metrics (CSAT, CES, First Contact Resolution).
- Root-Cause & Funnel Analysis: Perform deep-dive analytics to isolate user pain points, purchase drop-offs, and order cancellation drivers using quantitative metrics cross-referenced with qualitative feedback.
- Dashboard Design & Reporting: Build and maintain automated, interactive dashboards for department heads and product leads to monitor customer friction points in real time.
- Insight-to-Action Strategy: Translate customer complaint data into narrative presentations with actionable recommendations for Product, Marketing, and Operations teams to boost customer retention.

qualifications:

In order to launch the missions successfully, you need to have:

  • Experience: 2 - 3 years in customer insights, business intelligence, or product analytics within customer-facing digital ecosystems.
  • Technical Stack: BI/Visualization tools (Looker Studio, Tableau, Power BI), Python/R for basic data manipulation and NLP sentiment analysis, and survey platforms (Qualtrics, Typeform, Sprinklr).
  • Analytical Methodologies: Proven experience using VoC metrics (NPS, CSAT, CES, FCR), cohort analysis, customer churn modeling, and funnel drop-off diagnostics.
  • Behavioral Competencies: Strong data storytelling (converting raw data into executive slides), customer-centric mindset, and business communication

company.description:
PT BCA Finance berdiri pada tahun 1981 dengan nama PT Central Sari Metropolitan Leasing Corporation (CSML). Pada awal berdirinya, pemegang saham Perusahaan adalah PT Bank Central Asia dan Japan Leasing Corporation. Saat itu Perusahaan masih memfokuskan usaha pada pembiayaan komersial, seperti pembiayaan mesin-mesin produksi, alat berat dan transportasi.

Selanjutnya pada tahun 2001 PT Central Sari Metropolitan Leasing berubah nama menjadi PT Central Sari Finance (CSF), diikuti dengan perubahan kepemilikan saham, dimana PT Bank Central Asia, Tbk (BCA) menjadi pemegang saham mayoritas, serta perubahan fokus usaha menjadi pembiayaan kendaraan bermotor, khususnya roda empat atau lebih. Terakhir, Sesuai dengan Surat Keputusan Menteri Hukum dan Hak Asasi Manusia Republik Indonesia No.C-08091 HT.01.04.TH.2005, maka per tanggal 28 Maret 2005 PT Central Sari Finance telah berubah nama menjadi PT BCA Finance.

Kini BCA Finance sendiri telah berhasil mencatatkan asset kelolaan sebesar 52 T dengan profit 1,6 T. company_info.description:
PT BCA Finance berdiri pada tahun 1981 dengan nama PT Central Sari Metropolitan Leasing Corporation (CSML). Pada awal berdirinya, pemegang saham Perusahaan adalah PT Bank Central Asia dan Japan Leasing Corporation. Saat itu Perusahaan masih memfokuskan usaha pada pembiayaan komersial, seperti pembiayaan mesin-mesin produksi, alat berat dan transportasi.

Selanjutnya pada tahun 2001 PT Central Sari Metropolitan Leasing berubah nama menjadi PT Central Sari Finance (CSF), diikuti dengan perubahan kepemilikan saham, dimana PT Bank Central Asia, Tbk (BCA) menjadi pemegang saham mayoritas, serta perubahan fokus usaha menjadi pembiayaan kendaraan bermotor, khususnya roda empat atau lebih. Terakhir, Sesuai dengan Surat Keputusan Menteri Hukum dan Hak Asasi Manusia Republik Indonesia No.C-08091 HT.01.04.TH.2005, maka per tanggal 28 Maret 2005 PT Central Sari Finance telah berubah nama menjadi PT BCA Finance.

Kini BCA Finance sendiri telah berhasil mencatatkan asset kelolaan sebesar 52 T dengan profit 1,6 T. Dengan misinya untuk menjadi perusahaan terkemuka di industri pembiayaan PT BCA Finance senantiasa melakukan perubahan dan pengembangan model bisnis untuk menjawab tantangan dan kebutuhan zaman dimana hal ini sejalan dengan tag line perusahaan yaitu solusi tepat pembiayaan anda.

PT. Mandiri Jaya Konstruksi Nusantara adalah perusahaan kontraktor & Developer yang berdiri pada 11 Maret 2019 dengan dedikasi penuh pada penyediaan solusi konstruksi yang kokoh dan presisi. Sejak awal pendiriannya, perusahaan kami dibentuk untuk menjawab tantangan pembangunan infrastruktur dan properti yang kian kompleks dengan mengedepankan integritas struktural dan efisiensi teknis.

Kami memadukan pengalaman lapangan yang matang dengan manajemen proyek yang sistematis untuk memastikan setiap detail pekerjaan—mulai dari struktur bawah hingga penyelesaian akhir—memenuhi standar kualitas yang ketat. company.description:
Pandafood is a fast-growing snack manufacturing company from Indonesia, dedicated to bringing delicious and trusted products to consumers nationwide. Our journey began in 2015 as CV Panda Food, and in 2023 we took a major step forward by officially transforming into PT Pandafood Kreasi Indonesia. This transition marked a new chapter for us — one that focuses on expanding our reach and growing the business with a more professional and sustainable approach.

Our very first product was snack Panda Seaweed, which we introduced through souvenir stands, local shops, and modern retail stores around the Special Region of Yogyakarta. What started small quickly gained traction. Over time, our distribution network expanded to multiple regions across Indonesia, supported by a growing portfolio of brands and innovative snack products. Today, Pandafood is also a trusted private label partner for some of the country's leading modern retail chains.

At Pandafood, product quality and food safety always come first. All of our products are registered with BPOM MD license, certified Halal, and produced in facilities that meet HACCP standards. This reflects our strong commitment to maintaining high standards and earning consumer trust.

As we continue to grow, our focus remains clear: creating innovative products, strengthening our distribution network, and building meaningful partnerships. With a spirit of innovation, quality at the core, and a passion for delighting consumers, Pandafood is ready to make its mark as one of Indonesia's leading FMCG snack brands.

Are you an experienced leader who thrives in managing large teams and navigating a fast-paced operational environment? Do you have strong analytical skills, excellent communication abilities, and the versatility to work across different teams, systems, and client needs? If you're a proactive leader who enjoys tackling new challenges, driving operational performance, and building strong client relationships in an international environment, we'd love to hear from you.

We are looking for a Fare Loader Senior Supervisor to lead day-to-day operations for our overseas clients. Reporting to the Manager, you'll oversee a team of 50+ members through Team Leaders, ensuring operational targets and client SLAs are met while fostering team engagement, strengthening client relationships, and driving continuous improvement.

Is This You?

  • Oversee daily fare loading operations to ensure accurate and timely loading, updating, and maintenance of fare data in accordance with client requirements, operational procedures, and service-level agreements (SLAs).
  • Lead and support Team Leaders in managing daily workloads, team productivity, quality standards, and employee performance and development.
  • Monitor operational performance and data accuracy, including productivity, turnaround time, error rates, and SLA achievement, and implement corrective actions where needed.
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex fare loading issues, data discrepancies, system-related challenges, and service delivery concerns, ensuring timely investigation and resolution.
  • Support the Operations Manager in client communication, operational reporting, performance reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency by reviewing workflows, strengthening quality controls, and ensuring consistent adherence to client-specific procedures.
  • Maintain team engagement and service consistency through effective communication, coaching, and coordination across the operation.

  • Minimum 2 years of leadership or supervisory experience, preferably managing large teams through Team Leaders or frontline supervisors.

  • Fluent in English, with a minimum proficiency level of CEFR C1.

  • Adaptable and versatile, with the ability to manage competing priorities and respond effectively to changing operational and client requirements.

  • Willingness to work at both Central Jakarta and BSD City, as required by operational needs.

About The Role

This role will act as the central intelligence and quality engine of the Contact Center. This role is responsible for driving continuous improvement across customer operations by integrating workforce optimization, frontline quality governance, and data-driven customer insights

As our Astronaut, your missions are:

  • Pillar Management & Team Integration: Direct and align three core sub-functions: QA & Training, Customer Insight, and WFM.
  • Ensuring data from Insights informs QA rubrics/Training curriculum, while WFM staffing aligns with complaint volume trends.
  • Complaint Rate Reduction (Internal CX): Design and execute internal operational initiatives that directly lower contact and complaint rates by optimizing agent workflows, updating knowledge bases, improving First Contact Resolution (FCR), and targeting quality coaching.
  • System & Process Redesign (External CX): Partner with cross-functional stakeholders (Product, Tech, Operations, Marketing) to eliminate systemic complaint drivers, resolving upstream product bugs, policy friction, and fulfillment delays.
  • Root Cause Analysis (RCA) Governance: Establish structured RCA frameworks (5 Whys, Fishbone, FMEA) using insight analytics and QA escalations to isolate recurring failure points across the end-to-end customer journey.
  • Project Management & ROI Tracking: Own the project lifecycle for CX improvement workstreams, defining success metrics (e.g., % reduction in complaint volume, CSAT lift, ticket deflection) and presenting progress to CX leadership.

company.description:
PT BCA Finance berdiri pada tahun 1981 dengan nama PT Central Sari Metropolitan Leasing Corporation (CSML). Pada awal berdirinya, pemegang saham Perusahaan adalah PT Bank Central Asia dan Japan Leasing Corporation. Saat itu Perusahaan masih memfokuskan usaha pada pembiayaan komersial, seperti pembiayaan mesin-mesin produksi, alat berat dan transportasi.

Selanjutnya pada tahun 2001 PT Central Sari Metropolitan Leasing berubah nama menjadi PT Central Sari Finance (CSF), diikuti dengan perubahan kepemilikan saham, dimana PT Bank Central Asia, Tbk (BCA) menjadi pemegang saham mayoritas, serta perubahan fokus usaha menjadi pembiayaan kendaraan bermotor, khususnya roda empat atau lebih. Terakhir, Sesuai dengan Surat Keputusan Menteri Hukum dan Hak Asasi Manusia Republik Indonesia No.C-08091 HT.01.04.TH.2005, maka per tanggal 28 Maret 2005 PT Central Sari Finance telah berubah nama menjadi PT BCA Finance.

Kini BCA Finance sendiri telah berhasil mencatatkan asset kelolaan sebesar 52 T dengan profit 1,6 T. Dengan misinya untuk menjadi perusahaan terkemuka di industri pembiayaan PT BCA Finance senantiasa melakukan perubahan dan pengembangan model bisnis untuk menjawab tantangan dan kebutuhan zaman dimana hal ini sejalan dengan tag line perusahaan yaitu solusi tepat pembiayaan anda. 

Untuk mencapai hal tersebut PT BCA Finance memiliki nila-nilai perusahaan yang senantiasa diterapkan yaitu FOCUS yang terdiri dari:

First Class Teamwork
Orientation to Quality
Customer Focus
Uncompromise Integrity
Striving for Excellence

Melalui FOCUS ini seluruh karyawan diarahkan untuk memiliki budaya kerja yang sama sehingga tercipta sebuah Tim yang solid dalam menjalankan bisnis.

Untuk SDM sendiri selain penanaman budaya perusahaan BCA Finance juga focus pada pengembangan skill dan karir karyawannya oleh karena itu kebutuhan pejabat di BCA Finance 90% diperoleh dari internal.

company.description:
EF EFEKTA English for Adults

EF - EXCELLENCE IN ENGLISH TRAINING

EF was founded in Sweden in 1965 with just one teacher and a big dream of "breaking down the barriers in language learning both regionally and culturally". Today, EF has become the world's best and largest provider of English language courses by offering language learning and certified courses to people of all ages with study abroad opportunities and cultural exchange programs. EF has been appointed five times as the provider of language training services and official education services for the Olympics (1988 in Seoul, 2008 in Beijing, 2014 in Sochi, 2016 in Rio and 2018 in Pyeongchang).

EF & INDONESIA

With more than 500 schools and offices in 53 countries, EF is the world's largest private educational institution. EF has been in Indonesia since 1986 and to this day we provide intensive training programs for adults and education for children by leveraging the latest technology to provide courses, both in schools and online 24 hours a day.

EF & OLYMPICS

EF consistently supports various sporting events in various parts of the world and makes it a medium to promote global unity, development and equality. We are proud to have been the official provider of language training and education services for five Olympiads.

EF & INTERNATIONAL COMPANIES

EF continues to provide English training services for more than 1,500 international companies worldwide in various industries for a wide variety of employees.

EF Foreign Tutor.

EF has a team of high-quality teaching professionals led by teachers mostly from English-speaking countries with TEFL or other professional certifications. Our teachers are thoroughly selected and rigorously trained so that they are able to apply EF's superior learning methods. Let's get to know our foreign teachers better!

About this Position

As a Quality Control Senior Supervisor, you will lead the end-to-end QC function for Fresh categories (fruits, vegetables, eggs, dairy, frozen products, etc.) within the warehouse. This role is responsible for ensuring product quality standards are maintained from inbound to outbound, minimizing waste, and ensuring compliance with product specifications and temperature handling standards.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee inbound QC processes (verify, assess, investigate) to determine product acceptance or rejection based on quality standards.
  • Conduct stock screening in storage areas to identify near-expiry products and define appropriate action plans.
  • Ensure proper temperature handling across all stages (inbound, storage, outbound).
  • Collaborate with Category Management regarding product specification discrepancies and negotiate when necessary.
  • Manage over-commitment issues with vendors (size, weight, or specification mismatches).
  • Analyze waste across all operational stages and implement improvement initiatives to reduce shrinkage.
  • Lead and supervise QC team members (±20 direct reports; ±45 total QC staff in warehouse).
  • Collect, validate, and process quality data for reporting and decision-making purposes.

  • Hands-on experience managing fresh and frozen products including fruits, vegetables, eggs, dairy, and frozen food.

description:
Bertanggung jawab merancang, mengimplementasikan, dan memelihara sistem storage dan backup perusahaan untuk memastikan ketersediaan, keandalan, dan keamanan data.

Tanggung Jawab Utama

- Melakukan instalasi, konfigurasi, dan maintenance perangkat storage (SAN/NAS) dan sistem backup.

- Merancang dan mengelola strategi backup & recovery (backup policy, retention, disaster recovery).

- Melakukan monitoring kapasitas, performa, dan kesehatan storage secara berkala.

- Melakukan troubleshooting terhadap isu storage, replikasi data, dan proses backup/restore.

- Melakukan uji coba disaster recovery (DR test) dan restore data secara berkala.

- Melakukan capacity planning dan memberikan rekomendasi upgrade/optimasi storage.

- Menyusun dan memperbarui dokumentasi teknis (SOP, diagram arsitektur storage & backup).

- Berkoordinasi dengan tim system/infrastruktur terkait integrasi storage dengan server/virtualisasi.

address_components.address_line_1: 8, RT08/RW17, Jalan Pangeran Tubagus Angke, Pejagalan Kel., Penjaringan

name: System Engineer – Storage & Backup
qualifications:
- Pendidikan minimal S1 Teknik Informatika, Sistem Informasi, atau bidang terkait.

- Pengalaman minimal 2–4 tahun menangani sistem storage dan backup.

- Berpengalaman dengan perangkat storage (Dell EMC, NetApp, HPE, Hitachi, IBM, atau setara).

- Berpengalaman dengan solusi backup (Veeam, Commvault, Veritas NetBackup, Acronis, atau setara).

- Memahami konsep SAN/NAS, RAID, replikasi data, dan protokol storage (iSCSI, Fibre Channel, NFS/SMB).

- Memahami konsep virtualisasi (VMware/Hyper-V) dan integrasinya dengan storage.

- Memahami prinsip disaster recovery dan business continuity planning.

- Memiliki sertifikasi vendor storage/backup (mis. NetApp NCDA, Dell EMC Proven, Veeam VMCE) menjadi nilai tambah.

- Teliti, analitis, dan mampu bekerja dengan SLA yang ketat.

- Bersedia bertugas on-call untuk penanganan insiden kritikal terkait data.

company.description:
PT BCA Finance berdiri pada tahun 1981 dengan nama PT Central Sari Metropolitan Leasing Corporation (CSML). Pada awal berdirinya, pemegang saham Perusahaan adalah PT Bank Central Asia dan Japan Leasing Corporation. Saat itu Perusahaan masih memfokuskan usaha pada pembiayaan komersial, seperti pembiayaan mesin-mesin produksi, alat berat dan transportasi.

Kini BCA Finance sendiri telah berhasil mencatatkan asset kelolaan sebesar 52 T dengan profit 1,6 T. As an Inventory Operations Associate, you’ll support the team in keeping inventory healthy and operations running smoothly. You’ll work with data to monitor stock movement, spot issues, and help the team find practical solutions.

As our Astronaut, your missions are:

  • Monitor inbound, capacity, and outbound performance and highlight any gaps.
  • Track inventory health, including DOI, bad stock, and stock movement.
  • Help analyze inventory issues and support initiatives to reduce bad stock.

  • Follow up on pending SO/PO and other inventory movements.
  • Support day-to-day inventory processes such as RTV, write-off, internal consumption, and backhaul.
  • Help with ad-hoc analysis and operational requests when needed.

company.description:
PT BCA Finance berdiri pada tahun 1981 dengan nama PT Central Sari Metropolitan Leasing Corporation (CSML). Pada awal berdirinya, pemegang saham Perusahaan adalah PT Bank Central Asia dan Japan Leasing Corporation. Saat itu Perusahaan masih memfokuskan usaha pada pembiayaan komersial, seperti pembiayaan mesin-mesin produksi, alat berat dan transportasi.

Selanjutnya pada tahun 2001 PT Central Sari Metropolitan Leasing berubah nama menjadi PT Central Sari Finance (CSF), diikuti dengan perubahan kepemilikan saham, dimana PT Bank Central Asia, Tbk (BCA) menjadi pemegang saham mayoritas, serta perubahan fokus usaha menjadi pembiayaan kendaraan bermotor, khususnya roda empat atau lebih. Terakhir, Sesuai dengan Surat Keputusan Menteri Hukum dan Hak Asasi Manusia Republik Indonesia No.C-08091 HT.01.04.TH.2005, maka per tanggal 28 Maret 2005 PT Central Sari Finance telah berubah nama menjadi PT BCA Finance.

Kini BCA Finance sendiri telah berhasil mencatatkan asset kelolaan sebesar 52 T dengan profit 1,6 T. Dengan misinya untuk menjadi perusahaan terkemuka di industri pembiayaan PT BCA Finance senantiasa melakukan perubahan dan pengembangan model bisnis untuk menjawab tantangan dan kebutuhan zaman dimana hal ini sejalan dengan tag line perusahaan yaitu solusi tepat pembiayaan anda. 

Untuk mencapai hal tersebut PT BCA Finance memiliki nila-nilai perusahaan yang senantiasa diterapkan yaitu FOCUS yang terdiri dari:

First Class Teamwork
Orientation to Quality
Customer Focus
Uncompromise Integrity
Striving for Excellence

Melalui FOCUS ini seluruh karyawan diarahkan untuk memiliki budaya kerja yang sama sehingga tercipta sebuah Tim yang solid dalam menjalankan bisnis.

Untuk SDM sendiri selain penanaman budaya perusahaan BCA Finance juga focus pada pengembangan skill dan karir karyawannya oleh karena itu kebutuhan pejabat di BCA Finance 90% diperoleh dari internal.

description:
About the Role

The Growth & Marketing Manager will drive WAHU’s growth across customer acquisition, marketing, retention, product, and market expansion.

You will work closely with HQ, city operations, product & tech teams, and external partners to turn customer insights and business opportunities into measurable initiatives.

This is a hands-on and entrepreneurial role — you will identify opportunities, build the strategy, execute projects, track results, and improve what works.

Key Responsibilities

1. Growth, Acquisition & Retention

  • Develop and execute strategies to grow WAHU’s collector base.
  • Own customer acquisition and performance marketing.
  • Optimise the customer journey from acquisition to conversion and retention.
  • Develop referral programmes, promotions, and growth campaigns.
  • Drive collector engagement, retention, and reactivation.
  • Track key growth metrics such as acquisition, conversion, and retention.
  • Use AppsFlyer and campaign data to identify opportunities and improve performance.

2. Brand Marketing & Communication

  • Develop and execute WAHU’s overall marketing and communication strategy.
  • Grow WAHU’s reach through social media, content, digital marketing, KOL/influencers, and paid advertising.
  • Manage online channels including TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, WhatsApp, website, and app stores.
  • Plan and execute offline marketing activities, including hub launches, community programmes, neighbourhood activations, and retail/partner activations.
  • Ensure consistent brand positioning, tone of voice, and communication across channels and languages.
  • Develop CRM campaigns through push notifications, in-app messaging, and WhatsApp.
  • Manage external marketing partners and agencies.

3. Product & App Development

  • Act as the business-side partner for WAHU’s app development and optimisation.
  • Identify product improvements based on collector feedback, data, and operational needs.
  • Translate business and customer needs into clear product requirements.
  • Help prioritise product improvements and new features.
  • Support app releases, updates, and communication of new functionality.

4. Team, Agencies & Budget

  • Lead the Social Media Manager and manage external online marketing and design agencies.
  • Set clear briefs, targets, budgets, and performance expectations for agencies.
  • Monitor quality and results and make improvements where needed.
  • Build the marketing team gradually as business volume and needs grow.

description:
As our Astronaut, your missions are:

  • Own AIRO engineering delivery. Design, build, release, and operate customer-facing AI capabilities across product discovery, supported cart and payment journeys, platform assistance, and post-purchase support, in partnership with the relevant service owners.
  • Discover and validate problems. Understand customer journeys through feedback, usage data, and execution traces; embed with business users to observe workflows and investigate bottlenecks, errors, repetitive tasks, and knowledge gaps.
  • Define value before building. Establish baselines, identify accountable stakeholders, prioritize opportunities, and agree on success measures, acceptance criteria, and experiment stop conditions.
  • Choose practical solutions. Compare process changes, existing tools, system integrations, custom software, data solutions, and AI against expected value, delivery effort, operating cost, and risk.
  • Build and deliver end to end. Write, review, test, and deploy production software across APIs, integrations, data flows, automation, and user interfaces as needed. Iterate through small releases and direct user feedback.
  • Apply AI to real workflows. Integrate approved models and shared AI capabilities; implement retrieval, tool use, structured outputs, and agent workflows where justified by the problem.
  • Evaluate quality and reliability. Define representative customer-journey and workflow evaluations, investigate failure modes, and implement appropriate access controls, confirmation, human escalation, fallback, and recovery behavior. Validate conversation context, factual grounding, and the correctness of actions across retries and partial failures.
  • Drive adoption and improve experience. Work with Product and Design on customer usability and task completion. For internal workflows, co-design with users, demonstrate progress, train users, and address adoption barriers.
  • Own production operation. Coordinate releases, monitor reliability, latency, AI quality, and cost, troubleshoot incidents, and continuously improve AIRO and assigned solutions. Establish ongoing ownership explicitly and transfer support only through an accepted handover.
  • Prove business impact. Compare results with the agreed baseline and recommend whether to scale, improve, transfer, or stop an initiative.
  • Make learning reusable. Document decisions, runbooks, integrations, and delivery patterns; share platform needs and reusable improvements with the relevant engineering owners.

name: Forward Deployed Engineer
qualifications:
In order to launch the missions successfully, you need to have:

  • 5+ years of experience in Backend Engineering or Software Engineering, with demonstrated senior-level ownership of production-grade systems. Prior experience in an FDE role is not required.
  • Strong proficiency in at least one backend programming language such as Go, Java, Kotlin, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript with Node.js, with the ability to adapt to the team’s stack.
  • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices, databases, distributed systems, and system design, including experience designing and developing scalable, highly available backend services.
  • Solid understanding of software engineering principles, clean code, testing, version control, and CI/CD practices.
  • Experience working with cloud infrastructure and modern engineering tools and processes.
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills in production environments, including monitoring, incident resolution, and continuous improvement of performance and reliability.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently own a product capability or solution from problem discovery and technical design through implementation, deployment, and ongoing production improvement.
  • Hands-on experience building and evaluating LLM-powered applications or workflows, with an understanding of model limitations, failure handling, and quality, latency, and cost trade-offs. No fixed number of years in AI or FDE roles is required.
  • Ability to translate customer needs into reliable product experiences and assess usability, task completion, correctness, and performance, supporting ownership of AIRO, Astro’s customer-facing AI.
  • Ability to work directly with business users, identify root causes, clarify ambiguous requirements, and choose practical solutions across process improvement, software, data, and AI.
  • Strong cross-functional communication with Product, QA, Frontend, Data, and business stakeholders, including the ability to explain technical trade-offs, constructively challenge assumptions, and align priorities and scope.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with evolving requirements and tight delivery timelines, prioritizing work and making sound trade-offs between speed, quality, and scope.
  • Ability to define success criteria and use data and feedback to evaluate customer outcomes, adoption, and business impact.
  • Sound judgment about security, access permissions, sensitive data, and the consequences of automated actions.

About this Position

We are looking for a Dry Inventory Senior Supervisor who will be responsible for leading daily dry warehouse operations, ensuring inventory accuracy and flow, optimizing manpower productivity, and maintaining high standards of operational quality, safety, and service level.

Job Description

As our Astronaut, your missions are:

  • Lead and supervise daily warehouse operations, ensuring inventory activities are executed accurately and efficiently.
  • Oversee inbound, picking, packing, inventory, and outbound activities to ensure operational targets are achieved.
  • Monitor inventory accuracy, picking accuracy, packing correctness, storage order, and loading readiness.
  • Ensure smooth inventory flow and proactively resolve operational issues such as mispicks, missing items, and other inventory discrepancies.
  • Evaluate operational workflows and identify opportunities to improve manpower productivity, inventory accuracy, and service level.
  • Manage shift scheduling, manpower allocation, attendance, shift rotation, and backup planning to ensure sufficient manpower coverage.
  • Delegate tasks and monitor team performance to ensure execution meets quality and productivity targets.
  • Conduct daily operational reporting aligned with key KPIs, including output, errors, incidents, and attendance.
  • Collaborate with Supply Chain and Category teams to resolve operational issues and support inventory forecasting.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across inventory flow and accuracy.
  • Ensure compliance with SOP, health, hygiene, safety, security, and 5S standards.
  • Maintain operational discipline and ensure the team consistently follows established warehouse procedures.

qualifications:
Job Requirements

In order to launch the missions successfully, you need to have:

  • Minimum Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant educational background.
  • Minimum 4–5 years of experience in warehousing or logistics operations.
  • At least 2 years of experience at Supervisor level, with a minimum of 1 year at SPV level.
  • Proven experience managing inventory accuracy and inventory flow in warehouse operations.
  • Strong understanding of inventory management, including inventory control and accuracy.

Kami memadukan pengalaman lapangan yang matang dengan manajemen proyek yang sistematis untuk memastikan setiap detail pekerjaan—mulai dari struktur bawah hingga penyelesaian akhir—memenuhi standar kualitas yang ketat. Ketangguhan Teknis: Kami menggunakan standar material dan teknik konstruksi terkini untuk menjamin daya tahan bangunan jangka panjang.
Ketepatan Waktu: Kami menghargai nilai investasi Anda dengan sistem manajemen jadwal yang disiplin dan transparan.
Profesionalisme: Didukung oleh tim ahli yang berkompeten, kami memastikan setiap tahap pengerjaan berjalan sesuai dengan regulasi teknis dan standar keamanan kerja.
Integritas: Membangun kepercayaan melalui transparansi biaya, material, dan progres pengerjaan yang dapat dipertanggungjawabkan.
Visi Kami: Menjadi mitra konstruksi terdepan di Indonesia yang dikenal karena kualitas bangunan yang tangguh, inovasi teknis, dan kontribusi nyata dalam pembangunan nasional.

company.description:
Ever since it was established in 1957, Bank Central Asia (BCA) has continued to grow. This has been the result of the dedicated teamwork of every single one of our employees and the unflagging support of our customers. In line with our commitment to be “Always by Your Side”, BCA will continue to strive to earn the trust, and live up to the expectations, of all the Bank’s customers and other stakeholders in its drive to continue to achieve ongoing growth.

From the beginning, BCA has always offered diverse financial solutions through banking transaction services for many diverse groups and ages. And now everyone can enjoy the banking transaction ease and convenience BCA offers, enabled by strong inter-branch links, an extensive ATM network, and all the other electronic banking services the Bank offers.

Through the extensive range of well-targeted, high quality products and services the Bank provides, BCA’s financial solutions have proven they encourage the business growth of all the Bank’s customers, whether small, medium-sized, or large-scale businesses. For BCA, earning customers’ trust through offering them the best solutions to meet their financial needs is an honor and a source of pride.

By living our slogan, “Always by Your Side”, BCA will continue to strive to provide all its customers with only the very best services and solutions.

company.description:
Pandafood is a fast-growing snack manufacturing company from Indonesia, dedicated to bringing delicious and trusted products to consumers nationwide. Our journey began in 2015 as CV Panda Food, and in 2023 we took a major step forward by officially transforming into PT Pandafood Kreasi Indonesia. This transition marked a new chapter for us — one that focuses on expanding our reach and growing the business with a more professional and sustainable approach.

Our very first product was snack Panda Seaweed, which we introduced through souvenir stands, local shops, and modern retail stores around the Special Region of Yogyakarta. What started small quickly gained traction. Over time, our distribution network expanded to multiple regions across Indonesia, supported by a growing portfolio of brands and innovative snack products. Today, Pandafood is also a trusted private label partner for some of the country's leading modern retail chains.

At Pandafood, product quality and food safety always come first. All of our products are registered with BPOM MD license, certified Halal, and produced in facilities that meet HACCP standards. This reflects our strong commitment to maintaining high standards and earning consumer trust.

As we continue to grow, our focus remains clear: creating innovative products, strengthening our distribution network, and building meaningful partnerships. With a spirit of innovation, quality at the core, and a passion for delighting consumers, Pandafood is ready to make its mark as one of Indonesia's leading FMCG snack brands.

company.description:
Pandafood is a fast-growing snack manufacturing company from Indonesia, dedicated to bringing delicious and trusted products to consumers nationwide. Our journey began in 2015 as CV Panda Food, and in 2023 we took a major step forward by officially transforming into PT Pandafood Kreasi Indonesia. This transition marked a new chapter for us — one that focuses on expanding our reach and growing the business with a more professional and sustainable approach.

Our very first product was snack Panda Seaweed, which we introduced through souvenir stands, local shops, and modern retail stores around the Special Region of Yogyakarta. What started small quickly gained traction. Over time, our distribution network expanded to multiple regions across Indonesia, supported by a growing portfolio of brands and innovative snack products. Today, Pandafood is also a trusted private label partner for some of the country's leading modern retail chains.

At Pandafood, product quality and food safety always come first. All of our products are registered with BPOM MD license, certified Halal, and produced in facilities that meet HACCP standards. This reflects our strong commitment to maintaining high standards and earning consumer trust.

As we continue to grow, our focus remains clear: creating innovative products, strengthening our distribution network, and building meaningful partnerships. With a spirit of innovation, quality at the core, and a passion for delighting consumers, Pandafood is ready to make its mark as one of Indonesia's leading FMCG snack brands.

company.description:
EF EFEKTA English for Adults

EF - EXCELLENCE IN ENGLISH TRAINING

EF was founded in Sweden in 1965 with just one teacher and a big dream of "breaking down the barriers in language learning both regionally and culturally". Today, EF has become the world's best and largest provider of English language courses by offering language learning and certified courses to people of all ages with study abroad opportunities and cultural exchange programs. EF has been appointed five times as the provider of language training services and official education services for the Olympics (1988 in Seoul, 2008 in Beijing, 2014 in Sochi, 2016 in Rio and 2018 in Pyeongchang).

EF & INDONESIA

With more than 500 schools and offices in 53 countries, EF is the world's largest private educational institution. EF has been in Indonesia since 1986 and to this day we provide intensive training programs for adults and education for children by leveraging the latest technology to provide courses, both in schools and online 24 hours a day.

EF & OLYMPICS

EF consistently supports various sporting events in various parts of the world and makes it a medium to promote global unity, development and equality. We are proud to have been the official provider of language training and education services for five Olympiads.

EF & INTERNATIONAL COMPANIES

EF continues to provide English training services for more than 1,500 international companies worldwide in various industries for a wide variety of employees.

EF Foreign Tutor.

EF has a team of high-quality teaching professionals led by teachers mostly from English-speaking countries with TEFL or other professional certifications. Our teachers are thoroughly selected and rigorously trained so that they are able to apply EF's superior learning methods. Let's get to know our foreign teachers better!

company.description:
PT BCA Finance berdiri pada tahun 1981 dengan nama PT Central Sari Metropolitan Leasing Corporation (CSML). Pada awal berdirinya, pemegang saham Perusahaan adalah PT Bank Central Asia dan Japan Leasing Corporation. Saat itu Perusahaan masih memfokuskan usaha pada pembiayaan komersial, seperti pembiayaan mesin-mesin produksi, alat berat dan transportasi.

Selanjutnya pada tahun 2001 PT Central Sari Metropolitan Leasing berubah nama menjadi PT Central Sari Finance (CSF), diikuti dengan perubahan kepemilikan saham, dimana PT Bank Central Asia, Tbk (BCA) menjadi pemegang saham mayoritas, serta perubahan fokus usaha menjadi pembiayaan kendaraan bermotor, khususnya roda empat atau lebih. Terakhir, Sesuai dengan Surat Keputusan Menteri Hukum dan Hak Asasi Manusia Republik Indonesia No.C-08091 HT.01.04.TH.2005, maka per tanggal 28 Maret 2005 PT Central Sari Finance telah berubah nama menjadi PT BCA Finance.

Kini BCA Finance sendiri telah berhasil mencatatkan asset kelolaan sebesar 52 T dengan profit 1,6 T. Dengan misinya untuk menjadi perusahaan terkemuka di industri pembiayaan PT BCA Finance senantiasa melakukan perubahan dan pengembangan model bisnis untuk menjawab tantangan dan kebutuhan zaman dimana hal ini sejalan dengan tag line perusahaan yaitu solusi tepat pembiayaan anda. 

Untuk mencapai hal tersebut PT BCA Finance memiliki nila-nilai perusahaan yang senantiasa diterapkan yaitu FOCUS yang terdiri dari:

First Class Teamwork
Orientation to Quality
Customer Focus
Uncompromise Integrity
Striving for Excellence

Melalui FOCUS ini seluruh karyawan diarahkan untuk memiliki budaya kerja yang sama sehingga tercipta sebuah Tim yang solid dalam menjalankan bisnis.

Untuk SDM sendiri selain penanaman budaya perusahaan BCA Finance juga focus pada pengembangan skill dan karir karyawannya oleh karena itu kebutuhan pejabat di BCA Finance 90% diperoleh dari internal.

company.description:
OCBC Indonesia (formerly known as OCBC NISP) is the fourth oldest bank in Indonesia, which was founded in April 4th 1941 in Bandung under the name of NV Nederlandsch Indische Spaar En Deposito Bank.

OCBC Indonesia then grown to be a solid and dependable bank, especially in providing service for small business segments. It officially became a commercial bank in 1967, Foreign exchange bank in 1990 and public corporate in Indonesia Stock Exchange in 1994.

In the end of 1990, OCBC Indonesia managed to pass the Asia monetary crisis and the fall of banking industry without any recapitalization obligation aid from the government. OCBC Indonesia became one of the first few banks to resume lending during the crisis. This initiative enabled the Bank to note a high growth.

OCBC Indonesia good reputation and its promising growth has attracted the interest of International Finance Corporation (IFC), a part of World Bank Group, which then became a shareholder in 2001-2010 and from OCBC Singapore which then became the shareholder OCBC Indonesia. 

With the support from OCBC Bank-Singapore, OCBC Indonesia has implemented aggressive programmes to strengthen the infrastructure, human resources, information and technology, as well as office networking.

PT Bank OCBC NISP, Tbk is licensed and supervised by the Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) and is an LPS participant.

description:
About the Role

We are looking for IT Procurement professionals across multiple capability levels, from Junior/Associate to Expert/Advisor, to support end-to-end procurement activities for IT and technology projects.

The role covers the full procurement lifecycle, including RFQ/RFP preparation, vendor sourcing, vendor comparison and evaluation, technical and commercial evaluation, TCO analysis, negotiation, contracting support, PO/procurement tracking, vendor management, reporting, strategic sourcing, category strategy, and procurement advisory.

Candidates may contribute at different levels, from hands-on procurement administration and operational support to strategic sourcing, negotiation, procurement governance, category strategy, and strategic procurement advisory. The position and level (L1–L5) will be determined based on the candidate's experience, capability, depth of IT/Technology Procurement expertise, and scope of responsibility.

Key Responsibilities

  • Depending on the assigned level, responsibilities may include:
  • Prepare and administer RFQ/RFP processes for IT and technology requirements.
  • Identify, source, and manage potential vendors.
  • Collect and maintain vendor data, documentation, quotations, and procurement records.
  • Conduct vendor comparison and evaluation, including technical and commercial aspects.
  • Perform commercial evaluation and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analysis.
  • Develop sourcing strategies and procurement approaches for IT projects.
  • Conduct vendor assessment and due diligence.
  • Lead or support commercial negotiations with vendors.
  • Support contract preparation, review, and negotiation processes.
  • Monitor and track Purchase Orders (PO), procurement status, and delivery milestones.
  • Manage vendor relationships and performance.
  • Prepare procurement reports, analysis, and management updates.
  • Manage procurement-related stakeholder communication and escalation.
  • Provide strategic procurement insights, benchmarking, and category strategy where applicable.

Capability Levels

L1 – Junior / Associate

  • RFQ/RFP administration
  • Vendor data and documentation management
  • PO and procurement tracking
  • Procurement reporting and administrative support

L2 – Professional / Specialist

  • RFP preparation
  • Vendor sourcing and comparison
  • Technical and commercial evaluation
  • TCO analysis
  • Procurement analysis and recommendation

L3 – Senior Specialist

  • Sourcing strategy
  • Vendor assessment and selection
  • Commercial negotiation
  • End-to-end management of more complex IT procurement projects
  • Stakeholder coordination

L4 – Manager / Lead

  • IT procurement strategy
  • Procurement governance and process management
  • Stakeholder management
  • Escalation management
  • Strategic negotiation and contracting
  • Leadership of procurement activities and teams

L5 – Expert / Advisor

  • IT category strategy
  • Strategic sourcing
  • Industry benchmarking and market insight
  • Strategic procurement advisory
  • Complex procurement and commercial strategy

description:
Analisis Kebutuhan dan Peluang Layanan Utilitas

  • Mengumpulkan data kebutuhan utilitas tenant untuk berbagai jenis layanan utilitas kawasan.

  • Mengidentifikasi peluang pengembangan layanan utilitas baru atau penguatan layanan yang sudah ada.

  • Menganalisis kesesuaian kebutuhan tenant dengan potensi pengembangan bisnis utilitas kawasan.

Pengembangan Skema Bisnis Utilitas

  • Menyusun konsep awal skema bisnis layanan utilitas berdasarkan kebutuhan tenant dan arah pengembangan kawasan.

  • Mengkaji alternatif model layanan, skema kerja sama, dan potensi monetisasi masing-masing layanan utilitas.

  • Menyiapkan bahan analisis untuk penyempurnaan skema bisnis utilitas kawasan.

Penyusunan Model Bisnis dan Kajian Finansial Awal

  • Mengumpulkan data dasar biaya, asumsi CAPEX, OPEX, dan proyeksi pendapatan layanan utilitas.

  • Menyusun perhitungan awal model bisnis, cost recovery, dan potensi revenue sharing.

  • Menganalisis kelayakan awal model bisnis utilitas untuk bahan evaluasi atasan.

Dukungan Feasibility Study Utilitas

  • Menyiapkan data pasar, kebutuhan tenant, serta asumsi komersial untuk studi kelayakan.

  • Melakukan analisis awal terhadap aspek bisnis, pasar, dan potensi komersial pengembangan utilitas.

  • Menyusun bahan rekomendasi untuk penilaian kelayakan investasi utilitas.

Proyeksi Kebutuhan Utilitas Tenant

  • Mengumpulkan data pemakaian dan kebutuhan utilitas tenant untuk jangka pendek, menengah, dan panjang.

  • Mengolah data proyeksi kebutuhan utilitas sebagai dasar perencanaan komersial.

  • Menyelaraskan hasil proyeksi dengan potensi pertumbuhan tenant dan kawasan.

Monetisasi dan Pengembangan Produk Layanan

  • Mengidentifikasi peluang monetisasi dari layanan utilitas yang tersedia.

  • Menyusun usulan pengembangan produk atau skema layanan untuk meningkatkan penetrasi ke tenant.

  • Memantau perkembangan pipeline peluang bisnis utilitas dan tindak lanjutnya.

Pelaporan dan Dokumentasi Bisnis Utilitas

  • Menyusun laporan hasil analisis peluang bisnis dan kebutuhan tenant.

  • Mendokumentasikan draf model bisnis, proyeksi, dan kajian awal yang telah disusun.

  • Menyampaikan laporan untuk kebutuhan evaluasi dan pengambilan keputusan atasan.

Manajemen dan Mitigasi Risiko

  • Melakukan identifikasi, pengelolaan, pelaporan, kontrol, dan evaluasi mitigasi risiko secara berkala dengan memperhatikan target dan kebijakan risiko sesuai alur proses bisnis dan faktornya, serta memperhatikan aspek risiko dalam setiap keputusan dan ikut dalam program pengembangan budaya risiko.

company.description:
PT Kliring Penjaminan Efek Indonesia (KPEI) was established in 1996 as a Clearing and Guarantee
Institution or Central Counterparty (CCP) for the Indonesian capital market. In accordance with Law
No. 8 of 1995 on Capital Market, the Government of the Republic of Indonesia designated KPEI as
part of the Self-Regulatory Organization (SRO) of the Indonesian capital market, together with PT
Bursa Efek Indonesia (IDX) and PT Kustodian Sentral Efek Indonesia (KSEI). 

As an entity, KPEI’s line of business is to organize clearing of securities exchange transaction and
regulated over-thecounter (OTC) transactions as well as securities exchange settlement guarantee.
The development of industry and economy has enabled KPEI to expand its business activities by
conducting other financial supporting services, with the approval of the Financial Services Authority
(FSA) and in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. The year 2020 marked another
milestone of KPEI as it expanded its role as central counterparty (CCP) of the OTC Derivative market
in order to support the Government’s program to develop and integrity, efficient, and transparent
money market.

company.description:
PT Kliring Penjaminan Efek Indonesia (KPEI) was established in 1996 as a Clearing and Guarantee
Institution or Central Counterparty (CCP) for the Indonesian capital market. In accordance with Law
No. 8 of 1995 on Capital Market, the Government of the Republic of Indonesia designated KPEI as
part of the Self-Regulatory Organization (SRO) of the Indonesian capital market, together with PT
Bursa Efek Indonesia (IDX) and PT Kustodian Sentral Efek Indonesia (KSEI). 

As an entity, KPEI’s line of business is to organize clearing of securities exchange transaction and
regulated over-thecounter (OTC) transactions as well as securities exchange settlement guarantee.
The development of industry and economy has enabled KPEI to expand its business activities by
conducting other financial supporting services, with the approval of the Financial Services Authority
(FSA) and in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. The year 2020 marked another
milestone of KPEI as it expanded its role as central counterparty (CCP) of the OTC Derivative market
in order to support the Government’s program to develop and integrity, efficient, and transparent
money market.

Ruangguru merupakan perusahaan teknologi terbesar dan terlengkap di Indonesia yang berfokus pada layanan berbasis pendidikan dan telah memiliki lebih dari 13 juta pengguna serta telah mengelola lebih dari 500.000 guru yang menawarkan jasa di lebih dari 100 bidang pelajaran. Perusahaan ini didirikan sejak tahun 2014 oleh Belva Devara dan Iman Usman, yang keduanya berhasil masuk dalam jajaran pengusaha sukses dibawah 30 tahun melalui Forbes 30 under 30 untuk teknologi konsumen di Asia.

Ruangguru berkomitmen untuk menjadi mitra bagi pemerintah daerah demi memberikan pendidikan berkualitas melalui Sistem Manajemen Belajar (LMS). Tahun lalu, Ruangguru berhasil bekerja sama dengan 32 (dari 34) pemerintah provinsi dan lebih dari 326 pemerintah kota dan kabupaten di Indonesia. Selain itu, Ruangguru juga menawarkan video belajar berlangganan, marketplace les privat, layanan bimbingan belajar on-demand, tryout ujian online, dan lain-lain.

description:
Job Description

  • Project Lifecycle Management: Lead project teams through planning, initiation, execution, and closure to ensure project objectives are met within approved scope, timelines, and budgets while maintaining high quality.
  • Planning & Documentation: Prepare comprehensive project plans (Project Management Plan, WBS, Schedule), handle technical/functional documentation, and deliver regular weekly and monthly status reports.
  • Stakeholder Management: Maintain proactive communication and coordination with sponsors, steering committees, and key stakeholders to align project expectations.
  • Risk & Issue Management: Identify, analyze, and mitigate project risks (Risk & Issue Register Management) while managing technical incidents and field challenges.
  • Change Management: Control project scope changes (Change Request Management) and evaluate their impact on cost, schedule, and resource allocation.
  • Team & Vendor Coordination: Manage the allocation and performance of cross-functional project teams (System Analysts, Developers, QA, DevOps) alongside third-party vendors.
  • Testing & Handover: Oversee testing phases (UAT, Performance Testing, Security Hardening) up to the official handover, formal acceptance (BAST), and transition to the operational team.
name: Project Manager
qualifications:
Qualifications

1. Educational Background & Certifications:

  • Minimum Bachelor’s Degree (S1) in Informatics Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or IT Management.
  • Professional Project Management certifications (PMP, CAPM, PMI-ACP, CSM, or PSM I) are a strong plus.

2. Experience & Technical Skills:

  • Proven experience leading software implementation or development projects within financial services (banking & insurance) or government institutions.
  • In-depth understanding of the System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) using both Waterfall and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Prior experience or strong familiarity acting as a Scrum Master / Agile Project Manager is preferred.
  • Proficient in enterprise project management tools (Jira, Confluence, MS Project, Trello, Asana).
  • Knowledgeable in IT procurement governance and financial/government data compliance regulations (OJK, BI, Dukcapil).

3. Soft Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong interpersonal skills with a proven track record of engaging clients from government agencies and the financial sector (Banking & Insurance).
  • Excellent lobbying, negotiation, persuasion, coaching, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Strong leadership qualities, capable of providing clear direction and keeping teams motivated under pressure.
  • Skilled in stakeholder expectation management and crisis communication.

4. Language Proficiency:

  • Good proficiency in spoken and written English, including the ability to compile executive reports and deliver C-level presentations.

description:
Perencanaan Kebutuhan Daya dan Kapasitas

  • Mengumpulkan data kebutuhan daya tenant dan operasional kawasan.

  • Melakukan analisis beban listrik dan kebutuhan kapasitas sistem kelistrikan.

  • Menyusun proyeksi kebutuhan daya sebagai dasar perencanaan teknis.

Perencanaan Maintenance Sistem Kelistrikan

  • Menyusun rencana dan jadwal preventive maintenance fasilitas kelistrikan.

  • Mengidentifikasi prioritas pemeliharaan berdasarkan kondisi dan criticality peralatan.

  • Mengoordinasikan rencana maintenance dengan unit operasional terkait.

Analisis Kinerja Sistem Kelistrikan

  • Mengolah data performa sistem kelistrikan, gangguan, downtime, dan losses.

  • Menganalisis tren performa dan potensi penurunan keandalan sistem.

  • Menyusun rekomendasi teknis untuk peningkatan kinerja sistem.

Evaluasi Pengembangan Infrastruktur Listrik

  • Mengidentifikasi gap kapasitas dan kebutuhan pengembangan jaringan listrik.

  • Menyusun usulan teknis untuk peningkatan atau ekspansi infrastruktur listrik.

  • Memberikan masukan teknis dalam penyusunan rencana pengembangan kelistrikan kawasan.

Pelaporan Teknis Kelistrikan

  • Menyusun laporan analisis kebutuhan daya dan pelaksanaan maintenance.

  • Menyajikan data performa sistem listrik untuk kebutuhan evaluasi atasan.

  • Mendokumentasikan rencana dan realisasi maintenance kelistrikan.

Manajemen dan Mitigasi Risiko

  • Melakukan identifikasi, pengelolaan, pelaporan, kontrol, dan evaluasi mitigasi risiko secara berkala dengan memperhatikan target dan kebijakan risiko sesuai alur proses bisnis dan faktornya, serta memperhatikan aspek risiko dalam setiap keputusan dan ikut dalam program pengembangan budaya risiko.

PT Peruri Digital Security  (selanjutnya disebut  PDS ) adalah anak perusahaan dari  Perum Percetakan Uang Republik Indonesia  ( Perum Peruri ) yang didirikan pada tanggal 15 September 2011 berdasarkan Akta Notaris No. 22, bertepatan dengan peringatan 40 tahun Peruri. PDS menjadi wahana strategis untuk memastikan Peruri dapat beradaptasi dan tetap relevan dalam menghadapi era digitalisasi global yang bergerak cepat. Saat ini, 99,78% saham PDS dimiliki oleh Peruri, dengan fokus utama pada pengembangan seperti:

- Certificate Authority (CA) dan Tanda Tangan Elektronik
- Smart Card dan Sistem Otentikasi Digital
- Produk Digital Berbasis Keamanan Tertinggi
- Sistem Pembayaran dan Digital Identity
- Layanan Berbasis Blockchain dan Artificial Intelligence

company.description:
EF EFEKTA English for Adults

EF - EXCELLENCE IN ENGLISH TRAINING

EF was founded in Sweden in 1965 with just one teacher and a big dream of "breaking down the barriers in language learning both regionally and culturally". Today, EF has become the world's best and largest provider of English language courses by offering language learning and certified courses to people of all ages with study abroad opportunities and cultural exchange programs. EF has been appointed five times as the provider of language training services and official education services for the Olympics (1988 in Seoul, 2008 in Beijing, 2014 in Sochi, 2016 in Rio and 2018 in Pyeongchang).

EF & INDONESIA

With more than 500 schools and offices in 53 countries, EF is the world's largest private educational institution. EF has been in Indonesia since 1986 and to this day we provide intensive training programs for adults and education for children by leveraging the latest technology to provide courses, both in schools and online 24 hours a day.

EF & OLYMPICS

EF consistently supports various sporting events in various parts of the world and makes it a medium to promote global unity, development and equality. We are proud to have been the official provider of language training and education services for five Olympiads.

EF & INTERNATIONAL COMPANIES

EF continues to provide English training services for more than 1,500 international companies worldwide in various industries for a wide variety of employees.

EF Foreign Tutor.

EF has a team of high-quality teaching professionals led by teachers mostly from English-speaking countries with TEFL or other professional certifications. Our teachers are thoroughly selected and rigorously trained so that they are able to apply EF's superior learning methods. Let's get to know our foreign teachers better!

company.description: ﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿PT Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk (the Company) was established on May 9, 1990 under the name PT Trimulya Securindolestari based on Deed No. 64 dated May 9, 1990, which subsequently changed to PT Trimegah Securindolestari on May 28, 1990 based on Deed No. 227 dated May 28, 1990. The deeds were made before Rachmat Santoso, S.H., Notary in Jakarta, and have been announced in State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia No. 80 dated October 5, 1990, Supplement No. 3832. The Company earned Broker-Dealer License and Underwriting License from Bapepam & LK (now the Financial Services Authority) in 1992 and 1993. On October 12, 1999, the Company changed its name to PT Trimegah Securities Tbk based on Deed No. 17 dated October 12, 1999 made before Fathiah Helmi, S.H., Notaris in Jakarta and have been announced in State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia No. 90 dated February 1, 2000, Supplement No. 522, and on January 31, 2000 the Company listed its shares on the Jakarta Stock Exchange (now the Indonesia Stock Exchange) with the stock code “TRIM”. On January 31, 2011, PT Trimegah Asset Management, subsidiary of the Company, earned its business license as Investment Management Company. PT Trimegah Asset Management provides a variety of equity, balanced, fixed income and money market funds tailored to the needs of corporate clients, financial institutions and pension funds. To comply with the Financial Services Authority Regulation No. 20/POJK.04/2016 on the Licensing of Securities Companies that Undertake Business Activities as Underwriters and Broker-Dealers, effective as of July 29, 2016, the Company changed its name to PT Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk based on Deed No. 70 dated June 20, 2016 made before Fathiah Helmi, S.H., Notary in Jakarta. Equity Trading Division provides equity sales service in primary market and equity brokerage service in secondary market for retail and institutional clients. Fixed Income Trading Division provides fixed income securities sales service in primary market and fixed income securities brokerage service in secondary market such as Government Bonds, corporate bonds, Retail Government Bond, Retail Savings Bond, Retail Sharia Government Bond, and Savings Sharia Government Bond. Investment Banking Division provides equity and fixed income securities underwriting service as well as financial advisory service, including merger & acquisition, divestment, valuation, due diligence, corporate restructuring and financing and arranger. Starting April 2014, the Company also conducts activity as Mutual Fund Selling Agent for retail clients. To complete the services, the Company also provides online transaction facility for retail clients to invest in equity and mutual funds. On December 6, 2017, the Company earned Approval for Other Business Activity as Arranger, and Approval for Other Business Activity as Financial Advisor on September 21, 2018. PT Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk is Securities Company Member of the Indonesia Stock Exchange. PT Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk and PT Trimegah Asset Management are licensed, registered and supervised by the Financial Services Authority. Sejak awal pendiriannya, perusahaan kami dibentuk untuk menjawab tantangan pembangunan infrastruktur dan properti yang kian kompleks dengan mengedepankan integritas struktural dan efisiensi teknis.

Kami memadukan pengalaman lapangan yang matang dengan manajemen proyek yang sistematis untuk memastikan setiap detail pekerjaan—mulai dari struktur bawah hingga penyelesaian akhir—memenuhi standar kualitas yang ketat. Bagi kami, setiap proyek adalah tanggung jawab besar untuk membangun fondasi masa depan yang aman dan tahan lama bagi klien kami di seluruh penjuru Nusantara.

Pilar Utama Kami
Ketangguhan Teknis: Kami menggunakan standar material dan teknik konstruksi terkini untuk menjamin daya tahan bangunan jangka panjang.
Ketepatan Waktu: Kami menghargai nilai investasi Anda dengan sistem manajemen jadwal yang disiplin dan transparan.
Profesionalisme: Didukung oleh tim ahli yang berkompeten, kami memastikan setiap tahap pengerjaan berjalan sesuai dengan regulasi teknis dan standar keamanan kerja.
Integritas: Membangun kepercayaan melalui transparansi biaya, material, dan progres pengerjaan yang dapat dipertanggungjawabkan.
Visi Kami: Menjadi mitra konstruksi terdepan di Indonesia yang dikenal karena kualitas bangunan yang tangguh, inovasi teknis, dan kontribusi nyata dalam pembangunan nasional.
company_info.name: PT Mandiri Jaya Konstruksi Nusantara

company.description:
Ruangguru merupakan perusahaan teknologi terbesar dan terlengkap di Indonesia yang berfokus pada layanan berbasis pendidikan dan telah memiliki lebih dari 13 juta pengguna serta telah mengelola lebih dari 500.000 guru yang menawarkan jasa di lebih dari 100 bidang pelajaran. Perusahaan ini didirikan sejak tahun 2014 oleh Belva Devara dan Iman Usman, yang keduanya berhasil masuk dalam jajaran pengusaha sukses dibawah 30 tahun melalui Forbes 30 under 30 untuk teknologi konsumen di Asia.

Ruangguru berkomitmen untuk menjadi mitra bagi pemerintah daerah demi memberikan pendidikan berkualitas melalui Sistem Manajemen Belajar (LMS). Tahun lalu, Ruangguru berhasil bekerja sama dengan 32 (dari 34) pemerintah provinsi dan lebih dari 326 pemerintah kota dan kabupaten di Indonesia. Selain itu, Ruangguru juga menawarkan video belajar berlangganan, marketplace les privat, layanan bimbingan belajar on-demand, tryout ujian online, dan lain-lain.
