description:
1. Design, map, and continuously update class schedules for B2C students and B2B school partnership projects accurately within the operational system.
2. ⁠Assign qualified tutors in the system based on subject expertise, schedule availability, location preferences, and specific student/school requirements.
3. ⁠Send daily session reminders, track real-time tutor and student attendance, and proactively intervene to prevent class cancellations or delays.
4. ⁠Serve as the primary regional point of contact for inquiries, rescheduling requests, and daily operational issues from students, parents, tutors, and partner school representatives.
5. ⁠Quickly address and resolve on-the-ground operational bottlenecks (such as last-minute tutor replacements or schedule conflicts) to ensure uninterrupted learning sessions.
6. ⁠Maintain precise documentation of class data, attendance logs, and daily/weekly session status updates for regional and central management reports.
name: Admin Cluster Malang Raya
qualifications:
1. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, Communications, Education, or a related field (open to high-performing fresh graduates). 1 year of experience in operations administration, customer service/CX, or academic scheduling is a plus.
2. ⁠Exceptional organizational skills and accuracy when managing complex, multi-channel (B2B & B2C) scheduling data.
3. ⁠Proficient in Google Sheets / Microsoft Excel (comfortable with basic lookup formulas, filters, and PivotTables) and quick to adapt to internal operational dashboards.
4. ⁠Friendly, clear, and professional communication skills to engage effectively with students, parents, tutors, and partner school representatives.
5. ⁠Strong ability to prioritize tasks independently in a fast-paced, deadline-driven regional environment.
6. ⁠Quick-thinking and solution-oriented when managing sudden schedule adjustments or handling operational feedback in the field.

company.description:
Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX) is a Self-Regulatory Organization that creates a trusted and credible financial market infrastructure to deliver a fair, orderly, and efficient market, accessible to all stakeholders through innovative products and services. Our vision is to be a competitive stock exchange with world-class credibility. We aim to develop the Indonesian capital market to bring prosperity as one of the pillars of the Indonesian economy. We also actively seek to create more impact globally by joining the World Federation of Exchanges and Sustainable Stock Exchanges. Our goal is to become a credible exchange that drives financial deepening, enabling Indonesia to become the 5th largest economy by 2045. 

Our core values, Teamwork, Integrity, Professionalism, and Service Excellence (TIPS), are set to be our DNA. This is how we live at IDX. TIPS become the spirit that leads us to strengthen collaboration, and innovation, and to continuously go above and beyond to achieve our goals. 

People play significant roles in the success of IDX, and thus we put people as our priority. Ensuring our people have nurturing and exciting working experiences, we are fully committed to developing and energizing our people by providing various development programs and opportunities to create an impact through their roles/work. We are blessed to have been awarded as one of the Best Companies to Work for in Asia for the third consecutive year in 2017, 2018, and 2019, organized by HR Asia.

description:
We are looking for an analytical and detail-oriented professional with experience in Enterprise Architecture, particularly based on the TOGAF framework, to join our team as an IT Strategy and Enterprise Architecture Officer. In this role, you will contribute to the development and maintenance of the company's Enterprise Architecture, IT strategy, and digital transformation initiatives, ensuring alignment between business needs and technology solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Develop and maintain the company's Enterprise Architecture based on the TOGAF framework, covering Business Architecture, Data Architecture, Application Architecture, and Technology Architecture.

  2. Develop Enterprise Architecture roadmaps and studies to support the company's medium- and long-term business needs.

  3. Provide recommendations for IT solution adjustments to ensure alignment and coherence across data, applications, and technology within the company's Enterprise Architecture.

  4. Develop and update IT strategic plans and digital transformation initiatives in alignment with business needs.

  5. Manage IT architecture and project portfolio information and evaluate information systems in collaboration with relevant divisions and system owners.

  6. Support quality assurance processes for IT solution development projects.

  7. Coordinate GRC activities related to IT development and operations.

  8. Ensure IT policies, procedures, governance, and supporting documentation remain updated and available in accordance with applicable requirements.

address_components.address_line_1: RT05/RW03, Jalan Jenderal Sudirman, Senayan Kel., Kebayoran Baru

name: IT Strategy and Enterprise Architecture Officer
qualifications:
Education
Bachelor's Degree (S1) in Information Technology or related fields.

Experience

  • 1–2 years of relevant experience in Enterprise Architecture or a related field.

  • Hands-on experience in developing, maintaining, or implementing Enterprise Architecture based on the TOGAF framework is highly preferred.

Technical Skills

  1. Enterprise Architecture: Proficiency in TOGAF-based Enterprise Architecture

  2. IT Governance & Risk: Risk Management, GCG Principles and Management, and Internal Control & Compliance

  3. IT Management: IT Project Management, Quality Management, and IT Quality Assurance

  4. IT Foundations: IT Fundamentals and IT Governance & Regulations

Soft Skills

  1. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.

  2. Good planning and organizational skills.

  3. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

  4. Ability to build partnerships and gain commitment from relevant stakeholders.

  5. Proactive and committed to continuous improvement.

  6. Able to manage conflicts and communicate effectively with stakeholders.

General Requirements:

  1. Minimum GPA min. 3.00 (out of 4.00)
  2. Computer literate (Microsoft Office, MS Excel, & Power Point)
  3. Excellent communication skills in both Indonesian and English (verbal and written)
  4. Knowledge of Capital Market will be an advantage.
  5. Strong alignment with our core values: Teamwork, Integrity, Professionalism, and Service Excellence

company.description:
Asuransi Astra has been serving customers for more than half a century, precisely since September 12, 1956. The company, known for its Garda Oto motor vehicle insurance products, serves customers through a network of services spread across 28 branch offices, as well as service units and Garda Centers that continue developing. In addition to motor vehicle insurance, other products from Asuransi Astra are Garda Medika health insurance, mining industry insurance, agribusiness industry insurance, shop insurance, gas station insurance, sharia insurance, and others.

Since 2015, Asuransi Astra has developed its products and services digitally and introduced Garda Mobile as a collection of mobile applications intended for retail, commercial and general customers. The four Garda Mobile applications namely Otocare, Medcare, HR-access, and CR-access are consistently updated through various innovations aimed at customer convenience and comfort. The latest innovation developed in the Garda Mobile Otocare with the presence of GarXia, the first insurance purchase chatbot in Indonesia that can also help customers in reporting claims and the Garda Mall feature that allows users to shop for a variety of automotive needs, Astra Financial financial products, also to buying and selling cars. Asuransi Astra also has four digital products namely Garda Me, Garda Edu, Garda Home, and Garda Trip which can be purchased easily and quickly through the gardaoto.com site.

Asuransi Astra performance has also been recognized with various awards that have been received, including: Platinum Indonesia Best Brand Award (2002-2019), Top Brand Award (2007-2019), Service Quality Award (2007-2018), Corporate Image Award ( 2007-2019), Indonesian Customer Satisfaction Award (2001-2017), Indonesia Original Brand Award (2017-2019), General Insurance with very good financial performance in the Infobank Insurance Award (2008-2016, 2019), Excellent Service Experience Award (2013 -2020), Contact Center Service Excellence Award (2013-2020), Social Media Award (2012, 2016), Indonesia Sharia Finance Award (2017), Insurance Award (2017-2018), Insurance Consumer Choice Award (2017-2018), Asian Brands (2018), Marketing Award (2018), Indonesia Digital Innovation Award (2018), Markeeter of the Year (2018-2019), Infobrand Mobile Application Choice (2018), Marketeers Editor Choice Award (2018-2019), Indonesia Insurance Innovation Award (2019), Indonesia Digital Popular Brand Award (20 19), and others.

With the support of branches and workshops that are spread all over Indonesia, along with the best services and a series of achievements, certainly not stopping the steps of Asuransi Astra innovation through products that are built from the new spirit of Asuransi Astra to always provide comfort and peace for every customer. Therefore, Asuransi Astra will invest time and effort so that you always smile. "Peace of Mind to Millions" is the result that Asuransi Astra will provide to each customer.

description:
About the Role

Di Billstone, Anda akan memegang peran penting dalam menjaga kualitas dan keandalan proses keuangan perusahaan.

Sebagai FAT Supervisor, Anda akan menjadi bagian dari tim yang memastikan financial process berjalan dengan baik, informasi yang dihasilkan dapat dipercaya, dan perusahaan memiliki pondasi keuangan yang kuat untuk terus berkembang.

Peran ini cocok bagi Anda yang ingin mengambil ownership lebih besar, memiliki perhatian tinggi terhadap akurasi, serta tertarik untuk ikut meningkatkan cara kerja dan proses keuangan, bukan sekadar menjalankan rutinitas.

Your Responsibilities

1. Financial Reporting & Accounting Validation

  • Menyiapkan dan mereview laporan keuangan bulanan dan tahunan berbasis PSAK, dengan laporan bulanan selesai sebelum tanggal 5 setiap bulannya.
  • Memvalidasi seluruh transaksi, jurnal, rekonsiliasi bank, AR/AP, serta dokumen pendukung secara menyeluruh.
  • Mengidentifikasi discrepancy atau ketidaksesuaian transaksi dan memastikan tindak lanjut hingga terselesaikan.
  • Menyiapkan data dan dokumen pendukung untuk kebutuhan audit internal maupun eksternal.

2. Tax Planning, Compliance & Vendor Audit

  • Memastikan perhitungan, pembayaran, dan pelaporan PPh/PPN dilakukan secara akurat dan tepat waktu, dengan pembayaran sebelum tanggal 10 dan pelaporan sebelum tanggal 20.
  • Bekerja sama dengan penasihat atau konsultan pajak dalam menyusun strategi tax planning yang optimal.
  • Memeriksa dan memastikan pemotongan pajak vendor dilakukan menggunakan tarif yang tepat dan sesuai dengan peraturan perpajakan yang berlaku.

3. Systems Optimization, Budgeting & Cost Control

  • Mengawasi dan memaksimalkan penggunaan ERP, khususnya Odoo, serta software perpajakan seperti Coretax, untuk meningkatkan akurasi dan efisiensi proses.
  • Memantau cash flow serta budget divisi dan perusahaan.
  • Menjalankan cost management dan mengidentifikasi peluang efisiensi maupun cost saving.
  • Menyusun financial analysis yang membantu manajemen memahami kondisi bisnis dan mengambil keputusan.

How You Work

  • Anda memiliki rasa tanggung jawab dan ownership yang tinggi terhadap pekerjaan.
  • Anda teliti dan memahami bahwa detail kecil dalam proses keuangan dapat berdampak pada akurasi laporan dan kepatuhan perusahaan.
  • Anda terbiasa bekerja dengan deadline yang ketat tanpa mengorbankan kualitas.
  • Anda mampu menganalisis data, menemukan discrepancy, serta memastikan masalah ditindaklanjuti hingga selesai.
  • Anda proaktif mencari cara untuk meningkatkan proses, sistem, dan financial control.
  • Anda mampu berkomunikasi dengan jelas dan bekerja sama dengan internal team, management, auditor, maupun konsultan pajak.

What You’ll Enjoy as Our Team

  • Incentives (monthly & quarterly)
  • Tenure rewards & annual reviews
  • Recognition & appreciation culture
  • Well-being perks
  • Your ideas matter and are rewarded

company.description:
PT Kliring Penjaminan Efek Indonesia (KPEI) was established in 1996 as a Clearing and Guarantee
Institution or Central Counterparty (CCP) for the Indonesian capital market. In accordance with Law
No. 8 of 1995 on Capital Market, the Government of the Republic of Indonesia designated KPEI as
part of the Self-Regulatory Organization (SRO) of the Indonesian capital market, together with PT
Bursa Efek Indonesia (IDX) and PT Kustodian Sentral Efek Indonesia (KSEI). 

As an entity, KPEI’s line of business is to organize clearing of securities exchange transaction and
regulated over-thecounter (OTC) transactions as well as securities exchange settlement guarantee.
The development of industry and economy has enabled KPEI to expand its business activities by
conducting other financial supporting services, with the approval of the Financial Services Authority
(FSA) and in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. The year 2020 marked another
milestone of KPEI as it expanded its role as central counterparty (CCP) of the OTC Derivative market
in order to support the Government’s program to develop and integrity, efficient, and transparent
money market.
company.name: PT Kliring Penjaminan Efek Indonesia (KPEI)

company.description:
What is it like working at Kitabisa? 

About us 
Kitabisa stands as Indonesia's foremost digital fundraising and donation platform, serving as a nexus for millions of acts of kindness. Originating as a grassroots movement in 2013, we have continually expanded our reach and forged partnerships with diverse entities including corporations, governmental bodies, NGOs, hospitals, and prominent individuals. Together, we harness collective action to address societal challenges, with millions of #orangbaik contributors amplifying our impact in aiding those in need. Through leveraging technology, our vision is to cultivate the largest community dedicated to mutual aid and support. Our recent milestone, the acquisition of a sharia-compliant life insurance company, underscores our dedication to advancing inclusive and ethical financial solutions, furthering our mission of social impact and innovation.


What we value 
At Kitabisa, our work isn't just about tasks; it's about purpose. We're dedicated to connecting acts of kindness, amplifying their impact, and directly improving the lives of others, infusing our work with profound meaning. Guided by the principles of Berani, Berbuat, Baik, we embody courage by doing what's right even when no one's watching, upholding truthfulness, and respecting diversity. We are committed to action, understanding that mere words hold little weight without tangible steps forward. As 'doers', we prioritize action and value progress over perfection. Kindness forms the bedrock of everything we do, extending to ourselves, our colleagues, and, most importantly, those in need. If you share our values and seek to make a genuine difference in the lives of others, we invite you to join us on this meaningful journey.


Our Commitment
Kitabisa is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

description:
• Membuat dan meninjau dokumen teknik seperti Piping and Instrumentation Diagram (P&ID).
  • Menentukan spesifikasi teknis untuk alat ukur (instruments), katup kendali (control valves), dan sistem keamanan (ESD/Emergency Shutdown, DCS/Distributed Control System, F&G/Fire & Gas).
  • Membuat lembar data instrumen (instrument data sheets), diagram loop, dan daftar kebutuhan material (Bill of Quantity / BoQ).
  • Menyiapkan dokumen permintaan penawaran (request for quotation) untuk vendor.
  • Melakukan evaluasi teknis terhadap penawaran dari vendor atau penyuplai alat.
  • Berkoordinasi dengan bagian pengadaan untuk memastikan peralatan sesuai dengan standar industri migas (seperti API, IEC, atau ISA).
  • Memastikan parameter penting seperti suhu (temperature), tekanan (pressure), tingkat cairan (level), dan aliran (flow) terpantau secara akurat oleh sistem kontrol.
  • Mengatasi masalah (troubleshooting) pada perangkat instrumen atau sistem kendali yang mengalami kerusakan untuk mencegah downtime atau shutdown pabrik.
  • Mengatur jadwal dan prosedur kalibrasi alat ukur agar tetap presisi dan memenuhi standar keselamatan kerja.
  • Memastikan sistem pengaman darurat berfungsi dengan baik guna mencegah kecelakaan kerja atau ledakan (seperti Pressure Safety Valves / PSV).
  • Bekerja sama dengan disiplin ilmu lain seperti insinyur proses (process engineer), mekanik, dan kelistrikan (electrical)

address_components.address_line_1: 10, RT10/RW04, Jalan RA Kartini, Cilandak Barat Kel., Cilandak

name: Instrumen Engineering
qualifications:
• Pendidikan minimal Gelar Sarjana S1: lulusan Teknik Instrumentasi, Teknik Fisika, Teknik Elektro, atau Teknik Kontrol.
  • Memahami dan menguasai sistem seperti PLC (Programmable Logic Controller), DCS (Distributed Control System), SCADA, dan ESD (Emergency Shutdown).
  • Mengerti fungsi instrumen seperti transmitter, control valve, sensor, dan detektor.
  • Mampu membaca serta membuat P&ID (Piping and Instrumentation Diagram), Instrument Index, dan Loop Diagrams.
  • Terbiasa menggunakan AutoCAD serta alat kalibrasi seperti multimeter dan HART communicator.
  • Mampu mendiagnosis gangguan sistem dan menguji keandalan alat.
  • Berkoordinasi dengan baik bersama teknisi, manajemen, maupun divisi lain.

  • Memanfaatkan berbagai platform digital dan media online untuk melakukan presentasi produk serta konsultasi secara efektif.

company.description:
Ruangguru merupakan perusahaan teknologi terbesar dan terlengkap di Indonesia yang berfokus pada layanan berbasis pendidikan dan telah memiliki lebih dari 13 juta pengguna serta telah mengelola lebih dari 500.000 guru yang menawarkan jasa di lebih dari 100 bidang pelajaran. Perusahaan ini didirikan sejak tahun 2014 oleh Belva Devara dan Iman Usman, yang keduanya berhasil masuk dalam jajaran pengusaha sukses dibawah 30 tahun melalui Forbes 30 under 30 untuk teknologi konsumen di Asia.

Ruangguru berkomitmen untuk menjadi mitra bagi pemerintah daerah demi memberikan pendidikan berkualitas melalui Sistem Manajemen Belajar (LMS). Tahun lalu, Ruangguru berhasil bekerja sama dengan 32 (dari 34) pemerintah provinsi dan lebih dari 326 pemerintah kota dan kabupaten di Indonesia. Selain itu, Ruangguru juga menawarkan video belajar berlangganan, marketplace les privat, layanan bimbingan belajar on-demand, tryout ujian online, dan lain-lain.

company.description:
Asuransi Astra has been serving customers for more than half a century, precisely since September 12, 1956. The company, known for its Garda Oto motor vehicle insurance products, serves customers through a network of services spread across 28 branch offices, as well as service units and Garda Centers that continue developing. In addition to motor vehicle insurance, other products from Asuransi Astra are Garda Medika health insurance, mining industry insurance, agribusiness industry insurance, shop insurance, gas station insurance, sharia insurance, and others.

Since 2015, Asuransi Astra has developed its products and services digitally and introduced Garda Mobile as a collection of mobile applications intended for retail, commercial and general customers. The four Garda Mobile applications namely Otocare, Medcare, HR-access, and CR-access are consistently updated through various innovations aimed at customer convenience and comfort. The latest innovation developed in the Garda Mobile Otocare with the presence of GarXia, the first insurance purchase chatbot in Indonesia that can also help customers in reporting claims and the Garda Mall feature that allows users to shop for a variety of automotive needs, Astra Financial financial products, also to buying and selling cars. Asuransi Astra also has four digital products namely Garda Me, Garda Edu, Garda Home, and Garda Trip which can be purchased easily and quickly through the gardaoto.com site.

Asuransi Astra performance has also been recognized with various awards that have been received, including: Platinum Indonesia Best Brand Award (2002-2019), Top Brand Award (2007-2019), Service Quality Award (2007-2018), Corporate Image Award ( 2007-2019), Indonesian Customer Satisfaction Award (2001-2017), Indonesia Original Brand Award (2017-2019), General Insurance with very good financial performance in the Infobank Insurance Award (2008-2016, 2019), Excellent Service Experience Award (2013 -2020), Contact Center Service Excellence Award (2013-2020), Social Media Award (2012, 2016), Indonesia Sharia Finance Award (2017), Insurance Award (2017-2018), Insurance Consumer Choice Award (2017-2018), Asian Brands (2018), Marketing Award (2018), Indonesia Digital Innovation Award (2018), Markeeter of the Year (2018-2019), Infobrand Mobile Application Choice (2018), Marketeers Editor Choice Award (2018-2019), Indonesia Insurance Innovation Award (2019), Indonesia Digital Popular Brand Award (20 19), and others.

With the support of branches and workshops that are spread all over Indonesia, along with the best services and a series of achievements, certainly not stopping the steps of Asuransi Astra innovation through products that are built from the new spirit of Asuransi Astra to always provide comfort and peace for every customer. Therefore, Asuransi Astra will invest time and effort so that you always smile. "Peace of Mind to Millions" is the result that Asuransi Astra will provide to each customer.

description:
We're looking for an IT Architect Security Specialist, with main responsibilities are planning, researching & designing the company's IT security architectures. Recommend us with the latest technology, enhancements, reinforcements, and preparing countermeasures that protect our system.

Job descriptions for IT Architect Security as follows:

  • Analyzing, planning, researching, and designing company IT Security architectures and giving us the best recommendations for security
  • Doing Risk Assessments & Implementing recommendations
  • Enhance and Reinforce IT security
  • Having a great sense of IT Security
  • Review and update IT Policy
  • Managing and tuning force point data leakage protection
  • Manage Security Management Report
name: IT Security Architect
qualifications:
• Candidate must possess at least a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science/Information Technology or equivalent
  • At least 3 year(s) of working experience in IT Security Architect fields, both software & hardware
  • Up-to-date about the latest IT security systems
  • Familiar with DAST, SAST, standard security systems & frameworks
  • Deep understanding of security architect & strong technical background

company.description:
Ruangguru merupakan perusahaan teknologi terbesar dan terlengkap di Indonesia yang berfokus pada layanan berbasis pendidikan dan telah memiliki lebih dari 13 juta pengguna serta telah mengelola lebih dari 500.000 guru yang menawarkan jasa di lebih dari 100 bidang pelajaran. Perusahaan ini didirikan sejak tahun 2014 oleh Belva Devara dan Iman Usman, yang keduanya berhasil masuk dalam jajaran pengusaha sukses dibawah 30 tahun melalui Forbes 30 under 30 untuk teknologi konsumen di Asia.

Ruangguru berkomitmen untuk menjadi mitra bagi pemerintah daerah demi memberikan pendidikan berkualitas melalui Sistem Manajemen Belajar (LMS). Tahun lalu, Ruangguru berhasil bekerja sama dengan 32 (dari 34) pemerintah provinsi dan lebih dari 326 pemerintah kota dan kabupaten di Indonesia. Selain itu, Ruangguru juga menawarkan video belajar berlangganan, marketplace les privat, layanan bimbingan belajar on-demand, tryout ujian online, dan lain-lain.

description:
About The Roles

Make sure that every kilo a collector brings in is received, weighed, paid, and delivered onward — reliably, cheaply, and with data that holds up under audit.

The Manager of Operations owns Wahu's physical capacity: how many collection points exist, whether they work, and how material moves from hub to MRF. Growth creates the demand; this role makes sure the network can absorb it.

Job Descriptions

Network build — hubs & dropboxes

  • Owns the rollout plan against the 400–500 collection point target: site selection, partner onboarding, permits, installation, and launch readiness.
  • Builds a repeatable installation process so opening a hub is a standard procedure, not a project.
  • Manages the pipeline per partner and per region, phased against transport and MRF processing capacity no hub opens that cannot be serviced.
  • Proposes relocation or closure of underperforming points on cost and uptime evidence, with Growth consulted on whether demand can still be built.
  • Delivers a hub that is ready to receive collectors on the agreed launch date, so Growth's pre-launch campaign lands on a working site.

Hub operations — uptime and the collector experience on site

  • Analyze and optimized hub for improvement
  • Owns hub uptime: equipment working, scales calibrated, bins emptied, site clean and safe.
  • Staffs and trains hub attendants; sets the service standard a collector meets at the counter.
  • Owns payout execution accurate weighing, correct rates (e.g. Rp 10,000/kg for aluminium cans), and payment into the app wallet without disputes.
  • Runs preventive maintenance and a fast-response repair loop; a broken hub is a lost hub.
  • Resolves partner-side issues at store level: space, access, signage, store staff cooperation.

Logistics & collection

  • Owns routing, collection frequency, fleet, and third-party transport so no hub overflows and no truck runs half empty.
  • Plans capacity ahead of the rollout and ahead of campaign peaks flagged by Growth.
  • Manages transport cost per kilo as a primary lever on unit economics.
  • Owns chain-of-custody from hub to MRF — every load traceable to a source.

Alignment with the MRF

  • Coordinates with the MRF on delivery windows, intake planning, and volume forecasts. This is alignment between two organisations, not line management.
  • Holds material quality at the handover: sorted, dry, and within agreed contamination limits so volume is not lost at the gate.
  • Gives the MRF a reliable forward forecast so processing capacity is planned ahead of the rollout, not after it.
  • Flags early when network volume is about to outgrow available processing capacity.
  • Resolves handover disputes on weight, quality, and documentation.

Cost, data & compliance

  • Owns all-in operational cost per kilo, hub to MRF collection, transport, handling, payout and drives it down as volume scales.
  • Owns the operational data layer feeding the dashboard: volumes, weights, uptime, routes, deliveries. One source of truth, shared with Growth and Finance.
  • Guards traceability so volume claims survive audit by partners, certifiers, and plastic-credit markets (PPRS, PCX Markets).
  • Owns permits, KLHK and other regulatory reporting, and QHSE across all sites.
  • Owns safety: this is a business with vehicles, machinery, and manual handling.

Qualification

  • Track record: 8+ years in operations or logistics, of which at least 3 leading a multi-site field organisation.
  • Leads managers: has run a network through city, area, or branch managers — not a single site, and not only an office function. Comfortable being accountable for places they are not standing in.
  • Scale of people: has been responsible for 100+ staff, including blue-collar teams.
  • Standardisation: has taken something that worked in one location and made it work identically in five.
  • Indonesian market: operates confidently with local permits, regulators, retail partners, and vendors across regions.
  • Cost discipline: has owned a unit cost and moved it. Can build and defend an operational model.
  • Language: fluent Bahasa Indonesia and English.
  • Field presence: will be at hubs and on the floor, not only in the number

Nice to Have

  • Waste management, recycling, or materials handling experience.
  • Familiarity with EPR, PPRS certification, or plastic credit verification requirements.
  • Retail or in-store operations experience — installing and servicing equipment inside a partner's store.
  • Experience opening operations in a new city from scratch.
  • Formal continuous improvement background (Lean, Six Sigma) applied in practice, not on paper.

description:
Bertanggung jawab memastikan seluruh kegiatan operasional perusahaan berjalan sesuai dengan ketentuan hukum yang berlaku serta memenuhi regulasi Bank Indonesia dan regulator terbaik. Posisi ini akan menjadi mitra strategis bagi seluruh unit bisnis dalam mengelola aspek legal, regulatory compliance, dan corporate governance.

Tanggung Jawab:

  • Memberikan legal opinion dan konsultasi hukum kepada seluruh departemen perusahaan
  • Menyusun, mereview, dan melakukan negosiasi berbagai dokumen hukum seperti perjanjian kerja sama, NDA, MoU, SLA, vendor agreement, dan dokumen legal lainnya
  • Memastikan seluruh aktivitas bisnis perusahaan sesuai dengan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku

  • Melakukan legal review terhadap produk, layanan, maupun proyek baru untuk memastikan kesesuaiannya dengan regulasi
  • Mengelola administrasi legal perusahaan, termasuk corporate documents, perizinan, dan arsip kontrak
  • Mengidentifikasi risiko hukum dan kepatuhan serta memberikan rekomendasi mitigasi kepada manajemen
  • Mendukung proses audit internal maupun eksternal yang berkaitan dengan aspek legal dan compliance
  • Menyusun, memperbarui, dan mensosialisasikan kebijakan serta SOP perusahaan sesuai dengan perkembangan regulasi

company.description:
Jendela Group is a property and asset management company specializing in property development, marketing, and integrated management services. The company is committed to delivering professional, transparent, and results-driven solutions for property owners, investors, and tenants.

With a strong focus on innovation and market-driven strategies, Jendela Group aims to maximize asset value while ensuring operational excellence and long-term sustainability. Supported by a dedicated and experienced team, the company continues to build trusted partnerships and create meaningful value in the property industry.

Jendela Group operates through several business lines, including Jendela360, Weltown, CariProperti, and Properti BU, each designed to address different segments of the property market and provide comprehensive end-to-end property solutions.

company.description:
Starting an unincorporated business in 1996, Simbadda Group has been distributing high quality consumer electronics throughout Indonesia. The business unit has started to form a corporate business since 2002.

One of our leading brands is SIMBADDA, which is known by the Indonesian people as a pioneer of speakers, cases and power supplies. We are also involved in the distribution of premium gadget accessories and PC components. Simbadda Group will continue to expand its distribution business to grow in the consumer electronics industry in Indonesia.

Simbadda Group always upholds the value of honesty, among others: honesty of quality,  honesty of cooperation in business and trying to establish cooperation with all partners  throughout Indonesia. 

Currently, Simbadda Group is expanding towards digital transformation that is looking for  enthusiastic, passionate, ambitious individuals to be part of us.

description:
• Own and be accountable for national revenue, profitability, and sustainable business growth across all commercial and marketing functions.
  • Lead, oversee, and evaluate the performance of all Division Heads under the Commercial & Marketing function, ensuring alignment with business objectives and performance targets.
  • Set overall commercial and marketing direction, ensuring alignment between brand strategy, channel strategy, digital growth, omnichannel, and sales execution.
  • Govern the end-to-end business funnel from Brand Guidance → Branding → Traffic & Acquisition → Channel Execution → Conversion → Retention, ensuring each function contributes to measurable business results.
  • Establish and review key performance indicators covering revenue, profitability, channel performance, sell-in, sell-through, sell-out, CAC, ROAS, LTV, conversion, retention, and marketing ROI.
  • Conduct regular business and performance reviews with each Head, identify performance gaps, and ensure timely corrective actions and improvement plans.
  • Oversee national channel development and expansion across GT, MT, Key Accounts, Superstores, Retail, Experience Stores, E-Commerce, Marketplace, Website, and other strategic channels.
  • Ensure effective allocation and utilization of commercial and marketing budgets, with clear accountability for ROI and business impact.
  • Drive strategic alignment between Brand Principle / Holding, Distributor, Commercial, Marketing, Digital, Retail, and other relevant functions.
  • Lead major strategic decisions related to business growth, market expansion, key partnerships, customer acquisition, and commercial transformation.
  • Act as the primary strategic escalation and decision-making point for Commercial & Marketing matters before escalation to the Managing Director.
  • Build a strong, scalable, accountable, and performance-driven leadership team, including coaching and developing the Heads under the function.
  • Provide regular business performance updates, strategic recommendations, key risks, and growth opportunities to the Managing Director.
  • Lead strategic initiatives, transformation programs, and special/ad hoc projects assigned by the Managing Director to support company objectives.

address_components.address_line_1: 50, RT07/RW02, Jalan Pantai Indah Kapuk, Kamal Muara Kel., Penjaringan

name: General Manager – Commercial & Marketing
qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, Marketing, Finance, or related field; Master’s degree is an advantage.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in Commercial, Sales, Marketing, Business Development, or General Management.
  • Minimum 3–5 years in a senior leadership role, managing Heads/Managers and cross-functional teams.
  • Proven experience managing national revenue, profitability, commercial strategy, and business growth.
  • Strong experience across GT, MT, Key Account, Distributor, and Retail channels.
  • Proven ability to manage sell-in, sell-through, sell-out, channel performance, and commercial KPIs.
  • Strong understanding of P&L, budgeting, forecasting, ROI, CAC, and data-driven performance management.
  • Demonstrated experience in business expansion, strategic partnerships, and key account development.
  • Strong leadership, strategic thinking, negotiation, analytical, and decision-making skills.
  • Experience in consumer electronics, FMCG, retail, distribution, or related industries is preferred.
  • Proficient in English and Bahasa Indonesia, both written and spoken.

company.description:
Advance Innovations (AdIns) is Independent Software Vendor that established in 2000. We have comprehensive an end-to-end solution for financial businesses such as customer finance and leasing solution, mobile solution, document solution, IT training and development solution, data warehouse and business intelligent solution and payment channel solution. With all of this solutions we are a market leader in this industry with 60% of market share. AdIns has an excellent track record and 100% success rate in project implementation supported by an excellent combination of highly skilled professionals, in-depth business understanding, and extensive experience in financial industry especially banking and multi-finance company.

Feels Like Home

We do not care about who you are, where do you come from, or the colour of your skin. You are one of us and we are one of you. AdIns is home to young innovative professionals, because we know that modern problem need a modern solution. Having fun while working will make an enjoyable, conducive, and comfortable working place and it is one of the privilege that gave to the employees.

Learning Experience

If you are looking for a job, AdIns is not the right place for you, if you have huge thirst of knowledge, AdIns is the perfect place to keep on learning and developing yourself. Learning is the journey of a lifetime, that's why AdIners aren't just encouraged but also sponsored to take a bunch of certification for free.

Same Frequency

We understand that not everyone can get along with each other and we all have a fear of being judged. You can be yourself without any hesitation because we talk in the same frequency and have the same set of mind on this world. Being bullied and be the bully with no heartache is an everyday thing.

Facility & Reward

Greater power comes with greater responsibility, no pain no gain, yin and yang, everything come in pairs and have to be balance. AdIns will see and acknowledge every skill and potential that you have, so do not be afraid and feel free to do more than what they expect. We really appreciate our loyal and dedicated employees with a further study, certification, vacation trip, etc.

Ruangguru merupakan perusahaan teknologi terbesar dan terlengkap di Indonesia yang berfokus pada layanan berbasis pendidikan dan telah memiliki lebih dari 13 juta pengguna serta telah mengelola lebih dari 500.000 guru yang menawarkan jasa di lebih dari 100 bidang pelajaran. Perusahaan ini didirikan sejak tahun 2014 oleh Belva Devara dan Iman Usman, yang keduanya berhasil masuk dalam jajaran pengusaha sukses dibawah 30 tahun melalui Forbes 30 under 30 untuk teknologi konsumen di Asia.

Ruangguru berkomitmen untuk menjadi mitra bagi pemerintah daerah demi memberikan pendidikan berkualitas melalui Sistem Manajemen Belajar (LMS). Tahun lalu, Ruangguru berhasil bekerja sama dengan 32 (dari 34) pemerintah provinsi dan lebih dari 326 pemerintah kota dan kabupaten di Indonesia. Selain itu, Ruangguru juga menawarkan video belajar berlangganan, marketplace les privat, layanan bimbingan belajar on-demand, tryout ujian online, dan lain-lain.
company_info.name: Ruangguru

description:
Deskripsi pekerjaan yang akan dilakukan:

  • Mencari, mengelola, dan mengonversi prospek (leads) menjadi pelanggan untuk mencapai target penjualan individu maupun tim.
  • Melakukan presentasi produk dan memberikan konsultasi kepada calon pelanggan mengenai solusi pendidikan dari Ruangguru.
  • Membangun serta menjaga hubungan baik dengan calon pelanggan maupun pelanggan aktif guna memastikan kepuasan pelanggan.
  • Mengelola data pelanggan, aktivitas penjualan, serta tindak lanjut (follow-up) secara akurat melalui sistem CRM.
  • Memahami produk Ruangguru serta mengikuti perkembangan tren pendidikan untuk memberikan rekomendasi yang sesuai dengan kebutuhan pelanggan.
  • Berkolaborasi dengan tim internal dalam mendukung berbagai inisiatif penjualan dan meningkatkan pengalaman pelanggan.
  • Memanfaatkan berbagai platform digital dan media online untuk melakukan presentasi produk serta konsultasi secara efektif.

description:
ASTRO - Groceries in Minutes

Indonesia's first and fastest-growing on-demand platform for groceries and essentials.

Anything you need, fast.

Astro is Indonesia's first quick commerce company that delivers groceries and essentials to your door within 15 minutes. 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

Just like real Astronauts that take off into outer space, Astro embodies the values of being fast, bold, adventurous, and technologically advanced. Download our app now to experience and enjoy the new definition of fast!

Interested in working for a company that pushes the boundaries and strives to be the best? Join us now to be a part of this ground-breaking mission!

The Mission Control (Talent Pool) We are constantly looking for stellar talents to join our journey. Even if you don't see a specific role open today, we want to know you! By applying here, you are entering our "Mission Control" database for future opportunities across various functions.

Existing Function in ASTRO:

  1. Technology: Ensuring safe, reliable platforms while enhancing experiences and delivering cost-effective tech solutions.
  2. Product, Data & Demand Supply: Boosting user satisfaction, productivity, and efficiency with personalized and streamlined product solutions.
  3. Data & Business Intelligence: Delivering smart, data-driven strategies that guide impactful decision-making.
  4. Channel Operations: Ensures seamless performance by optimizing networks, scaling up active Mitra, reducing customer complaints and streamlining inventory management
  5. Private Label: Develops top-selling products and ensures customer satisfaction through constant refinement and collaboration with local producers.
  6. Customer Growth: Attracts new buyers & retains existing users to experience Astro’s convenience.
  7. Commercial Controller: Enhances efficiency and profitability by reducing waste, optimizing product range, contributing to significant cost savings and revenue growth.
  8. Commercial (ASTRO Farm & FMCG): Maximizes financial performance by improving profitability, reducing costs, increasing ad revenue, and driving growth across key business areas.
  9. Legal: Ensures compliance by building frameworks that minimize risks to protect Astro’s interests.
  10. People: Manages end-to-end talent processes, drives organizational growth, optimizes workforce management to save costs, and builds Astro’s reputation as a top startup to work for.
  11. Tax, Accounting & Finance: Manages compliance with tax regulations, ensures accurate financial reporting, and oversees timely payments to support efficient operations.
  12. Corporate Finance: Optimized pricing to boost buyers, revenue, and competitiveness of fresh products while reducing costs.
  13. Internal Audit & Risk Management: Ensures operational accuracy through daily stock checks, minimizes inventory losses, prevents business disruptions, and works towards eliminating fraud.

Ready to join the mission? Submit your profile today!

description:
Do you have an eye for numbers and a knack for keeping finances on track? Are you familiar with Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), and the importance of keeping invoices and payments in check? If you enjoy solving discrepancies, tracking outstanding payments, and making sure every detail adds up, this could be the opportunity for you!

We're looking for a Finance & Operations Associate to join our team. In this role, you'll support day-to-day finance and operational activities, including invoice processing, monitoring outstanding balances and aging days, and maintaining accurate financial records. You'll play an important role in ensuring transactions are processed efficiently, discrepancies are resolved promptly, and business operations run smoothly.

Key Responsibilities

  • Process and verify Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR) transactions, ensuring accuracy and compliance with established procedures.
  • Handle invoice processing, including reviewing invoice details, validating supporting documents, and ensuring invoices are recorded accurately and processed within agreed timelines.
  • Monitor outstanding invoices, payment statuses, and aging days to identify overdue payments, follow up on outstanding items, and support timely settlement.
  • Perform account reconciliations, investigate discrepancies, and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to resolve exceptions.
  • Maintain accurate financial records, transaction data, reports, and supporting documentation to ensure data integrity.
  • Respond to internal and external enquiries regarding invoices, payments, receivables, and other finance-related matters within established turnaround times.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support daily finance and operational activities and ensure smooth transaction processing.
  • Perform administrative and back-office tasks to support financial accuracy, operational efficiency, and compliance with established procedures.
  • Support ad hoc assignments and continuous process improvement initiatives while contributing to team productivity, quality, and service performance targets.

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
  • English proficiency of CEFR B2 or above.
  • Fresh graduate or with 1-2 years of experience in finance, accounting, business operations, or shared services through full-time work, internships, or relevant academic projects.
  • Willing to work on a rotating roster, including overnight shifts, weekends, and public holidays.
  • Willing to be based in BSD and/or Jakarta.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage high volumes of work accurately.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate with multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience in processing high volumes of transactions or operational tasks.
  • Familiarity with ERP systems, financial systems, or business operations platforms.
  • Experience working in a BPO, shared services, or multinational environment.

company.description:
What is it like working at Kitabisa? 

About us 
Kitabisa stands as Indonesia's foremost digital fundraising and donation platform, serving as a nexus for millions of acts of kindness. Originating as a grassroots movement in 2013, we have continually expanded our reach and forged partnerships with diverse entities including corporations, governmental bodies, NGOs, hospitals, and prominent individuals. Together, we harness collective action to address societal challenges, with millions of #orangbaik contributors amplifying our impact in aiding those in need. Through leveraging technology, our vision is to cultivate the largest community dedicated to mutual aid and support. Our recent milestone, the acquisition of a sharia-compliant life insurance company, underscores our dedication to advancing inclusive and ethical financial solutions, furthering our mission of social impact and innovation.


What we value 
At Kitabisa, our work isn't just about tasks; it's about purpose. We're dedicated to connecting acts of kindness, amplifying their impact, and directly improving the lives of others, infusing our work with profound meaning. Guided by the principles of Berani, Berbuat, Baik, we embody courage by doing what's right even when no one's watching, upholding truthfulness, and respecting diversity. We are committed to action, understanding that mere words hold little weight without tangible steps forward. As 'doers', we prioritize action and value progress over perfection. Kindness forms the bedrock of everything we do, extending to ourselves, our colleagues, and, most importantly, those in need. If you share our values and seek to make a genuine difference in the lives of others, we invite you to join us on this meaningful journey.


Our Commitment
Kitabisa is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

company.description: ﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿PT Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk (the Company) was established on May 9, 1990 under the name PT Trimulya Securindolestari based on Deed No. 64 dated May 9, 1990, which subsequently changed to PT Trimegah Securindolestari on May 28, 1990 based on Deed No. 227 dated May 28, 1990. The deeds were made before Rachmat Santoso, S.H., Notary in Jakarta, and have been announced in State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia No. 80 dated October 5, 1990, Supplement No. 3832. The Company earned Broker-Dealer License and Underwriting License from Bapepam & LK (now the Financial Services Authority) in 1992 and 1993. On October 12, 1999, the Company changed its name to PT Trimegah Securities Tbk based on Deed No. 17 dated October 12, 1999 made before Fathiah Helmi, S.H., Notaris in Jakarta and have been announced in State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia No. 90 dated February 1, 2000, Supplement No. 522, and on January 31, 2000 the Company listed its shares on the Jakarta Stock Exchange (now the Indonesia Stock Exchange) with the stock code “TRIM”. On January 31, 2011, PT Trimegah Asset Management, subsidiary of the Company, earned its business license as Investment Management Company. PT Trimegah Asset Management provides a variety of equity, balanced, fixed income and money market funds tailored to the needs of corporate clients, financial institutions and pension funds. To comply with the Financial Services Authority Regulation No. 20/POJK.04/2016 on the Licensing of Securities Companies that Undertake Business Activities as Underwriters and Broker-Dealers, effective as of July 29, 2016, the Company changed its name to PT Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk based on Deed No. 70 dated June 20, 2016 made before Fathiah Helmi, S.H., Notary in Jakarta. Equity Trading Division provides equity sales service in primary market and equity brokerage service in secondary market for retail and institutional clients. Fixed Income Trading Division provides fixed income securities sales service in primary market and fixed income securities brokerage service in secondary market such as Government Bonds, corporate bonds, Retail Government Bond, Retail Savings Bond, Retail Sharia Government Bond, and Savings Sharia Government Bond. Investment Banking Division provides equity and fixed income securities underwriting service as well as financial advisory service, including merger & acquisition, divestment, valuation, due diligence, corporate restructuring and financing and arranger. Starting April 2014, the Company also conducts activity as Mutual Fund Selling Agent for retail clients. To complete the services, the Company also provides online transaction facility for retail clients to invest in equity and mutual funds. On December 6, 2017, the Company earned Approval for Other Business Activity as Arranger, and Approval for Other Business Activity as Financial Advisor on September 21, 2018. PT Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk is Securities Company Member of the Indonesia Stock Exchange. PT Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk and PT Trimegah Asset Management are licensed, registered and supervised by the Financial Services Authority. company.description:
What is it like working at Kitabisa? 

About us 
Kitabisa stands as Indonesia's foremost digital fundraising and donation platform, serving as a nexus for millions of acts of kindness. Originating as a grassroots movement in 2013, we have continually expanded our reach and forged partnerships with diverse entities including corporations, governmental bodies, NGOs, hospitals, and prominent individuals. Together, we harness collective action to address societal challenges, with millions of #orangbaik contributors amplifying our impact in aiding those in need. Through leveraging technology, our vision is to cultivate the largest community dedicated to mutual aid and support. Our recent milestone, the acquisition of a sharia-compliant life insurance company, underscores our dedication to advancing inclusive and ethical financial solutions, furthering our mission of social impact and innovation.


What we value 
At Kitabisa, our work isn't just about tasks; it's about purpose. We're dedicated to connecting acts of kindness, amplifying their impact, and directly improving the lives of others, infusing our work with profound meaning. Guided by the principles of Berani, Berbuat, Baik, we embody courage by doing what's right even when no one's watching, upholding truthfulness, and respecting diversity. We are committed to action, understanding that mere words hold little weight without tangible steps forward. As 'doers', we prioritize action and value progress over perfection. Kindness forms the bedrock of everything we do, extending to ourselves, our colleagues, and, most importantly, those in need. If you share our values and seek to make a genuine difference in the lives of others, we invite you to join us on this meaningful journey.


Our Commitment
Kitabisa is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

description:
Kitabisa sedang mencari Hospital Coordinator untuk wilayah Sumatera Utara dan Aceh. Kamu akan menjadi penghubung utama antara Kitabisa dengan rumah sakit, klinik, komunitas, dan instansi kesehatan untuk membantu pasien yang membutuhkan biaya pengobatan melalui penggalangan dana. Peran ini cocok untuk kamu yang senang turun ke lapangan, membangun relasi, dan ingin berdampak langsung bagi pasien.

Tanggung Jawab

  • Mencari dan mendapatkan pasien (supply) melalui rekomendasi rumah sakit, klinik, komunitas, dan instansi kesehatan.
  • Mencari pasien secara personal melalui pendekatan direct selling di lapangan.
  • Membuat campaign penggalangan dana untuk pasien, baik dari jalur rekomendasi maupun direct selling.
  • Menggali informasi dari pasien dan keluarga, serta menindaklanjuti kebutuhan aset (dokumen, foto, cerita, data medis) untuk memaksimalkan performa campaign.
  • Membangun dan menjaga hubungan baik dengan rumah sakit, klinik, komunitas, dan instansi kesehatan di wilayah Sumatera Utara dan Aceh.
  • Bertanggung jawab atas proses pembayaran billing ke rumah sakit, klinik, komunitas, dan instansi kesehatan.
  • Menyusun laporan pencairan dana untuk dilaporkan kepada pihak rumah sakit, klinik, komunitas, dan instansi kesehatan terkait.

company.description: ﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿PT Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk (the Company) was established on May 9, 1990 under the name PT Trimulya Securindolestari based on Deed No. 64 dated May 9, 1990, which subsequently changed to PT Trimegah Securindolestari on May 28, 1990 based on Deed No. 227 dated May 28, 1990. The deeds were made before Rachmat Santoso, S.H., Notary in Jakarta, and have been announced in State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia No. 80 dated October 5, 1990, Supplement No. 3832. The Company earned Broker-Dealer License and Underwriting License from Bapepam & LK (now the Financial Services Authority) in 1992 and 1993. On October 12, 1999, the Company changed its name to PT Trimegah Securities Tbk based on Deed No. 17 dated October 12, 1999 made before Fathiah Helmi, S.H., Notaris in Jakarta and have been announced in State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia No. 90 dated February 1, 2000, Supplement No. 522, and on January 31, 2000 the Company listed its shares on the Jakarta Stock Exchange (now the Indonesia Stock Exchange) with the stock code “TRIM”. On January 31, 2011, PT Trimegah Asset Management, subsidiary of the Company, earned its business license as Investment Management Company. PT Trimegah Asset Management provides a variety of equity, balanced, fixed income and money market funds tailored to the needs of corporate clients, financial institutions and pension funds. To comply with the Financial Services Authority Regulation No. 20/POJK.04/2016 on the Licensing of Securities Companies that Undertake Business Activities as Underwriters and Broker-Dealers, effective as of July 29, 2016, the Company changed its name to PT Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk based on Deed No. 70 dated June 20, 2016 made before Fathiah Helmi, S.H., Notary in Jakarta. Equity Trading Division provides equity sales service in primary market and equity brokerage service in secondary market for retail and institutional clients. Fixed Income Trading Division provides fixed income securities sales service in primary market and fixed income securities brokerage service in secondary market such as Government Bonds, corporate bonds, Retail Government Bond, Retail Savings Bond, Retail Sharia Government Bond, and Savings Sharia Government Bond. Investment Banking Division provides equity and fixed income securities underwriting service as well as financial advisory service, including merger & acquisition, divestment, valuation, due diligence, corporate restructuring and financing and arranger. Starting April 2014, the Company also conducts activity as Mutual Fund Selling Agent for retail clients. To complete the services, the Company also provides online transaction facility for retail clients to invest in equity and mutual funds. On December 6, 2017, the Company earned Approval for Other Business Activity as Arranger, and Approval for Other Business Activity as Financial Advisor on September 21, 2018. PT Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk is Securities Company Member of the Indonesia Stock Exchange. PT Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk and PT Trimegah Asset Management are licensed, registered and supervised by the Financial Services Authority. Mission Educate and create wealth for the community through unique and professional investment experience Vision Be most preferred destination for financial services in the region Core Values Integrity - Zero-tolerance policy for issues of integrity Client-First - Consistent mindset to prioritize clients need over our own Excellence - Commitment to delivering the highest quality product in all we do Fairness - Give credit where it is due, own up to mistakes, think of others Creativity - Creativity creates advantage; have courage to speak out

description:
• Own the architecture, quality, and performance of the iOS app end to end
  • Build and maintain core flows: order entry, portfolio, watchlist, transaction history, onboarding
  • Handle real-time market data on the client — WebSocket lifecycle, reconnect strategy, snapshot + delta, conflation for slow connections, and keeping the UI smooth while thousands of instruments tick
  • Protect order integrity client-side: client order IDs, deduplication, idempotency, and correct order state machine handling when the network drops mid-submit
  • Financial-grade app security: certificate pinning, Keychain storage, biometric authentication, jailbreak detection, sensitive-screen protection
  • Honest mobile observability: crash-free rate, hang rate, cold start, per-endpoint latency — and acting on the numbers
  • Mature the iOS CI/CD pipeline: automated builds, signing, TestFlight, shortening commit-to-release time
  • Release discipline: feature flags, staged rollout, genuinely tested rollback, and releasing outside exchange hours
  • Review code, mentor engineers, and set the mobile team's engineering standards
  • Work with compliance, risk, and security from the design stage rather than as a rubber stamp at the end
name: Mobile Developer iOS
qualifications:
• 5+ years of iOS development, including at least 2 years carrying senior-level technical responsibility
  • Deep Swift; comfortable in both UIKit and SwiftUI, with a view on when each belongs
  • Modern concurrency: async/await, Structured Concurrency, GCD; Combine or equivalent
  • Architecture at scale: MVVM / VIPER / TCA, modularization, dependency injection — and the reasoning behind the choice
  • Networking: URLSession, WebSockets, caching, graceful behaviour on poor connections
  • Testing: unit, snapshot, and UI tests, with a clear point of view on what is worth testing
  • Performance and memory profiling with Instruments
  • iOS CI/CD: Fastlane, Xcode Cloud, Bitrise, or GitHub Actions
  • Able to explain technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders — in this industry you will do it often

company.description: ﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿PT Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk (the Company) was established on May 9, 1990 under the name PT Trimulya Securindolestari based on Deed No. 64 dated May 9, 1990, which subsequently changed to PT Trimegah Securindolestari on May 28, 1990 based on Deed No. 227 dated May 28, 1990. The deeds were made before Rachmat Santoso, S.H., Notary in Jakarta, and have been announced in State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia No. 80 dated October 5, 1990, Supplement No. 3832. The Company earned Broker-Dealer License and Underwriting License from Bapepam & LK (now the Financial Services Authority) in 1992 and 1993. On October 12, 1999, the Company changed its name to PT Trimegah Securities Tbk based on Deed No. 17 dated October 12, 1999 made before Fathiah Helmi, S.H., Notaris in Jakarta and have been announced in State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia No. 90 dated February 1, 2000, Supplement No. 522, and on January 31, 2000 the Company listed its shares on the Jakarta Stock Exchange (now the Indonesia Stock Exchange) with the stock code “TRIM”. On January 31, 2011, PT Trimegah Asset Management, subsidiary of the Company, earned its business license as Investment Management Company. PT Trimegah Asset Management provides a variety of equity, balanced, fixed income and money market funds tailored to the needs of corporate clients, financial institutions and pension funds. To comply with the Financial Services Authority Regulation No. 20/POJK.04/2016 on the Licensing of Securities Companies that Undertake Business Activities as Underwriters and Broker-Dealers, effective as of July 29, 2016, the Company changed its name to PT Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk based on Deed No. 70 dated June 20, 2016 made before Fathiah Helmi, S.H., Notary in Jakarta. Equity Trading Division provides equity sales service in primary market and equity brokerage service in secondary market for retail and institutional clients. Fixed Income Trading Division provides fixed income securities sales service in primary market and fixed income securities brokerage service in secondary market such as Government Bonds, corporate bonds, Retail Government Bond, Retail Savings Bond, Retail Sharia Government Bond, and Savings Sharia Government Bond. Investment Banking Division provides equity and fixed income securities underwriting service as well as financial advisory service, including merger & acquisition, divestment, valuation, due diligence, corporate restructuring and financing and arranger. Starting April 2014, the Company also conducts activity as Mutual Fund Selling Agent for retail clients. To complete the services, the Company also provides online transaction facility for retail clients to invest in equity and mutual funds. On December 6, 2017, the Company earned Approval for Other Business Activity as Arranger, and Approval for Other Business Activity as Financial Advisor on September 21, 2018. PT Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk is Securities Company Member of the Indonesia Stock Exchange. PT Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk and PT Trimegah Asset Management are licensed, registered and supervised by the Financial Services Authority. Sebagai Communication Coordinator, kamu akan bertanggung jawab untuk membangun dan menjaga hubungan strategis dengan komunitas kreatif, brand, dan influencer yang sejalan dengan audiens toko—para pencari pengalaman unik, early adopters, dan pelanggan loyal yang menghargai kreativitas serta relevansi.

Peran ini berfokus pada menarik lebih banyak pengunjung ke toko dan membangun loyalitas pelanggan melalui program kolaboratif, event menarik, dan aktivitas komunitas yang relevan, serta pengelolaan media sosial yang engaging. Kamu akan mengelola promosi acara, menjalin kemitraan yang berdampak, serta memastikan engagement komunitas tetap kuat melalui berbagai kanal publik dan digital. Dengan keterampilan komunikasi yang efektif, kemampuan beradaptasi, dan pendekatan yang solutif, kamu akan menciptakan pengalaman yang tidak hanya meningkatkan brand awareness, tetapi juga menjadikan toko sebagai destinasi utama bagi komunitas kreatif.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Membangun & Menjaga Hubungan Strategis

  • Mengembangkan kemitraan dengan komunitas kreatif, brand, influencer, dan tokoh yang relevan dengan audiens toko.
  • Menjalin komunikasi aktif untuk memastikan kolaborasi jangka panjang yang berdampak.
  • Mengidentifikasi peluang kerja sama yang bisa meningkatkan traffic dan engagement toko.

2. Mengelola Program & Event Komunitas

  • Merancang dan menjalankan event interaktif, program komunitas, serta aktivasi toko yang menarik minat pelanggan.
  • Mengoordinasikan detail acara dan memastikan setiap event memberikan pengalaman yang relevan bagi audiens.
  • Memastikan promosi acara dilakukan dengan baik melalui berbagai kanal komunikasi.

3. Strategi & Manajemen Media Sosial

  • Mengembangkan strategi media sosial toko untuk memperkuat positioning sebagai pusat kreativitas.
  • Mengawasi dan merancang konten yang engaging, relevan dengan komunitas, serta mendorong partisipasi pelanggan.

About this Position

This role is responsible for ensuring product quality across web and mobile applications by designing and executing thorough manual testing throughout the development lifecycle. The Quality Engineer will review product requirements, create test cases, identify and document defects, and work closely with Product and Engineering teams to validate expected system behavior before release. The role also involves API testing, maintaining test documentation, and leveraging tools or AI to improve test planning and QA efficiency..

Responsibilities

  • Review Product Requirement Documents (PRD) to understand business logic, product behavior, and technical requirements before testing begins.
  • Design and create detailed, structured, and traceable test scenarios and test cases based on PRD and functional requirements.
  • Perform manual testing across web, mobile, and API platforms to ensure product functionality, usability, and reliability meet quality standards.
  • Conduct API testing using Postman to validate request/response behavior, data integrity, and service integration.
  • Identify, document, and track bugs or issues clearly through Jira, ensuring proper reproduction steps and impact analysis are captured.
  • Work closely with engineers and product managers to reproduce issues, clarify requirements, and validate expected system behavior.
  • Manage and maintain test cases using TestRail, ensuring test coverage remains accurate and up to date throughout development cycles.
  • Document testing results, findings, and release readiness reports in Confluence to maintain transparency and traceability across teams.
  • Support release validation through regression testing to ensure new changes do not negatively impact existing functionality.
  • Utilize AI tools to assist QA activities, such as breaking down PRDs, generating test scenarios, and improving test planning efficiency.
  • Demonstrate understanding of basic test automation concepts and collaborate with engineers when automation is involved (e.g., WebdriverIO for mobile testing and Playwright for web testing).

description:
Operasional Anaerobic Digester

  • Mengoperasikan fasilitas anaerobic digester sesuai SOP dan parameter proses yang ditetapkan.

  • Memastikan material organik yang masuk sesuai kebutuhan dan kapasitas proses.

  • Menjaga stabilitas operasional digester agar pengolahan limbah organik berjalan optimal.

Operasional Composting

  • Melaksanakan proses composting limbah organik sesuai metode dan tahapan kerja yang ditetapkan.

  • Mengatur komposisi bahan, kelembapan, suhu, dan kondisi tumpukan/reaktor kompos.

  • Memastikan proses berjalan hingga menghasilkan kompos sesuai spesifikasi internal.

Monitoring Parameter Proses Biologis

  • Memantau parameter proses biologis seperti suhu, pH, kelembapan, loading rate, dan stabilitas proses.

  • Mencatat hasil monitoring secara berkala.

  • Menindaklanjuti deviasi parameter dengan tindakan korektif awal.

Pengelolaan Hasil Olahan

  • Mengelola output hasil proses seperti kompos, biogas, residu, atau produk turunan lainnya.

  • Memastikan hasil olahan tertangani sesuai prosedur dan tujuan pemanfaatannya.

  • Mencatat volume dan kualitas hasil pengolahan untuk evaluasi program.

Optimalisasi Program Zero Waste

  • Mengidentifikasi peluang peningkatan efisiensi proses anaerobic digester dan composting.

  • Mengusulkan perbaikan metode kerja, pemanfaatan hasil olahan, atau peningkatan proses.

  • Mendukung pelaksanaan inisiatif pengurangan limbah dan circular economy di kawasan.

Pelaporan Program Zero Waste

  • Mengisi logsheet operasional fasilitas anaerobic digester dan composting.

  • Menyusun laporan volume limbah organik terolah dan hasil pemrosesan.

  • Menyampaikan data program zero waste sebagai dasar monitoring dan evaluasi atasan.

Manajemen dan Mitigasi Risiko

  • Melakukan identifikasi, pengelolaan, pelaporan, kontrol, dan evaluasi mitigasi risiko secara berkala dengan memperhatikan target dan kebijakan risiko sesuai alur proses bisnis dan faktornya, serta memperhatikan aspek risiko dalam setiap keputusan dan ikut dalam program pengembangan budaya risiko.

Advance Innovations (AdIns) is Independent Software Vendor that established in 2000. We have comprehensive an end-to-end solution for financial businesses such as customer finance and leasing solution, mobile solution, document solution, IT training and development solution, data warehouse and business intelligent solution and payment channel solution. AdIns has an excellent track record and 100% success rate in project implementation supported by an excellent combination of highly skilled professionals, in-depth business understanding, and extensive experience in financial industry especially banking and multi-finance company.

Feels Like Home

We do not care about who you are, where do you come from, or the colour of your skin. You are one of us and we are one of you. company.description:
PT Peruri Digital Security  (selanjutnya disebut  PDS ) adalah anak perusahaan dari  Perum Percetakan Uang Republik Indonesia  ( Perum Peruri ) yang didirikan pada tanggal 15 September 2011 berdasarkan Akta Notaris No. 22, bertepatan dengan peringatan 40 tahun Peruri. Pendirian ini merupakan respons strategis atas perkembangan teknologi informasi dan komunikasi yang mengubah secara fundamental cara masyarakat bertransaksi, mengelola data, dan mengamankan dokumen

Sebagai perusahaan induk yang memiliki mandat untuk mencetak dokumen negara dan dokumen bernilai tinggi, Peruri melihat urgensi untuk melakukan diversifikasi usaha melalui penguatan kapabilitas digital. PDS menjadi wahana strategis untuk memastikan Peruri dapat beradaptasi dan tetap relevan dalam menghadapi era digitalisasi global yang bergerak cepat. Saat ini, 99,78% saham PDS dimiliki oleh Peruri, dengan fokus utama pada pengembangan seperti:

Solusi Keamanan Digital
- Certificate Authority (CA) dan Tanda Tangan Elektronik
- Smart Card dan Sistem Otentikasi Digital
- Produk Digital Berbasis Keamanan Tertinggi
- Sistem Pembayaran dan Digital Identity
- Layanan Berbasis Blockchain dan Artificial Intelligence

It has become rather easy these days, to connect with anyone.

giftee, in providing eGift as its foremost service, hopes to build all kinds of ties between the people, businesses and their townships. By having more warm connections in our world, it could make spontaneous feelings more forthcoming. As this starts to circulate smoothly, we should be forming a society built on better relationships. And so with this belief, we forge ahead.

Since the Company’s establishment in 1981, the management is consistently maintaining and pursuing its commitments towards ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction and its dedication to high quality products. These factors have been instrumental in shaping Impack’s corporate culture and in bringing about its proud record and achievements to date. To secure Impack’s position as a leading plastics building material company in the Asia Pacific Region, the management and staff are well-equipped with the necessary skill, entrepreneurial spirit and total commitments to implement and achieve their desired goals. Each of our subsidiaries and business divisions have bottom-line responsibility for their own businesses and operations, and operates in a synergistic manner towards a common goal. With a dynamic supported by an experienced management team, Impack is well-prepared to expand the production capacity of its core business units in the coming years. With its orientation towards the future, the company is poised to become the market leader in the Asia Pacific Region.

company.description:
PT Sinar Mitra Sepadan Finance (“Perusahaan”) adalah perusahaan pembiayaan nasional yang didirikan pada 28 November 2000. Perusahaan memperoleh izin usaha melalui Surat Keputusan Kementerian Keuangan Nomor 365/KMK.06/2001 pada 11 Juni 2001. Saat ini, Perusahaan berkedudukan di Jakarta Selatan dengan kantor pusat di Agro Plaza Lantai 16-17, Jl. H.R. Rasuna Said Kav. X2-1, Kuningan Timur, Setiabudi, Jakarta Selatan 12950.

Pemegang saham Perusahaan saat ini adalah ORIX Corporation dari Jepang dan PT Sinar Mas Multiartha, Tbk. (“SMMA”), dengan ORIX Corporation sebagai pemegang saham mayoritas sebesar 85%.

Perusahaan telah menjadi bagian dari ORIX Corporation, Jepang, yang memiliki jaringan di lebih dari 30 negara dan terdaftar di New York Stock Exchange. PT Sinar Mitra Sepadan Finance bergerak di bidang jasa pembiayaan kendaraan bermotor roda empat atau lebih. Selama lebih dari 20 tahun, Perusahaan telah berkembang dengan memiliki lebih dari 100 jaringan (Kantor Cabang dan Kantor Selain Kantor Cabang) di seluruh Indonesia dan lebih dari 2.000 karyawan. 

SMS Finance, pilihan perusahaan pembiayaan untuk mobil bekas dan multiguna dengan jaminan BPKB mobil, bunga rendah mulai 0,7%!
company.name: PT. Sinar Mitra Sepadan Finance (SMS Finance)

Ruangguru merupakan perusahaan teknologi terbesar dan terlengkap di Indonesia yang berfokus pada layanan berbasis pendidikan dan telah memiliki lebih dari 13 juta pengguna serta telah mengelola lebih dari 500.000 guru yang menawarkan jasa di lebih dari 100 bidang pelajaran. Our goal is to become a credible exchange that drives financial deepening, enabling Indonesia to become the 5th largest economy by 2045. 

Our core values, Teamwork, Integrity, Professionalism, and Service Excellence (TIPS), are set to be our DNA. This is how we live at IDX. TIPS become the spirit that leads us to strengthen collaboration, and innovation, and to continuously go above and beyond to achieve our goals. 

People play significant roles in the success of IDX, and thus we put people as our priority. Ensuring our people have nurturing and exciting working experiences, we are fully committed to developing and energizing our people by providing various development programs and opportunities to create an impact through their roles/work. We are blessed to have been awarded as one of the Best Companies to Work for in Asia for the third consecutive year in 2017, 2018, and 2019, organized by HR Asia.

company.description:
CARE Technologies is a leading insurance technology company and one of the pioneers in Indonesia to develop and launch both desktop-based and web-based applications specifically designed for the General Insurance industry.

Established on February 20, 2006, and headquartered in Tebet, South Jakarta, CARE Technologies has been committed to delivering innovative and reliable technology solutions that support the digital transformation of insurance businesses. In 2010, CARE Technologies became one of the first companies in Indonesia to introduce an Enterprise General Insurance Application, a platform that continues to evolve and support the growing needs of the insurance industry.

With a team of more than 180 highly skilled professionals, including IT Consultants, Business Analysts, Project Managers, and Software Developers, CARE Technologies continuously delivers leading solutions and services to our clients.

Today, CARE Technologies serves the majority of General Insurance companies in Indonesia, with approximately 80% of the market utilizing CARE solutions. Our international footprint continues to expand, with successful implementations and clients across Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, Taiwan, and Guam.

description:
• Financial Planning & Cash Flow Management

  • Develop and manage the company’s cash flow forecasts, ensuring accurate projections of cash inflows and outflows.

  • Monitor short-term and medium-term liquidity to ensure the company maintains sufficient cash availability.

  • Ensure adequate fund availability to meet operational and financial obligations in a timely manner.

  • Identify potential cash flow gaps and liquidity risks, and proactively recommend appropriate mitigation measures.

  • Develop funding and payment prioritization recommendations based on cash flow requirements, business priorities, and financial obligations.

  • Analyze cash flow trends and variances to support financial planning and management decision-making.

  • Treasury & Banking Management

  • Oversee the management and administration of all company bank accounts, ensuring proper control and utilization.

  • Oversee and ensure the timely and accurate completion of bank reconciliations.

  • Provide recommendations for the placement of idle funds in accordance with the company’s policies, guidelines, and delegated authority.

  • Account Receivable & Collection Management

  • Manage the company’s Accounts Receivable (AR) operations to ensure effective receivables management.

  • Ensure timely and accurate billing in accordance with agreed terms and contractual requirements.

  • Conduct regular reviews of Accounts Receivable aging reports and monitor outstanding balances to support timely collection.

  • Account Payable & Payment Governance

  • Oversee Accounts Payable (AP) activities and payment schedules to ensure timely and accurate payments.

  • Ensure vendors are paid in accordance with contractual obligations and the company’s cash flow priorities.

  • Review and approve material or unusual payments, ensuring appropriate justification and authorization.

  • Monitor and ensure compliance with established payment controls and procedures.

  • Budgeting & Financial Control

  • Support the preparation of the company's annual budget.

  • Monitor actual versus budgeted figures.

  • Preparing Financial Reports for management.

  • Implementing Internal Controls & Fraud Prevention

  • Making Finance Policy & Procedure

  • Conducting Audit, Compliance & Tax

  • Identifying potential Financial Risk Management issues.

  • Team Management
