company.description:
Ruangguru merupakan perusahaan teknologi terbesar dan terlengkap di Indonesia yang berfokus pada layanan berbasis pendidikan dan telah memiliki lebih dari 13 juta pengguna serta telah mengelola lebih dari 500.000 guru yang menawarkan jasa di lebih dari 100 bidang pelajaran. Perusahaan ini didirikan sejak tahun 2014 oleh Belva Devara dan Iman Usman, yang keduanya berhasil masuk dalam jajaran pengusaha sukses dibawah 30 tahun melalui Forbes 30 under 30 untuk teknologi konsumen di Asia.

Ruangguru berkomitmen untuk menjadi mitra bagi pemerintah daerah demi memberikan pendidikan berkualitas melalui Sistem Manajemen Belajar (LMS). Tahun lalu, Ruangguru berhasil bekerja sama dengan 32 (dari 34) pemerintah provinsi dan lebih dari 326 pemerintah kota dan kabupaten di Indonesia. Selain itu, Ruangguru juga menawarkan video belajar berlangganan, marketplace les privat, layanan bimbingan belajar on-demand, tryout ujian online, dan lain-lain.

- Senang untuk tampil dan berbicara di depan umum
- Memiliki laptop dan smartphone pribadi

  2. Memiliki pengalaman mengajar berbagai jenjang usia (anak-anak hingga remaja) menjadi nilai tambah

company.description:
Ruangguru merupakan perusahaan teknologi terbesar dan terlengkap di Indonesia yang berfokus pada layanan berbasis pendidikan dan telah memiliki lebih dari 13 juta pengguna serta telah mengelola lebih dari 500.000 guru yang menawarkan jasa di lebih dari 100 bidang pelajaran. Perusahaan ini didirikan sejak tahun 2014 oleh Belva Devara dan Iman Usman, yang keduanya berhasil masuk dalam jajaran pengusaha sukses dibawah 30 tahun melalui Forbes 30 under 30 untuk teknologi konsumen di Asia.

Ruangguru berkomitmen untuk menjadi mitra bagi pemerintah daerah demi memberikan pendidikan berkualitas melalui Sistem Manajemen Belajar (LMS). Tahun lalu, Ruangguru berhasil bekerja sama dengan 32 (dari 34) pemerintah provinsi dan lebih dari 326 pemerintah kota dan kabupaten di Indonesia. Selain itu, Ruangguru juga menawarkan video belajar berlangganan, marketplace les privat, layanan bimbingan belajar on-demand, tryout ujian online, dan lain-lain.

Global Talentlytica Indonesia adalah perusahaan yang mengembangkan Platform Assessment Online, layanan software as service di bidang Human Resource yang berdiri sejak tahun 2019, Talentlytica sebelumnya merupakan salah satu brand product dari perusahaan PT. Gagas Daya Imaji yang berdiri sejak tahun 2007. 

Talentlytica bergerak di jasa konsultan dan layanan di bidang pengembangan sumber daya manusia. Platform kami membantu Departemen HR untuk mengambil keputusan lebih baik menggunakan data dan analitik. Dengan dukungan ini HR dapat menjadi business partner yang efektif untuk mencapai tujuan organisasi secara keseluruhan. Saat ini kami mencari kandidat yang memiliki semangat belajar yang tinggi, ingin membantu talent menemukan pekerjaan yang fit dengan diri mereka.

Umat manusia menghadapi ancaman  sosial yang tidak terbayangkan sebelumnya. Industrial Revolution 4.0 atau dikenal juga sebagai Conceptual Age akan membuat automation dan artificial intelligence merubah bagaimana manusia hidup dan bekerja. Hal ini  akan membuat Krisis tenaga kerja , dan dampaknya berbeda dengan revolusi yang terjadi sebelumnya. Pada revolusi sebelumnya membutuhkan waktu beberapa dekade dan generasi sebelum itu benar-benar terjadi secara menyeluruh.
Saat ini perubahan tersebut jauh lebih cepat dan sangat mungkin terjadi dalam satu rentang generasi bahkan lebih cepat. Hal tersebut menjadi tantangan besar (sama seperti Climate Change, Sampah, Krisis Energy dlsb).

Umat manusia menghadapi ancaman  sosial yang tidak terbayangkan sebelumnya. Industrial Revolution 4.0 atau dikenal juga sebagai Conceptual Age akan membuat automation dan artificial intelligence merubah bagaimana manusia hidup dan bekerja. Hal ini  akan membuat Krisis tenaga kerja , dan dampaknya berbeda dengan revolusi yang terjadi sebelumnya. Pada revolusi sebelumnya membutuhkan waktu beberapa dekade dan generasi sebelum itu benar-benar terjadi secara menyeluruh.
Saat ini perubahan tersebut jauh lebih cepat dan sangat mungkin terjadi dalam satu rentang generasi bahkan lebih cepat. Hal tersebut menjadi tantangan besar (sama seperti Climate Change, Sampah, Krisis Energy dlsb).

company.description:
Our Journey

With a renewed vision for growth and innovation, we rebranded as PT Bank SMBC Indonesia Tbk (SMBC Indonesia) in 2024, formerly known as PT Bank BTPN Tbk. This rebranding reflects our response to the dynamic changes, allowing us to consolidate our strengths and deliver even more seamless, integrated solutions for millions of customers from diverse segments across Indonesia.
 
This transformation signals our commitment to advancing and streamlining our business strategies, enabling us to better serve our customers and help them lead more meaningful and fulfilling lives. At the heart of this rebrand is our dedication to supporting Indonesia's long-term development goals, in alignment with the vision of Indonesia Emas 2045.
 
In addition to these goals, we are excited to invite talented individuals and younger generations to join us, expand their careers and make a lasting impact. Together, we can drive positive change and build a brighter future for Indonesia.

Life at SMBC Indonesia

At SMBC Indonesia, our team is a close-knit family of innovative individuals dedicated to growing and making a positive impact on our communities. We offer top-notch banking services while ensuring that our team members feel appreciated and engaged thanks to cutting-edge digital technology and global expertise. We foster a flexible, open environment where employees can continuously learn, develop professionally, and aspire to become their best selves.

We cultivate a collaborative culture with open communication between leaders and team members, encouraging the sharing of ideas, feedback, and problem-solving. Strong bonds between colleagues are vital, enabling agile teamwork that drives success in today’s fast-paced banking industry.
Our office is designed for both productivity and relaxation, with activities like billiards, gaming, and karaoke available after work. SMBC Indonesia also supports various internal clubs, offering options like yoga, badminton, gaming, and parenting to keep our team active and engaged. We believe these opportunities are essential for maintaining a vibrant, innovative workforce.

Giving Back

Through our Daya program, SMBC Indonesia champions sustainable, measurable empowerment initiatives for our customers. The Daya program offers education, training, and resource-sharing to enhance entrepreneurial skills, unlock growth opportunities, and improve quality of life. Health & Wellness and Community Empowerment programs are integral parts of our business model, fostering an environment where our customers thrive alongside our business.

Adaptive to change
 
With decades of experience, SMBC Indonesia has embraced adaptability as a core value. Our approach to work reflects this, with flexible dress codes, remote work options, and digital collaboration tools to keep our team connected and productive. By embracing these changes, we are better positioned to serve our customers effectively and stay resilient in a dynamic industry. Despite the evolving challenges in banking, SMBC Indonesia remains committed to meaningful progress and impactful service that touches millions.
company.name: PT Bank SMBC Indonesia Tbk

company.description:
Ruangguru merupakan perusahaan teknologi terbesar dan terlengkap di Indonesia yang berfokus pada layanan berbasis pendidikan dan telah memiliki lebih dari 13 juta pengguna serta telah mengelola lebih dari 500.000 guru yang menawarkan jasa di lebih dari 100 bidang pelajaran. Perusahaan ini didirikan sejak tahun 2014 oleh Belva Devara dan Iman Usman, yang keduanya berhasil masuk dalam jajaran pengusaha sukses dibawah 30 tahun melalui Forbes 30 under 30 untuk teknologi konsumen di Asia.

Ruangguru berkomitmen untuk menjadi mitra bagi pemerintah daerah demi memberikan pendidikan berkualitas melalui Sistem Manajemen Belajar (LMS). Tahun lalu, Ruangguru berhasil bekerja sama dengan 32 (dari 34) pemerintah provinsi dan lebih dari 326 pemerintah kota dan kabupaten di Indonesia. Selain itu, Ruangguru juga menawarkan video belajar berlangganan, marketplace les privat, layanan bimbingan belajar on-demand, tryout ujian online, dan lain-lain.

description:
Are you passionate about keeping IT systems running smoothly and ensuring users receive reliable technical support? Do you enjoy troubleshooting technical issues, maintaining critical infrastructure, and working in a fast-paced operational environment where no two days are the same?

We're looking for an IT Operations Associate to join our IT Operations team. In this role, you'll provide day-to-day IT support for our production environment, helping ensure business continuity by resolving technical issues, maintaining infrastructure, and delivering excellent support to internal users.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide day-to-day IT support for end users, ensuring timely resolution of incidents and service requests
  • Maintain and support critical IT infrastructure, including LAN/WAN networks, wireless networks, servers, firewalls, CCTV systems, IP telephony, and access control systems
  • Diagnose and resolve moderately complex hardware, software, network, and connectivity issues using established troubleshooting methodologies
  • Manage incidents and requests through IT Service Management (ITSM) tools while following ITIL best practices
  • Monitor system performance, identify potential issues, and proactively escalate risks to ensure business continuity
  • Collaborate with internal teams to support operational projects, infrastructure improvements, and system implementations
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of IT procedures, documentation, and operational standards
  • Prioritize multiple support requests while maintaining service quality and meeting operational service levels
name: IT Operations Support
qualifications:
Is this you?

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, or a related field
  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant work experience in IT operations, technical support, network administration, or IT infrastructure support.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues independently
  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting and configuring networking technologies, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, and network devices
  • Experience using IT Service Management (ITSM) platforms such as Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, Zendesk, or similar ticketing systems
  • Understanding of ITIL principles for incident and request management
  • Excellent project and time management skills with the ability to manage changing priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Professional proficiency in both Bahasa Indonesia and English, with strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Professional certifications such as Cisco CCNA/CCNP or MikroTik MTCNA/MTCRE/MTCRP
  • Experience supporting enterprise IT environments and infrastructure
  • Experience administering Windows Server and/or Linux operating systems
  • Familiarity with virtualization platforms such as VMware or Hyper-V
  • Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
  • Basic understanding of endpoint security, firewalls, backup, and disaster recovery practices
  • Willing to be placed in BSD, South Tanggerang office

Ruangguru merupakan perusahaan teknologi terbesar dan terlengkap di Indonesia yang berfokus pada layanan berbasis pendidikan dan telah memiliki lebih dari 13 juta pengguna serta telah mengelola lebih dari 500.000 guru yang menawarkan jasa di lebih dari 100 bidang pelajaran. PT Surya Artha Nusantara Finance (SANF) is a financial services company in Indonesia, primarily focused on providing financing solutions for the heavy equipment and transportation sectors. SANF is a joint venture between PT Astra International Tbk, one of Indonesia's largest conglomerates, and Marubeni Corporation, a major Japanese trading company.

SANF offers a variety of financial products, including leasing, consumer financing, and factoring, to support businesses in acquiring heavy equipment, trucks, and machinery. The company plays a significant role in industries like construction, mining, agriculture, and transportation, helping businesses manage their financial needs through customized financing solutions.

Let's join our Fun, Friendly, and Continuous Growth journey!

company.description:
EF EFEKTA English for Adults

EF - EXCELLENCE IN ENGLISH TRAINING

EF was founded in Sweden in 1965 with just one teacher and a big dream of "breaking down the barriers in language learning both regionally and culturally". Today, EF has become the world's best and largest provider of English language courses by offering language learning and certified courses to people of all ages with study abroad opportunities and cultural exchange programs. EF has been appointed five times as the provider of language training services and official education services for the Olympics (1988 in Seoul, 2008 in Beijing, 2014 in Sochi, 2016 in Rio and 2018 in Pyeongchang).

EF & INDONESIA

With more than 500 schools and offices in 53 countries, EF is the world's largest private educational institution. EF has been in Indonesia since 1986 and to this day we provide intensive training programs for adults and education for children by leveraging the latest technology to provide courses, both in schools and online 24 hours a day.

EF & OLYMPICS

EF consistently supports various sporting events in various parts of the world and makes it a medium to promote global unity, development and equality. We are proud to have been the official provider of language training and education services for five Olympiads.

EF & INTERNATIONAL COMPANIES

EF continues to provide English training services for more than 1,500 international companies worldwide in various industries for a wide variety of employees.

EF Foreign Tutor.

EF has a team of high-quality teaching professionals led by teachers mostly from English-speaking countries with TEFL or other professional certifications. Our teachers are thoroughly selected and rigorously trained so that they are able to apply EF's superior learning methods. Let's get to know our foreign teachers better!

Established in 1953 by Go Soei Kie (Dasuki Angkosubroto) as a commodities trading business, Gunung Sewu has grown to become one of Indonesia’s premier diversified business groups, with a workforce of approximately 30,000 professionals encompassing operations in the food, insurance, property, manufacturing and other emerging businesses. We believe that Indonesia is a market that can be developed involving ecosystems that are sustainable, whilst aiming to lead by example.
 
We take pride in our humble beginnings, and have grown over the years by placing Passion, Purpose, and Progress as the cornerstone of our activities and focus on creating value in a sustainable manner, as we believe these are the keys to our long-term success. We nurture new businesses, but also work on expanding our existing ones and to develop close relationships with our partners and stakeholders to preserve brand equity across generations.
 
While we celebrate our time-tested values, long-standing heritage and history that spans over 65 years, we believe the global market rewards companies that are striving to explore new horizons. To this end, we aim to nurture progress by fostering an entrepreneurial spirit, guided by integrity and fairness amongst our workforce.

company.description:
Asuransi Astra has been serving customers for more than half a century, precisely since September 12, 1956. The company, known for its Garda Oto motor vehicle insurance products, serves customers through a network of services spread across 28 branch offices, as well as service units and Garda Centers that continue developing. In addition to motor vehicle insurance, other products from Asuransi Astra are Garda Medika health insurance, mining industry insurance, agribusiness industry insurance, shop insurance, gas station insurance, sharia insurance, and others.

Since 2015, Asuransi Astra has developed its products and services digitally and introduced Garda Mobile as a collection of mobile applications intended for retail, commercial and general customers. The four Garda Mobile applications namely Otocare, Medcare, HR-access, and CR-access are consistently updated through various innovations aimed at customer convenience and comfort. The latest innovation developed in the Garda Mobile Otocare with the presence of GarXia, the first insurance purchase chatbot in Indonesia that can also help customers in reporting claims and the Garda Mall feature that allows users to shop for a variety of automotive needs, Astra Financial financial products, also to buying and selling cars. Asuransi Astra also has four digital products namely Garda Me, Garda Edu, Garda Home, and Garda Trip which can be purchased easily and quickly through the gardaoto.com site.

Asuransi Astra performance has also been recognized with various awards that have been received, including: Platinum Indonesia Best Brand Award (2002-2019), Top Brand Award (2007-2019), Service Quality Award (2007-2018), Corporate Image Award ( 2007-2019), Indonesian Customer Satisfaction Award (2001-2017), Indonesia Original Brand Award (2017-2019), General Insurance with very good financial performance in the Infobank Insurance Award (2008-2016, 2019), Excellent Service Experience Award (2013 -2020), Contact Center Service Excellence Award (2013-2020), Social Media Award (2012, 2016), Indonesia Sharia Finance Award (2017), Insurance Award (2017-2018), Insurance Consumer Choice Award (2017-2018), Asian Brands (2018), Marketing Award (2018), Indonesia Digital Innovation Award (2018), Markeeter of the Year (2018-2019), Infobrand Mobile Application Choice (2018), Marketeers Editor Choice Award (2018-2019), Indonesia Insurance Innovation Award (2019), Indonesia Digital Popular Brand Award (20 19), and others.

With the support of branches and workshops that are spread all over Indonesia, along with the best services and a series of achievements, certainly not stopping the steps of Asuransi Astra innovation through products that are built from the new spirit of Asuransi Astra to always provide comfort and peace for every customer. Therefore, Asuransi Astra will invest time and effort so that you always smile. "Peace of Mind to Millions" is the result that Asuransi Astra will provide to each customer.

description:
Underwriters are responsible for calculating, analyzing, and assessing risks. They arrange insurance coverage, propose insurance terms and conditions, provide risk recommendations, and negotiate reinsurance placements.

To support the development of future underwriting professionals, successful candidates will join the Underwriter Expert Program, a structured 6-month development program designed to build technical knowledge, business understanding, and underwriting expertise. Participants will undergo comprehensive training with focuses on developing participants into underwriting specialists through an expert track aligned with Asuransi Astra’s business needs.

As part of the program, participants will be developed within one of the following underwriting specializations:

  • Marine & Aviation: Manage risks and insurance coverage related to marine cargo, hull, logistics, and aviation businesses.
  • Property & Casualty: Assess and underwrite risks for property, industrial assets, and general liability insurance.
  • Energy, Engineering & Major Risks: Handle complex risks associated with energy, construction, infrastructure, and large-scale industrial projects.
  • Heavy Equipment & Miscellaneous: Heavy equipment, machinery, and various specialized commercial risks.
  • Health: Evaluate and manage underwriting risks for corporate and individual health insurance products.
  • Retail Product Management: Develop, manage, and optimize retail insurance products to meet market needs and business objectives.
name: Underwriter Expert Program
qualifications:
• Candidate must possess at least a Bachelor's Degree (S1) in Engineering (Master Degree with related major/same major are welcome to apply)
  • Fresh Graduate are welcome to apply
  • Has Non-Academic Achievement will be a plus.

company.description:
PT. Global Talentlytica Indonesia adalah perusahaan yang mengembangkan Platform Assessment Online, layanan software as service di bidang Human Resource yang berdiri sejak tahun 2019, Talentlytica sebelumnya merupakan salah satu brand product dari perusahaan PT. Gagas Daya Imaji yang berdiri sejak tahun 2007. 

Talentlytica bergerak di jasa konsultan dan layanan di bidang pengembangan sumber daya manusia. Platform kami membantu Departemen HR untuk mengambil keputusan lebih baik menggunakan data dan analitik. Dengan dukungan ini HR dapat menjadi business partner yang efektif untuk mencapai tujuan organisasi secara keseluruhan. Saat ini kami mencari kandidat yang memiliki semangat belajar yang tinggi, ingin membantu talent menemukan pekerjaan yang fit dengan diri mereka.

Umat manusia menghadapi ancaman  sosial yang tidak terbayangkan sebelumnya. Industrial Revolution 4.0 atau dikenal juga sebagai Conceptual Age akan membuat automation dan artificial intelligence merubah bagaimana manusia hidup dan bekerja. Hal ini  akan membuat Krisis tenaga kerja , dan dampaknya berbeda dengan revolusi yang terjadi sebelumnya. Pada revolusi sebelumnya membutuhkan waktu beberapa dekade dan generasi sebelum itu benar-benar terjadi secara menyeluruh.
Saat ini perubahan tersebut jauh lebih cepat dan sangat mungkin terjadi dalam satu rentang generasi bahkan lebih cepat. Hal tersebut menjadi tantangan besar (sama seperti Climate Change, Sampah, Krisis Energy dlsb).

company.description:
Ruangguru merupakan perusahaan teknologi terbesar dan terlengkap di Indonesia yang berfokus pada layanan berbasis pendidikan dan telah memiliki lebih dari 13 juta pengguna serta telah mengelola lebih dari 500.000 guru yang menawarkan jasa di lebih dari 100 bidang pelajaran. Perusahaan ini didirikan sejak tahun 2014 oleh Belva Devara dan Iman Usman, yang keduanya berhasil masuk dalam jajaran pengusaha sukses dibawah 30 tahun melalui Forbes 30 under 30 untuk teknologi konsumen di Asia.

Ruangguru berkomitmen untuk menjadi mitra bagi pemerintah daerah demi memberikan pendidikan berkualitas melalui Sistem Manajemen Belajar (LMS). Selain itu, Ruangguru juga menawarkan video belajar berlangganan, marketplace les privat, layanan bimbingan belajar on-demand, tryout ujian online, dan lain-lain.

Ruangguru merupakan perusahaan teknologi terbesar dan terlengkap di Indonesia yang berfokus pada layanan berbasis pendidikan dan telah memiliki lebih dari 13 juta pengguna serta telah mengelola lebih dari 500.000 guru yang menawarkan jasa di lebih dari 100 bidang pelajaran. Perusahaan ini didirikan sejak tahun 2014 oleh Belva Devara dan Iman Usman, yang keduanya berhasil masuk dalam jajaran pengusaha sukses dibawah 30 tahun melalui Forbes 30 under 30 untuk teknologi konsumen di Asia.

Ruangguru berkomitmen untuk menjadi mitra bagi pemerintah daerah demi memberikan pendidikan berkualitas melalui Sistem Manajemen Belajar (LMS). Tahun lalu, Ruangguru berhasil bekerja sama dengan 32 (dari 34) pemerintah provinsi dan lebih dari 326 pemerintah kota dan kabupaten di Indonesia. Selain itu, Ruangguru juga menawarkan video belajar berlangganan, marketplace les privat, layanan bimbingan belajar on-demand, tryout ujian online, dan lain-lain.

company.description:
Ruangguru merupakan perusahaan teknologi terbesar dan terlengkap di Indonesia yang berfokus pada layanan berbasis pendidikan dan telah memiliki lebih dari 13 juta pengguna serta telah mengelola lebih dari 500.000 guru yang menawarkan jasa di lebih dari 100 bidang pelajaran. Perusahaan ini didirikan sejak tahun 2014 oleh Belva Devara dan Iman Usman, yang keduanya berhasil masuk dalam jajaran pengusaha sukses dibawah 30 tahun melalui Forbes 30 under 30 untuk teknologi konsumen di Asia.

Ruangguru berkomitmen untuk menjadi mitra bagi pemerintah daerah demi memberikan pendidikan berkualitas melalui Sistem Manajemen Belajar (LMS). Tahun lalu, Ruangguru berhasil bekerja sama dengan 32 (dari 34) pemerintah provinsi dan lebih dari 326 pemerintah kota dan kabupaten di Indonesia. Selain itu, Ruangguru juga menawarkan video belajar berlangganan, marketplace les privat, layanan bimbingan belajar on-demand, tryout ujian online, dan lain-lain.

company.description:
Ruangguru merupakan perusahaan teknologi terbesar dan terlengkap di Indonesia yang berfokus pada layanan berbasis pendidikan dan telah memiliki lebih dari 13 juta pengguna serta telah mengelola lebih dari 500.000 guru yang menawarkan jasa di lebih dari 100 bidang pelajaran. Perusahaan ini didirikan sejak tahun 2014 oleh Belva Devara dan Iman Usman, yang keduanya berhasil masuk dalam jajaran pengusaha sukses dibawah 30 tahun melalui Forbes 30 under 30 untuk teknologi konsumen di Asia.

Ruangguru berkomitmen untuk menjadi mitra bagi pemerintah daerah demi memberikan pendidikan berkualitas melalui Sistem Manajemen Belajar (LMS). Tahun lalu, Ruangguru berhasil bekerja sama dengan 32 (dari 34) pemerintah provinsi dan lebih dari 326 pemerintah kota dan kabupaten di Indonesia. Selain itu, Ruangguru juga menawarkan video belajar berlangganan, marketplace les privat, layanan bimbingan belajar on-demand, tryout ujian online, dan lain-lain.

Perusahaan ini didirikan sejak tahun 2014 oleh Belva Devara dan Iman Usman, yang keduanya berhasil masuk dalam jajaran pengusaha sukses dibawah 30 tahun melalui Forbes 30 under 30 untuk teknologi konsumen di Asia.

Ruangguru berkomitmen untuk menjadi mitra bagi pemerintah daerah demi memberikan pendidikan berkualitas melalui Sistem Manajemen Belajar (LMS). Tahun lalu, Ruangguru berhasil bekerja sama dengan 32 (dari 34) pemerintah provinsi dan lebih dari 326 pemerintah kota dan kabupaten di Indonesia. Selain itu, Ruangguru juga menawarkan video belajar berlangganan, marketplace les privat, layanan bimbingan belajar on-demand, tryout ujian online, dan lain-lain.

description:
Job Purpose

To generate and qualify sales opportunities for SAP GROW, particularly SAP GROW Fast Package, through structured outbound calling and lead qualification. The position is responsible for engaging prospects, identifyingbusiness needs, conducting BANT qualification, and handing over qualified opportunities to the assigned Sales team.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Conduct outbound calls to prospective customers based on company-provided lead and prospect databases.
  2. Introduce SAP GROW and relevant value propositions in a concise and professional manner.
  3. Identify prospects' current ERP/business systems and key business challenges.
  4. Conduct BANT qualification:

  • Budget
  • Authority
  • Need
  • Timeline

5. Identify key decision makers, influencers, and relevant stakeholders.

6. Identify potential SAP GROW use cases and business drivers.

7. Schedule discovery meetings between qualified prospects and the assigned Sales team.

8. Provide complete lead qualification information to Sales.

9. Maintain accurate and up-to-date lead information in CRM.

10. Conduct follow-up calls and outreach based on agreed lead nurturing plans.

11. Coordinate with Sales regarding lead status, feedback, and next actions.

12. Monitor and achieve agreed monthly and quarterly lead-generation KPIs.

13. Provide regular reporting on calling activities, lead status, BANT qualification and conversion.

14. Continuously improve calling scripts, objection handling and qualification techniques based on Sales feedback.

address_components.address_line_1: RT09/RW05, Podomoro City, Tanjung Duren Selatan Kel., Grogol Petamburan

name: Sales Development Representative – SAP GROW
qualifications:
Qualification / Requirements

Minimum Qualifications

Education

  • Minimum Diploma / Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • Open to candidates with strong telesales/business development experience regardless of educational background.

Experience

Preferably:

  • 1–3 years experience in telesales, telemarketing, inside sales, SDR, lead generation or business development.
  • Experience selling B2B products/services is strongly preferred.
  • Experience in IT, software, SaaS, ERP, technology or consulting is an advantage.

Required Skills

  • Excellent verbal communication skills.
  • Confident making outbound calls to business prospects.
  • Good listening and questioning skills.
  • Able to identify customer pain points.
  • Able to conduct structured qualification conversations.
  • Comfortable speaking with managers and business decision makers.
  • Good follow-up discipline.
  • Able to work with CRM and Excel/Google Sheets.
  • Target-oriented and comfortable working with measurable KPIs.
  • Good Bahasa Indonesia and English communication skills.

Preferred Skills

Candidates with experience in:

  • SAP
  • ERP
  • SaaS
  • Cloud
  • Microsoft
  • Oracle
  • Salesforce
  • IT consulting
  • B2B technology sales

A Japan-based provider of digital gift and voucher reward fulfillment services. 

It has become rather easy these days, to connect with anyone.
But we believe we all seek not just a mere connection but one that connects through the heart.
In this realistic society, relationships tend to be dry with too much emphasis on rationality and efficiency. In fact, the traits of human ties of sending, receiving and sharing love and care, is probably diminishing.

giftee, in providing eGift as its foremost service, hopes to build all kinds of ties between the people, businesses and their townships. By having more warm connections in our world, it could make spontaneous feelings more forthcoming. As this starts to circulate smoothly, we should be forming a society built on better relationships. And so with this belief, we forge ahead.

company.description:
PT Kliring Penjaminan Efek Indonesia (KPEI) was established in 1996 as a Clearing and Guarantee
Institution or Central Counterparty (CCP) for the Indonesian capital market. In accordance with Law
No. 8 of 1995 on Capital Market, the Government of the Republic of Indonesia designated KPEI as
part of the Self-Regulatory Organization (SRO) of the Indonesian capital market, together with PT
Bursa Efek Indonesia (IDX) and PT Kustodian Sentral Efek Indonesia (KSEI). 

As an entity, KPEI’s line of business is to organize clearing of securities exchange transaction and
regulated over-thecounter (OTC) transactions as well as securities exchange settlement guarantee.
The development of industry and economy has enabled KPEI to expand its business activities by
conducting other financial supporting services, with the approval of the Financial Services Authority
(FSA) and in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. The year 2020 marked another
milestone of KPEI as it expanded its role as central counterparty (CCP) of the OTC Derivative market
in order to support the Government’s program to develop and integrity, efficient, and transparent
money market.

Asuransi Astra has been serving customers for more than half a century, precisely since September 12, 1956. The four Garda Mobile applications namely Otocare, Medcare, HR-access, and CR-access are consistently updated through various innovations aimed at customer convenience and comfort. The latest innovation developed in the Garda Mobile Otocare with the presence of GarXia, the first insurance purchase chatbot in Indonesia that can also help customers in reporting claims and the Garda Mall feature that allows users to shop for a variety of automotive needs, Astra Financial financial products, also to buying and selling cars. With the support of branches and workshops that are spread all over Indonesia, along with the best services and a series of achievements, certainly not stopping the steps of Asuransi Astra innovation through products that are built from the new spirit of Asuransi Astra to always provide comfort and peace for every customer. name: Information Security Officer
qualifications:
Education
Bachelor’s Degree (S1) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or a related field.

Experience

  • Minimum 2 years of relevant professional experience in Information Security, Cybersecurity, IT Risk, IT Governance, IT Compliance, or related fields.

  • Practical experience in information security assessment, security control implementation, compliance activities, or security assurance is preferred.

  • Experience in developing, reviewing, or implementing information security policies, standards, procedures, or controls is an advantage.

  • Experience working with business and technology stakeholders to address security gaps, coordinate remediation, and improve security controls is an advantage.

Skills

  1. Strong understanding of Information Security Management, Information Security Governance, Cybersecurity Risk Management, IT Governance, and applicable information security regulations and standards.

  2. Ability to assess information security risks and control effectiveness, identify security gaps, and develop appropriate recommendations or remediation actions.

  3. Ability to develop, implement, monitor, and continuously improve information security policies, standards, procedures, controls, and security programs in alignment with business requirements and identified risks.

  4. Ability to support security assurance and regulatory compliance activities, including evidence management, remediation tracking, and follow-up of audit or regulatory findings.

  5. Good technical understanding of IT Security, IT Infrastructure, Business Application Systems, Security Architecture, and Cybersecurity Incident Management, with an understanding of Stock Exchange Business Operations.

  6. Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across business, technology, risk, compliance, and audit functions.

  7. Relevant certification or training in Information Security, Cybersecurity, IT Risk, IT Governance, Compliance, or related fields is an advantage. A strong commitment to continuous learning and professional development in information security is highly valued.

General Requirements:

  1. Minimum GPA min. 3.00 (out of 4.00)
  2. Computer literate (Microsoft Office, MS Excel, & Power Point)
  3. Excellent communication skills in both Indonesian and English (verbal and written)
  4. Knowledge of Capital Market will be an advantage.
  5. Strong alignment with our core values: Teamwork, Integrity, Professionalism, and Service Excellence

EF EFEKTA English for Adults

EF - EXCELLENCE IN ENGLISH TRAINING

EF was founded in Sweden in 1965 with just one teacher and a big dream of "breaking down the barriers in language learning both regionally and culturally". Today, EF has become the world's best and largest provider of English language courses by offering language learning and certified courses to people of all ages with study abroad opportunities and cultural exchange programs. company.description: ﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿PT Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk (the Company) was established on May 9, 1990 under the name PT Trimulya Securindolestari based on Deed No. 64 dated May 9, 1990, which subsequently changed to PT Trimegah Securindolestari on May 28, 1990 based on Deed No. 227 dated May 28, 1990. The deeds were made before Rachmat Santoso, S.H., Notary in Jakarta, and have been announced in State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia No. 80 dated October 5, 1990, Supplement No. 3832. The Company earned Broker-Dealer License and Underwriting License from Bapepam & LK (now the Financial Services Authority) in 1992 and 1993. On October 12, 1999, the Company changed its name to PT Trimegah Securities Tbk based on Deed No. 17 dated October 12, 1999 made before Fathiah Helmi, S.H., Notaris in Jakarta and have been announced in State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia No. 90 dated February 1, 2000, Supplement No. 522, and on January 31, 2000 the Company listed its shares on the Jakarta Stock Exchange (now the Indonesia Stock Exchange) with the stock code “TRIM”. On January 31, 2011, PT Trimegah Asset Management, subsidiary of the Company, earned its business license as Investment Management Company. PT Trimegah Asset Management provides a variety of equity, balanced, fixed income and money market funds tailored to the needs of corporate clients, financial institutions and pension funds. To comply with the Financial Services Authority Regulation No. 20/POJK.04/2016 on the Licensing of Securities Companies that Undertake Business Activities as Underwriters and Broker-Dealers, effective as of July 29, 2016, the Company changed its name to PT Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk based on Deed No. 70 dated June 20, 2016 made before Fathiah Helmi, S.H., Notary in Jakarta. Equity Trading Division provides equity sales service in primary market and equity brokerage service in secondary market for retail and institutional clients. Fixed Income Trading Division provides fixed income securities sales service in primary market and fixed income securities brokerage service in secondary market such as Government Bonds, corporate bonds, Retail Government Bond, Retail Savings Bond, Retail Sharia Government Bond, and Savings Sharia Government Bond. Investment Banking Division provides equity and fixed income securities underwriting service as well as financial advisory service, including merger & acquisition, divestment, valuation, due diligence, corporate restructuring and financing and arranger. Starting April 2014, the Company also conducts activity as Mutual Fund Selling Agent for retail clients. To complete the services, the Company also provides online transaction facility for retail clients to invest in equity and mutual funds. On December 6, 2017, the Company earned Approval for Other Business Activity as Arranger, and Approval for Other Business Activity as Financial Advisor on September 21, 2018. PT Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk is Securities Company Member of the Indonesia Stock Exchange. PT Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk and PT Trimegah Asset Management are licensed, registered and supervised by the Financial Services Authority. description:
We are looking for an IT QA + Co-Project Manager (Co-PM) to support software quality assurance and project coordination.

The primary responsibility of this role is to ensure software quality through testing and defect management. In addition, the role will support the main Project Manager in coordinating project activities, monitoring progress, tracking deliverables, and following up on outstanding tasks to ensure smooth project execution.

Key Responsibilities

1. Quality Assurance (QA)

  • Review business and technical requirements to understand system functionality and expected outcomes.
  • Prepare and execute test scenarios, test cases, and test plans.
  • Perform functional, integration, regression, and UAT support.
  • Identify, document, track, and verify bugs and defects until resolution.
  • Collaborate with developers and relevant stakeholders to resolve issues and ensure software quality.
  • Support testing activities during system releases and deployment.

2. Project Coordination (Co-PM)

  • Assist the main Project Manager in coordinating day-to-day project activities.
  • Monitor project progress, timelines, milestones, and deliverables.
  • Follow up with team members on task status, outstanding issues, and action items.
  • Coordinate communication between developers, QA, business users, and other stakeholders.
  • Assist in preparing project status reports, meeting minutes, and progress updates.
  • Help identify project risks, dependencies, and potential delays, and escalate them to the main Project Manager.
  • Support project documentation and ensure project activities are properly tracked.
name: IT QA + Co Project Manager
qualifications:
• Minimum 2-3 years of experience in IT, with relevant experience in software QA and/or project coordination.
  • Solid understanding of software testing methodologies, SDLC, and Agile/Scrum practices.
  • Hands-on experience in preparing test cases, executing tests, and managing defects.
  • Experience coordinating tasks, tracking project progress, and working with cross-functional teams.
  • Strong communication, analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and capable of managing multiple priorities.
  • Able to work collaboratively with the main Project Manager, technical teams, and business stakeholders.

company.description:
Pandafood is a fast-growing snack manufacturing company from Indonesia, dedicated to bringing delicious and trusted products to consumers nationwide. Our journey began in 2015 as CV Panda Food, and in 2023 we took a major step forward by officially transforming into PT Pandafood Kreasi Indonesia. This transition marked a new chapter for us — one that focuses on expanding our reach and growing the business with a more professional and sustainable approach.

Our very first product was snack Panda Seaweed, which we introduced through souvenir stands, local shops, and modern retail stores around the Special Region of Yogyakarta. What started small quickly gained traction. Over time, our distribution network expanded to multiple regions across Indonesia, supported by a growing portfolio of brands and innovative snack products. Today, Pandafood is also a trusted private label partner for some of the country's leading modern retail chains.

At Pandafood, product quality and food safety always come first. All of our products are registered with BPOM MD license, certified Halal, and produced in facilities that meet HACCP standards. This reflects our strong commitment to maintaining high standards and earning consumer trust.

As we continue to grow, our focus remains clear: creating innovative products, strengthening our distribution network, and building meaningful partnerships. With a spirit of innovation, quality at the core, and a passion for delighting consumers, Pandafood is ready to make its mark as one of Indonesia's leading FMCG snack brands.

company.description:
PT Kliring Penjaminan Efek Indonesia (KPEI) was established in 1996 as a Clearing and Guarantee
Institution or Central Counterparty (CCP) for the Indonesian capital market. In accordance with Law
No. 8 of 1995 on Capital Market, the Government of the Republic of Indonesia designated KPEI as
part of the Self-Regulatory Organization (SRO) of the Indonesian capital market, together with PT
Bursa Efek Indonesia (IDX) and PT Kustodian Sentral Efek Indonesia (KSEI). 

As an entity, KPEI’s line of business is to organize clearing of securities exchange transaction and
regulated over-thecounter (OTC) transactions as well as securities exchange settlement guarantee.
The development of industry and economy has enabled KPEI to expand its business activities by
conducting other financial supporting services, with the approval of the Financial Services Authority
(FSA) and in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. The year 2020 marked another
milestone of KPEI as it expanded its role as central counterparty (CCP) of the OTC Derivative market
in order to support the Government’s program to develop and integrity, efficient, and transparent
money market.

description:
Personal Assistant to BOD

Job Summary
Bertanggung jawab mendukung kebutuhan administrasi dan operasional 6 anggota Direksi, termasuk pengelolaan agenda, perjalanan dinas, meeting, dan kegiatan Direksi. Memastikan seluruh kebutuhan Direksi terkoordinasi dengan baik, tepat waktu, dan profesional.

Tentang Peran Jabatan
Personal Assistant to BOD bertanggung jawab mendukung kebutuhan administrasi dan operasional 6 anggota Direksi, termasuk pengelolaan agenda, perjalanan dinas, meeting, dan kegiatan Direksi. Posisi ini juga berperan dalam memastikan koordinasi dengan pihak internal maupun eksternal berjalan efektif, tepat waktu, dan terorganisir.


Tanggung Jawab

  • Mengelola jadwal, agenda, meeting, dan kebutuhan administrasi Direksi.
  • Mengatur business trip dan corporate trip secara end-to-end, termasuk itinerary, transportasi, akomodasi, dan dokumen perjalanan.
  • Mengkoordinasikan meeting dan corporate event yang melibatkan Direksi, termasuk venue, konsumsi, perlengkapan, dan kebutuhan lainnya.
  • Mengelola administrasi pembayaran, kontrak, perizinan, dan dokumen resmi terkait kebutuhan Direksi.
  • Melakukan koordinasi dengan tim internal dan pihak eksternal seperti travel agent, vendor, dan pihak ketiga lainnya.
  • Memastikan seluruh kebutuhan Direksi terselesaikan dengan baik, tepat waktu, dan sesuai standar perusahaan.

company.description:
PT Surya Artha Nusantara Finance (SANF) is a financial services company in Indonesia, primarily focused on providing financing solutions for the heavy equipment and transportation sectors. SANF is a joint venture between PT Astra International Tbk, one of Indonesia's largest conglomerates, and Marubeni Corporation, a major Japanese trading company.

SANF offers a variety of financial products, including leasing, consumer financing, and factoring, to support businesses in acquiring heavy equipment, trucks, and machinery. The company plays a significant role in industries like construction, mining, agriculture, and transportation, helping businesses manage their financial needs through customized financing solutions.

Let's join our Fun, Friendly, and Continuous Growth journey!

company.description:
Asuransi Astra has been serving customers for more than half a century, precisely since September 12, 1956. The company, known for its Garda Oto motor vehicle insurance products, serves customers through a network of services spread across 28 branch offices, as well as service units and Garda Centers that continue developing. In addition to motor vehicle insurance, other products from Asuransi Astra are Garda Medika health insurance, mining industry insurance, agribusiness industry insurance, shop insurance, gas station insurance, sharia insurance, and others.

Since 2015, Asuransi Astra has developed its products and services digitally and introduced Garda Mobile as a collection of mobile applications intended for retail, commercial and general customers. The four Garda Mobile applications namely Otocare, Medcare, HR-access, and CR-access are consistently updated through various innovations aimed at customer convenience and comfort. The latest innovation developed in the Garda Mobile Otocare with the presence of GarXia, the first insurance purchase chatbot in Indonesia that can also help customers in reporting claims and the Garda Mall feature that allows users to shop for a variety of automotive needs, Astra Financial financial products, also to buying and selling cars. Asuransi Astra also has four digital products namely Garda Me, Garda Edu, Garda Home, and Garda Trip which can be purchased easily and quickly through the gardaoto.com site.

Asuransi Astra performance has also been recognized with various awards that have been received, including: Platinum Indonesia Best Brand Award (2002-2019), Top Brand Award (2007-2019), Service Quality Award (2007-2018), Corporate Image Award ( 2007-2019), Indonesian Customer Satisfaction Award (2001-2017), Indonesia Original Brand Award (2017-2019), General Insurance with very good financial performance in the Infobank Insurance Award (2008-2016, 2019), Excellent Service Experience Award (2013 -2020), Contact Center Service Excellence Award (2013-2020), Social Media Award (2012, 2016), Indonesia Sharia Finance Award (2017), Insurance Award (2017-2018), Insurance Consumer Choice Award (2017-2018), Asian Brands (2018), Marketing Award (2018), Indonesia Digital Innovation Award (2018), Markeeter of the Year (2018-2019), Infobrand Mobile Application Choice (2018), Marketeers Editor Choice Award (2018-2019), Indonesia Insurance Innovation Award (2019), Indonesia Digital Popular Brand Award (20 19), and others.

With the support of branches and workshops that are spread all over Indonesia, along with the best services and a series of achievements, certainly not stopping the steps of Asuransi Astra innovation through products that are built from the new spirit of Asuransi Astra to always provide comfort and peace for every customer. Therefore, Asuransi Astra will invest time and effort so that you always smile. "Peace of Mind to Millions" is the result that Asuransi Astra will provide to each customer.

description:
Role Overview

Acromax Media is an international digital media company founded in Germany in 2007, with offices in Hamburg, Vienna, Tirana, and Almaty. With a team of 50 professionals, we manage digital media operations for around 40 TV broadcasters, 100 podcast producers, 50 film producers, and approximately 6,000 music producers representing over 60,000 songs.

We are seeking a full-time, office-based Media Operations & Digital Rights Specialist to join our expanding international team. As a certified Google and YouTube Partner, we offer a structured, paid training program designed for individuals who want to build a career in digital rights management, music distribution, content publishing, and monetization.

Following successful completion of training and certification, candidates transition into full operational responsibilities within our Media Operations team.

What We Do

We ingest audio and video content from producers worldwide and publish it across major platforms including YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Spotify, Apple Music, Google TV, Apple TV, Deezer, and others.

We monetize content through advertising and subscription models, operating on a revenue-share basis. In addition to distribution, we provide:

Content screening for platform compliance (copyright, third-party usage, violent or restricted content)
Digital rights management and anti-piracy protection
Marketing campaigns to maximize performance
Analytics and reporting to optimize revenue and audience engagement

Our Media Operations team manages 6,000–8,000 videos daily for clients across the globe.

Key Responsibilities

Manage and publish content across major digital platforms
Handle uploads, scheduling, metadata optimization, and asset coordination
Operate YouTube backend systems and Facebook Business Rights Manager
Support digital rights enforcement and music distribution
Assist with anti-piracy and rights protection processes
Manage marketing campaigns via Google Ads
Process technical requests and helpdesk tickets
Maintain organized publishing workflows and media libraries
Monitor performance metrics and prepare reports
Collaborate with international team members in English
Training & Certification

As a certified YouTube Partner for over 10 years (across MCN, music, and publishing sectors), we provide structured English-language training through official partner lectures. Each new team member receives daily mentorship from experienced staff.

Training includes supervised online exams. Upon successful completion, employees receive official YouTube certification. Training time is fully paid.

Employment Terms

Full-time, office-based position
Structured rotational shift system with fair distribution of working hours
Paid training period followed by employment contract
International, professional, and collaborative work environment
Career development opportunities within digital media operations
Recruitment Process
Short introductory call (approx. 10 minutes)
Online capability test (40–60 minutes) involving hypothetical problem-solving scenarios
Final in-person meeting in the country of the new office location

We are expanding into Southeast Asia to strengthen our global media operations team and work with emerging talent beyond Europe and Central Asia.

Perusahaan ini didirikan sejak tahun 2014 oleh Belva Devara dan Iman Usman, yang keduanya berhasil masuk dalam jajaran pengusaha sukses dibawah 30 tahun melalui Forbes 30 under 30 untuk teknologi konsumen di Asia.

Ruangguru berkomitmen untuk menjadi mitra bagi pemerintah daerah demi memberikan pendidikan berkualitas melalui Sistem Manajemen Belajar (LMS). Tahun lalu, Ruangguru berhasil bekerja sama dengan 32 (dari 34) pemerintah provinsi dan lebih dari 326 pemerintah kota dan kabupaten di Indonesia. Selain itu, Ruangguru juga menawarkan video belajar berlangganan, marketplace les privat, layanan bimbingan belajar on-demand, tryout ujian online, dan lain-lain.

company.description:
Ruangguru merupakan perusahaan teknologi terbesar dan terlengkap di Indonesia yang berfokus pada layanan berbasis pendidikan dan telah memiliki lebih dari 13 juta pengguna serta telah mengelola lebih dari 500.000 guru yang menawarkan jasa di lebih dari 100 bidang pelajaran. Perusahaan ini didirikan sejak tahun 2014 oleh Belva Devara dan Iman Usman, yang keduanya berhasil masuk dalam jajaran pengusaha sukses dibawah 30 tahun melalui Forbes 30 under 30 untuk teknologi konsumen di Asia.

Ruangguru berkomitmen untuk menjadi mitra bagi pemerintah daerah demi memberikan pendidikan berkualitas melalui Sistem Manajemen Belajar (LMS). Tahun lalu, Ruangguru berhasil bekerja sama dengan 32 (dari 34) pemerintah provinsi dan lebih dari 326 pemerintah kota dan kabupaten di Indonesia. Selain itu, Ruangguru juga menawarkan video belajar berlangganan, marketplace les privat, layanan bimbingan belajar on-demand, tryout ujian online, dan lain-lain.

description:
• Membuat dan mengevaluasi desain sistem kelistrikan fasilitas migas (pembangkit daya/genset, jaringan transmisi, dan distribusi tegangan menengah/rendah).
  • Melakukan perhitungan teknis spesifik migas, seperti load calculation (analisis beban), cable sizing (ukuran kabel), voltage drop (susut tegangan), dan short circuit calculation (arus hubung singkat) menggunakan software seperti ETAP.
  • Menyusun dokumen teknis, spesifikasi material/peralatan, Single Line Diagram (SLD), serta Material Take Off (MTO).
  • Mengatur dan memonitor pemeliharaan preventif maupun korektif pada peralatan listrik seperti switchgear, transformer (trafo), circuit breaker, motor listrik, dan sistem ups (Uninterruptible Power Supply).
  • Memastikan sistem pentanahan (grounding system / lightning protection) terpasang dan berfungsi aman.
  • Menangani gangguan kelistrikan darurat (troubleshooting) untuk meminimalkan waktu henti (downtime) fasilitas produksi.
  • Terlibat dalam fase Engineering, Procurement, Construction, and Commissioning (EPCC).
  • Mengawasi instalasi peralatan listrik di lapangan agar sesuai dengan standar keselamatan migas internasional (seperti IEC, IEEE, API).
  • Mendukung proses pengujian fungsional dan commissioning sistem kelistrikan sebelum fasilitas beroperasi penuh.
  • Memastikan seluruh pekerjaan mematuhi protokol Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja (K3 / HSE), mengingat tingginya risiko area kerja migas (area hazardous / mudah meledak).
  • Menyiapkan estimasi biaya (cost estimation), anggaran, dan evaluasi penawaran teknis vendor (bid evaluation).

qualifications:

  • Pengalaman Minimal 3-5 tahun
  • Mampu menggunakan software industri seperti ETAP (untuk analisis sistem tenaga listrik) atau AutoCAD.
  • Pemahaman regulasi dan standar seperti IEC, IEEE, API, dan ATEX (untuk area berbahaya dengan risiko ledakan).
  • Mampu membuat perhitungan teknis seperti Cable Sizing (ukuran kabel), Short Circuit Calculation (arus hubung singkat), dan Load Flow (aliran beban).
  • Kemampuan membuat estimasi biaya, jadwal pengerjaan, dan pengawasan di lapangan.

  • Memastikan kebersihan dan sanitasi area kerja, peralatan dapur, serta fasilitas penyimpanan sesuai standar keamanan pangan.

  • Membantu memberikan pelatihan dan arahan teknis kepada Commis Chef untuk meningkatkan keterampilan memasak.
  • Berkoordinasi dengan Sous Chef dan bagian dapur lainnya untuk menjaga kelancaran operasional, terutama pada jam sibuk.

company.description:
Making dream homes happen since 2015, Dekoruma is a rapidly-growing tech startup aiming to put a stop to the inefficiencies that have long occurred in the Home & Living industry. We believe that everyone is entitled to easy access not only to quality furniture at an affordable price, but also economical home design and its nitty-gritty. Since its establishment, we have launched vertically integrated business units (and even more to come), two of them being interior design services and material supply store.

While interior design services and furniture manufacturers remain abundant, there has yet to be a one-stop platform that actualises the A to Z’s of realizing your dream homes. Dekoruma intends to be the one answer to this demand.

Engage in a workplace surrounded by vibrant energy and youth who does work that matters and improvements that make a difference. We seek to create a working environment that is dynamic, and above all, impactful. In Dekoruma, we work for a cause, not just applause.

company.description: PT Prima Karya Sarana Sejahtera (PKSS) merupakan anak perusahaan Yayasan Kesejahteraan Pekerja Bank Rakyat Indonesia (YKP BRI) dan Dana Pensiun BRI. company.description:
Impack Pratama – with its entrepreneurial spirit and commitment to enhancing people’s lifestyles with innovative products, has established itself as a leader in the Indonesian plastic building material industry.

Since the Company’s establishment in 1981, the management is consistently maintaining and pursuing its commitments towards ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction and its dedication to high quality products. These factors have been instrumental in shaping Impack’s corporate culture and in bringing about its proud record and achievements to date. To secure Impack’s position as a leading plastics building material company in the Asia Pacific Region, the management and staff are well-equipped with the necessary skill, entrepreneurial spirit and total commitments to implement and achieve their desired goals. Each of our subsidiaries and business divisions have bottom-line responsibility for their own businesses and operations, and operates in a synergistic manner towards a common goal. With a dynamic supported by an experienced management team, Impack is well-prepared to expand the production capacity of its core business units in the coming years. With its orientation towards the future, the company is poised to become the market leader in the Asia Pacific Region.

company.description:
Ruangguru merupakan perusahaan teknologi terbesar dan terlengkap di Indonesia yang berfokus pada layanan berbasis pendidikan dan telah memiliki lebih dari 13 juta pengguna serta telah mengelola lebih dari 500.000 guru yang menawarkan jasa di lebih dari 100 bidang pelajaran. Perusahaan ini didirikan sejak tahun 2014 oleh Belva Devara dan Iman Usman, yang keduanya berhasil masuk dalam jajaran pengusaha sukses dibawah 30 tahun melalui Forbes 30 under 30 untuk teknologi konsumen di Asia.

Ruangguru berkomitmen untuk menjadi mitra bagi pemerintah daerah demi memberikan pendidikan berkualitas melalui Sistem Manajemen Belajar (LMS). Tahun lalu, Ruangguru berhasil bekerja sama dengan 32 (dari 34) pemerintah provinsi dan lebih dari 326 pemerintah kota dan kabupaten di Indonesia. Selain itu, Ruangguru juga menawarkan video belajar berlangganan, marketplace les privat, layanan bimbingan belajar on-demand, tryout ujian online, dan lain-lain.

description:

Ruangguru merupakan perusahaan teknologi terbesar dan terlengkap di Indonesia yang berfokus pada layanan berbasis pendidikan dan telah memiliki lebih dari 13 juta pengguna serta telah mengelola lebih dari 500.000 guru yang menawarkan jasa di lebih dari 100 bidang pelajaran. Ruangguru berkomitmen untuk menjadi mitra bagi pemerintah daerah demi memberikan pendidikan berkualitas melalui Sistem Manajemen Belajar (LMS). Tahun lalu, Ruangguru berhasil bekerja sama dengan 32 (dari 34) pemerintah provinsi dan lebih dari 326 pemerintah kota dan kabupaten di Indonesia. Selain itu, Ruangguru juga menawarkan video belajar berlangganan, marketplace les privat, layanan bimbingan belajar on-demand, tryout ujian online, dan lain-lain.

Perusahaan ini didirikan sejak tahun 2014 oleh Belva Devara dan Iman Usman, yang keduanya berhasil masuk dalam jajaran pengusaha sukses dibawah 30 tahun melalui Forbes 30 under 30 untuk teknologi konsumen di Asia.

Ruangguru berkomitmen untuk menjadi mitra bagi pemerintah daerah demi memberikan pendidikan berkualitas melalui Sistem Manajemen Belajar (LMS). Tahun lalu, Ruangguru berhasil bekerja sama dengan 32 (dari 34) pemerintah provinsi dan lebih dari 326 pemerintah kota dan kabupaten di Indonesia. Selain itu, Ruangguru juga menawarkan video belajar berlangganan, marketplace les privat, layanan bimbingan belajar on-demand, tryout ujian online, dan lain-lain.

Ruangguru merupakan perusahaan teknologi terbesar dan terlengkap di Indonesia yang berfokus pada layanan berbasis pendidikan dan telah memiliki lebih dari 13 juta pengguna serta telah mengelola lebih dari 500.000 guru yang menawarkan jasa di lebih dari 100 bidang pelajaran. Ruangguru berkomitmen untuk menjadi mitra bagi pemerintah daerah demi memberikan pendidikan berkualitas melalui Sistem Manajemen Belajar (LMS). Tahun lalu, Ruangguru berhasil bekerja sama dengan 32 (dari 34) pemerintah provinsi dan lebih dari 326 pemerintah kota dan kabupaten di Indonesia. Selain itu, Ruangguru juga menawarkan video belajar berlangganan, marketplace les privat, layanan bimbingan belajar on-demand, tryout ujian online, dan lain-lain.

description:
1. Carry out Red Team (offensive security) activities such as penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, exploitation, and red team simulations to proactively identify weaknesses in applications, infrastructure, and cloud environments.

2. Perform Blue Team (defensive security) tasks including continuous monitoring of systems and networks, analyzing alerts from SIEM/IDS/IPS/EDR, and leading security incident detection and response.

3. Develop and fine-tune detection rules, correlation logic, and automation scripts to improve proactive defense and reduce response time.

4. Research latest attack techniques, exploits, and defense mechanisms to stay ahead of evolving cyber threats.

5. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (SOC, DevOps, IT, Engineering) to embed security across the SDLC and infrastructure.

6. Document findings, prepare reports, and provide clear remediation guidance for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

address_components.address_line_1: 52, RT05/RW03, Jalan Jenderal Sudirman, Senayan Kel., Kebayoran Baru

name: Security Engineer
qualifications:
1. Min. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).

2. Min. 1 years of experience in cyber security, with exposure to both offensive and defensive practices.

3. Strong knowledge of penetration testing frameworks (Metasploit, Burp Suite, Kali Linux, Nmap, OWASP ZAP).

4. Hands-on experience with defensive tools: SIEM (QRadar, FortiSIEM), IDS/IPS, EDR (CrowdStrike, Sophos), Firewalls, and WAF.

5. Solid understanding of security frameworks and methodologies (MITRE ATT&CK, OWASP Top 10, NIST, ISO 27001).

6. Having Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) Certification is a plus.

description:
About this Position
This role focuses on building and optimizing high-performance Android applications that deliver smooth, responsive, and seamless user experiences. You will collaborate with Product, Design, QA, and Engineering teams to develop new features, improve application performance, and deliver fluid UI transitions and animations comparable to leading quick-commerce applications such as Blinkit and Zepto. You will also take ownership of performance profiling, troubleshooting, and optimization across app startup time, CPU utilization, frozen frames, memory consumption, and UI rendering. Additionally, you will explore and leverage AI tools to improve development efficiency and support practical implementation in daily engineering workflows.

As our Astronaut, your missions are:

  • Lead the development, optimization, and maintenance of Android applications, ensuring high performance, reliability, scalability, and code quality.
  • Identify, diagnose, and resolve performance bottlenecks related to app startup time, screen load time, CPU utilization, frozen frames, memory consumption, and UI rendering.
  • Implement smooth UI transitions, animations, gestures, and micro-interactions to deliver a responsive and seamless user experience comparable to Blinkit and Zepto.
  • Profile and optimize Android rendering performance, scrolling behavior, frame rendering time, and main-thread execution to minimize UI jank and frozen frames.
  • Collaborate with Product and Design teams to translate UI/UX requirements into polished, high-performance Android experiences.
  • Establish performance benchmarks, monitor production metrics, and continuously improve application responsiveness and resource efficiency.
  • Lead technical design discussions, break down complex engineering problems into actionable tasks, and ensure timely, high-quality feature delivery.
  • Perform code reviews, mentor engineers, and promote best practices in Android development, performance optimization, testing, and maintainable architecture.
  • Take ownership of the full product lifecycle, including development, testing, release, production monitoring, and continuous improvement.
  • Explore and leverage AI tools or technologies to improve development efficiency and support practical implementation in daily engineering workflows, including coding, debugging, refactoring, test generation, and documentation.
  • Evaluate AI-generated code and solutions to ensure correctness, security, maintainability, and performance before integrating them into production applications.

name: Senior Android Engineer
qualifications:
In order to launch successfully, you need to have:

  • Minimum 3-4 years of experience in software engineering, with strong hands-on experience in native Android application development.
  • Strong proficiency in Kotlin, Android SDK, Android Jetpack libraries, and modern Android development practices.
  • Solid experience with Jetpack Compose and/or the Android View system, including advanced UI rendering, animations, transitions, and gesture handling.
  • Proven experience identifying and resolving Android performance issues related to application startup, screen load time, CPU utilization, frozen frames, frame rendering time, and memory consumption.
  • Hands-on experience with performance profiling and debugging tools such as Android Studio Profiler, Perfetto, Android GPU Inspector, Firebase Performance, and LeakCanary.
  • Strong understanding of Android's rendering pipeline, frame deadlines, VSync, main-thread execution, garbage collection, memory allocation, and CPU/GPU utilization.
  • Proven ability to build smooth, responsive UI experiences, including complex animations, seamless navigation transitions, optimized scrolling, skeleton loading states, and interactive components.
  • Experience optimizing lists, image loading, caching, asynchronous processing, and background operations using technologies such as RecyclerView, Kotlin Coroutines, and Flow.
  • Solid understanding of software architecture and design patterns, including MVVM or MVI, dependency injection, modularization, and clean code principles.
  • Experience with application performance monitoring, benchmarking, production troubleshooting, and regression prevention.
  • Practical experience exploring and using AI-powered development tools to improve coding productivity, debugging, testing, refactoring, and other everyday engineering workflows.
  • Ability to validate AI-assisted implementations and ensure that generated solutions meet production standards for performance, security, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Good understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including testing, CI/CD, release management, production monitoring, and maintenance.
  • Possesses a curious and proactive mindset, continuously seeking feedback, learning new technologies, and exploring better engineering practices to improve application performance and development efficiency.

company.description:
Who We Are

We are a System Integration Firm that dedicated ourselves to Cloud Computing Solutions. We establish ICS to answer the future challenges, to provide solutions on how to get to market faster, create new experiences, and build operational muscle for sustainable results. Rising to those challenges, we provide Implementation, Managed Services, Consultancies, for multinational and local enterprises, or startups that are building their path for greater future. We will provide the most effective, cost optimized solution to all of our customers. We will answer every challenge with innovation to transform our client businesses, so they could scale new opportunities and balance the two for a wise pivot for a sustainable business. Our company comprise of engineers that has been in the industry for more than 10 years, we are confident to provide the right and most effective solutions to all of our clients. As a leader in CLOUD solutions and services, ICS helps global enterprises and midsize organizations to increase the efficiency and flexibility of their mission-critical cloud infrastructure and support operations, through a dedicated team of cloud experts.We have done more than 50 migrations during our 3 years of establishments, and more than 100 customers currently. We have done not only migrations, but also SAP Implementation, Magento for e-commerce, and Dev-Ops implementation in many industries. We keep adding more competencies to serve more unique requirements from our customers.

Why us

We are advisors, strategists and engineers focused to emphasize your business. We are born in the cloud. Running in the  business over a decade allow us to have experiences in many industries, shape us to provide the right solutions for all of our customers.

•	Indonesia AWS Advance Partner
Since 2019, we’ve become the first local advance partner in Indonesia. ICS Compute has proven to deliver best practice for cloud computing to the customers, not only from reliability, security, scalability, but also for cost and infra optimization.
•	Certified Cloud Engineer
We certified all of our engineers to give our customers convenience, and to make sure that we can provide and deliver best practice solutions to all of our customers base on their workload.
•	Quality Cloud Infrastructure
By leverage the services from the cloud providers, we provide quality solutions, which include aspects of security, high availability, scalability, reliable and cost optimized.
•	Best Value for Money
We will help our customers in their cloud journey, and it also include by helping them choose the right cloud providers, the right billing method, and do several tips and tricks that can help them to optimize their cloud usages.
•	Rich Feature Solutions
All applications that was created currently already available to implement on Cloud. These movement will create a rich environment in Cloud Computing, from a-z of your requirements will be available on top of Cloud Computing. You don’t have to look elsewhere to find the right and effective features for your company. From Infrastructure as a service, transform your workload to combine platform as a service, software as a service and function as a service, and develop your data analytic by using the cloud services. Technology grows rapidly, providing thousands innovation every year, so modernize your company now and create greater opportunities with our solutions to compete in the market.

Our core values

In ICS, we believe the future will be all digital on top of Cloud. Because we believe Cloud Computing has the scalability, the flexibility and the optimization that will be required by all industries. Simply said, Cloud Computing is a necessities. So, we are obsessively passionate and focus on the curve of technology, following every innovation and optimization that will help our customers to reach their goals. Born in the cloud, we trained all of our Team to follow the curve of technology and innovation. So we could provide the best solution to boost their businesses with the most optimize cost. We are more than happy to assist and helped you in pursuing your dreams through technology and innovation. Let’s Grow Together!

company.description:
ALEPH PROFILE:

Hello, we noticed you taking a peek.

It all started on a stormy day in May 2006. There was rain, there was thunder, there was lightning, and there was Aleph.

Aleph is a striking group of craftsmen specialised in strategy, design and technology. We work together to plan, write and produce internet, mobile, and desktop solutions for the most daring set of clients. Bold clients who see the future of user-centric experience and engage Aleph as their rocket fuel.

ALEPH CULTURE:

We’ve grown from a garage operation to a staff strength of 300 and growing across Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam and Thailand; but we still maintain a boutique company feel and culture within each local market. This is what bonds us and yet frees us enough to apply our unique talents, to deliver functional and flexible solutions, to dream big and to make it happen within this part of the world.

First discovered in 2006 the Alephian is a rare species. As a highly collaborative species, the Alephian loves to gather together and exercise great creativity to accomplish large difficult projects for its counter part in the natural hierarchy: “the client”.

The Alephian’s natural habitat is in the mobile and internet space where its nimble fingers and outstanding control of Wacom pens creates beautiful websites, apps, and campaigns.

A peculiar characteristic is the Alephian ability to communicate relevant information consistently. This is highlighted by a Friday morning tradition where they gather around food and exchange knowledge. This appears to be an effort to become a better group of species.

When not at work, Alephians can be found enjoying Southeast Asia’s beautiful resorts and beaches, planning a theme party or cycling together. And if you ever walk by, put your hand up. Alephians love giving high fives.
company.name: Aleph Labs

At Aleph Labs, we are expanding our Talent Pool for Senior DevOps Engineers (.NET Stack) to drive upcoming, high-impact digital initiatives. In this role, you will work closely with top-tier local and regional clients, backed by our global network to build, scale, and secure high-availability cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Infrastructure & CI/CD Management: Propose, design, and maintain scalable infrastructure and CI/CD processes for .NET applications and microservices.
  • AI-Powered Workflow: Leverage modern Agentic AI tools (Cursor, Claude, Copilot) to accelerate scripting, automation, and infrastructure troubleshooting.
  • Security & System Performance: Strengthen application and environment security, optimize system performance, and enhance alerting/monitoring mechanisms.
  • Client & Team Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional Agile/Scrum teams to deliver end-to-end products and communicate effectively in English with local and regional stakeholders.
  • Engineering Best Practices: Automate day-to-day operations, manage technical debt, and evangelize DevOps best practices across development workflows.

  • Proficient in scripting (Bash, PowerShell, Python) and automation/IaC tools (Terraform, Ansible).

company.description:
Asuransi Astra has been serving customers for more than half a century, precisely since September 12, 1956. The company, known for its Garda Oto motor vehicle insurance products, serves customers through a network of services spread across 28 branch offices, as well as service units and Garda Centers that continue developing. In addition to motor vehicle insurance, other products from Asuransi Astra are Garda Medika health insurance, mining industry insurance, agribusiness industry insurance, shop insurance, gas station insurance, sharia insurance, and others.

Since 2015, Asuransi Astra has developed its products and services digitally and introduced Garda Mobile as a collection of mobile applications intended for retail, commercial and general customers. The four Garda Mobile applications namely Otocare, Medcare, HR-access, and CR-access are consistently updated through various innovations aimed at customer convenience and comfort. The latest innovation developed in the Garda Mobile Otocare with the presence of GarXia, the first insurance purchase chatbot in Indonesia that can also help customers in reporting claims and the Garda Mall feature that allows users to shop for a variety of automotive needs, Astra Financial financial products, also to buying and selling cars. Asuransi Astra also has four digital products namely Garda Me, Garda Edu, Garda Home, and Garda Trip which can be purchased easily and quickly through the gardaoto.com site.

Asuransi Astra performance has also been recognized with various awards that have been received, including: Platinum Indonesia Best Brand Award (2002-2019), Top Brand Award (2007-2019), Service Quality Award (2007-2018), Corporate Image Award ( 2007-2019), Indonesian Customer Satisfaction Award (2001-2017), Indonesia Original Brand Award (2017-2019), General Insurance with very good financial performance in the Infobank Insurance Award (2008-2016, 2019), Excellent Service Experience Award (2013 -2020), Contact Center Service Excellence Award (2013-2020), Social Media Award (2012, 2016), Indonesia Sharia Finance Award (2017), Insurance Award (2017-2018), Insurance Consumer Choice Award (2017-2018), Asian Brands (2018), Marketing Award (2018), Indonesia Digital Innovation Award (2018), Markeeter of the Year (2018-2019), Infobrand Mobile Application Choice (2018), Marketeers Editor Choice Award (2018-2019), Indonesia Insurance Innovation Award (2019), Indonesia Digital Popular Brand Award (20 19), and others.

With the support of branches and workshops that are spread all over Indonesia, along with the best services and a series of achievements, certainly not stopping the steps of Asuransi Astra innovation through products that are built from the new spirit of Asuransi Astra to always provide comfort and peace for every customer. Therefore, Asuransi Astra will invest time and effort so that you always smile. "Peace of Mind to Millions" is the result that Asuransi Astra will provide to each customer.
